Ext-GeographicalInformation ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1..20))
	-- Refers to geographical Information defined in 3G TS 23.032.
	-- This is composed of 1 or more octets with an internal structure according to
	-- 3G TS 23.032
	-- Octet 1: Type of shape, only the following shapes in 3G TS 23.032 are allowed:
	--		(a) Ellipsoid point with uncertainty circle
	--		(b) Ellipsoid point with uncertainty ellipse
	--		(c) Ellipsoid point with altitude and uncertainty ellipsoid
	--		(d) Ellipsoid Arc
	--		(e) Ellipsoid Point
	-- Any other value in octet 1 shall be treated as invalid
	-- Octets 2 to 8 for case (a) ? Ellipsoid point with uncertainty circle
	--		Degrees of Latitude				3 octets
	--		Degrees of Longitude				3 octets
	--		Uncertainty code				1 octet
	-- Octets 2 to 11 for case (b) ? Ellipsoid point with uncertainty ellipse:
	--		Degrees of Latitude				3 octets
	--		Degrees of Longitude				3 octets
	--		Uncertainty semi-major axis			1 octet
	--		Uncertainty semi-minor axis			1 octet
	--		Angle of major axis				1 octet
	--		Confidence					1 octet
	-- Octets 2 to 14 for case (c) ? Ellipsoid point with altitude and uncertainty ellipsoid
	--		Degrees of Latitude				3 octets
	--		Degrees of Longitude				3 octets
	--		Altitude					2 octets
	--		Uncertainty semi-major axis			1 octet
	--		Uncertainty semi-minor axis			1 octet
	--		Angle of major axis				1 octet
	--		Uncertainty altitude				1 octet
	--		Confidence					1 octet
	-- Octets 2 to 13 for case (d) ? Ellipsoid Arc
	--		Degrees of Latitude				3 octets
	--		Degrees of Longitude				3 octets
	--		Inner radius					2 octets
	--		Uncertainty radius				1 octet
	--		Offset angle					1 octet
	--		Included angle					1 octet
	--		Confidence					1 octet
	-- Octets 2 to 7 for case (e) ? Ellipsoid Point
	--		Degrees of Latitude				3 octets
	--		Degrees of Longitude				3 octets

	--
	-- An Ext-GeographicalInformation parameter comprising more than one octet and
	-- containing any other shape or an incorrect number of octets or coding according
	-- to 3G TS 23.032 shall be treated as invalid data by a receiver.
	--
	-- An Ext-GeographicalInformation parameter comprising one octet shall be discarded
	-- by the receiver if an Add-GeographicalInformation parameter is received 
	-- in the same message.
	--
	-- An Ext-GeographicalInformation parameter comprising one octet shall be treated as
	-- invalid data by the receiver if an Add-GeographicalInformation parameter is not

RatingGroupId ::= INTEGER

ServiceConditionChange	::= BIT STRING 
--{
--	qoSChange 				(0),	-- PDP context modification
--	sGSNChange 				(1), 	-- PDP context modification
--	sGSNPLMNIDChange 			(2), 	-- PDP context modification
--	tariffTimeSwitch 			(3), 	-- tariff time change
--	pDPContextRelease 			(4), 	-- PDP context release
--	rATChange 				(5),	-- PDP context modification
--	serviceIdledOut 			(6),	-- IP flow idle out, DCCA QHT expiry

--	configurationChange 			(8),	-- configuration change

--	dCCATimeThresholdReached 		(10),	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
--	dCCAVolumeThresholdReached 		(11), 	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
--	dCCAServiceSpecificUnitThresholdReached	(12), 	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
--	dCCATimeExhausted 			(13), 	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
--	dCCAVolumeExhausted 			(14), 	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
--	dCCAValidityTimeout 			(15), 	-- DCCA quota validity time (QVT expiry)
--	reserved2				(16),	-- reserved due to no use case, 
--													-- old: return Requested is covered by (17),(18)
--	dCCAReauthorisationRequest 		(17), 	-- DCCA quota reauthorization request by OCS
--	dCCAContinueOngoingSession 		(18), 	-- DCCA failure handling (CCFH),
--													-- continue IP flow
--	dCCARetryAndTerminateOngoingSession	(19), 	-- DCCA failure handling (CCFH),
--													-- terminate IP flow after DCCA retry
--	dCCATerminateOngoingSession 		(20), 	-- DCCA failure handling,
--													-- terminate IP flow
--	cGI-SAIChange				(21), 	-- PDP context modification
--	rAIChange				(22), 	-- PDP context modification
--	dCCAServiceSpecificUnitExhausted	(23), 	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
--	recordClosure				(24),	-- eG-CDR closure
--	timeLimit				(25),	-- intermediate recording
--	volumeLimit				(26),	-- intermediate recording
--	serviceSpecificUnitLimit		(27),	-- intermediate recording
--	envelopeClosure 			(28)
--} 
-- Trigger and cause values for IP flow level recording are defined for support of independent
-- online and offline charging and also for tight interworking between online and offline charging.

    downlinkVolume		[2]  INTEGER OPTIONAL,
    usageduration		[3]  INTEGER OPTIONAL,

    chargingRuleBaseName	[8]  ChargingRuleBaseName OPTIONAL,

    envelopeStartTime		[12] TimeStampExtension OPTIONAL,
    envelopeEndTime    		[13] TimeStampExtension OPTIONAL,
    duration			[14] CallDurationExtension OPTIONAL
}

	-- Value is in seconds with one digit after the comma

{
	numberOfEvents		[1] INTEGER,
	eventTimeStamps  	[2] SEQUENCE OF TimeStamp OPTIONAL
}

}

{

	continuousTimePeriod			(1),
	continousTimePeriodExtension	(100)
}

{
	changeTime  [1]  TimeStampExtension OPTIONAL
}

TimeStampExtension			::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(10))
	--
	-- The contents of this field are a compact form of the UTCTime format
	-- containing local time plus an offset to universal time. Binary coded
	-- decimal encoding is employed for the digits to reduce the storage and
	-- transmission overhead
	-- e.g. yymmddhhmmsss Suuvv	
	-- where
	-- YY 	= 	Year 00 to 99		BCD encoded
	-- MM 	= 	Month 01 to 12 	BCD encoded
	-- DD	=	Day 01 to 31		BCD encoded
	-- hh	=	hour 00 to 23		BCD encoded
	-- mm	=	minute 00 to 59	BCD encoded
	-- ss	=	second 00 to 59	BCD encoded
	-- s	= 	1/ 10 of a second: 0 to 9 BCD encoded
	-- S	=	Sign 0 = "+", "-"	ASCII encoded
	-- hh	=	hour 00 to 23		BCD encoded
	-- mm	=	minute 00 to 59	BCD encoded

END

--
--  GPRS DATA TYPES
--
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

AccessPointNameNI	::= IA5String (SIZE(1..63))
	--
	-- Network Identifier part of APN in  dot representation.
	-- For example, if the complete APN is 'apn1a.apn1b.apn1c.mnc022.mcc111.gprs'
	-- NI is 'apn1a.apn1b.apn1c' and is presented in this form in the CDR..

AddressString ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1..20))
	-- This type is used to represent a number for addressing
	-- purposes. It is composed of
	--	a)	one octet for nature of address, and numbering plan
	--		indicator.
	--	b)	digits of an address encoded as TBCD-String.

	-- a)	The first octet includes a one bit extension indicator, a
	--		3 bits nature of address indicator and a 4 bits numbering
	--		plan indicator, encoded as follows:

	-- bit 8: 1  (no extension)

	-- bits 765: nature of address indicator
	--	000  unknown
	--	001  international number
	--	010  national significant number
	--	011  network specific number
	--	100  subscriber number
	--	101  reserved
	--	110  abbreviated number
	--	111  reserved for extension

	-- bits 4321: numbering plan indicator
	--	0000  unknown
	--	0001  ISDN/Telephony Numbering Plan (Rec CCITT E.164)
	--	0010  spare
	--	0011  data numbering plan (CCITT Rec X.121)
	--	0100  telex numbering plan (CCITT Rec F.69)
	--	0101  spare
	--	0110  land mobile numbering plan (CCITT Rec E.212)
	--	0111  spare
	--	1000  national numbering plan
	--	1001  private numbering plan
	--	1111  reserved for extension

	--	all other values are reserved.

	-- b)	The following octets representing digits of an address
	--		encoded as a TBCD-STRING.	

AFChargingIdentifier ::= IA5String
    --
    -- see AF-Charging-Identifier AVP as defined in TS 29.214[221]
    --

AFRecordInformation	::= SEQUENCE
{
	aFChargingIdentifier		[1] AFChargingIdentifier,
	flows						[2] Flows OPTIONAL
}

APNSelectionMode::= ENUMERATED
{
	--

	-- YY 	= 	Year 00 to 99		BCD encoded

	-- hh	=	hour 00 to 23		BCD encoded
	-- mm	=	minute 00 to 59	BCD encoded
	-- ss	=	second 00 to 59	BCD encoded

	cSGAccessMode				[1] CSGAccessMode,
	cSGMembershipIndication 	[2] NULL OPTIONAL
}

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--
--  TMO EXPAND
--
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TmoCallDuration			::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(3..12))
-- The contents of this field are 2^32 - 1. Variable with one digit after the comma
-- Value is in seconds with one digit after the comma


TmoTimeStamp			::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(10))
--
-- The contents of this field are a compact form of the UTCTime format
-- containing local time plus an offset to universal time. Binary coded
-- decimal encoding is employed for the digits to reduce the storage and
-- transmission overhead
-- e.g. yymmddhhmmsss Suuvv	
-- where
-- YY 	= 	Year 00 to 99		BCD encoded
-- MM 	= 	Month 01 to 12 	BCD encoded
-- DD	=	Day 01 to 31		BCD encoded
-- hh	=	hour 00 to 23		BCD encoded
-- mm	=	minute 00 to 59	BCD encoded
-- ss	=	second 00 to 59	BCD encoded
-- s	= 	1/ 10 of a second: 0 to 9 BCD encoded
-- S	=	Sign 0 = "+", "-"	ASCII encoded
-- hh	=	hour 00 to 23		BCD encoded
-- mm	=	minute 00 to 59	BCD encoded  

ChangeTimeEvent ::= SEQUENCE
{
	changeTime  			[1]  	TmoTimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	changeTimeTimeZone		[2] 	INTEGER OPTIONAL	
}

CallDuration 			::= INTEGER
--
-- The call duration is counted in seconds. 
-- For successful calls /sessions / PDP contexts, this is the chargeable duration.
-- For call attempts this is the call holding time.


TurkcellSpecificFields	::= SEQUENCE
{
	--
	-- Added Container for Turkcell Specific Fields
	--
	sGWUniqueKey     		[1] SGWUniqueKey OPTIONAL,
	subscriptionType			[2] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	paymentType			[3] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	sourceDataNodeType	[4] SourceDataNodeType OPTIONAL,
	matched				[5] Matched OPTIONAL
	--cdrUniqueKey		[4] CdrUniqueKey OPTIONAL,

}

SGWUniqueKey ::= IA5STRING(SIZE(20))

Matched ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (2) CODE ("LEFT"))

SourceDataNodeType	::= ENUMERATED
{
	huaweiGGSN	(0),
	ciscoGGSN	(1),
	huaweiPGW	(2)
}

END

NRTRDEINFMSInput DEFINITIONS ::=
BEGIN

CallEvent ::= [APPLICATION 1] CHOICE
{
moc Moc OPTIONAL,
mtc Mtc OPTIONAL,
gprs Gprs OPTIONAL
}
--
-- Structure of the individual NRTRDE call events
-- Note: The Basic Call Information and Optional Call Information Groups
-- are not present in the physical structure, rather
-- they have been expanded into MOC, MTC and GPRS respectively.
--
Moc ::= [APPLICATION 3] SEQUENCE
{
imsi Imsi OPTIONAL,
imei Imei OPTIONAL,
callEventStartTimeStamp CallEventStartTimeStamp OPTIONAL,
utcTimeOffset UtcTimeOffset OPTIONAL,
callEventDuration CallEventDuration OPTIONAL,
causeForTermination CauseForTermination OPTIONAL,
serviceCode ServiceCode OPTIONAL,
supplementaryServiceCode SupplementaryServiceCode OPTIONAL,
dialledDigits DialledDigits OPTIONAL,
connectedNumber ConnectedNumber OPTIONAL,
thirdPartyNumber ThirdPartyNumber OPTIONAL,
recEntityId RecEntityId OPTIONAL,
callReference CallReference OPTIONAL,
chargeAmount ChargeAmount OPTIONAL,
servingNetwork ServingNetwork OPTIONAL,
msisdn Msisdn OPTIONAL,
locationArea LocationArea OPTIONAL,
cellId CellId OPTIONAL
--validationError ValidationError  OPTIONAL
}

Mtc ::= [APPLICATION 4] SEQUENCE
{
imsi Imsi OPTIONAL,
imei Imei OPTIONAL,
callEventStartTimeStamp CallEventStartTimeStamp OPTIONAL,
utcTimeOffset UtcTimeOffset OPTIONAL,
callEventDuration CallEventDuration OPTIONAL,
causeForTermination CauseForTermination OPTIONAL,
serviceCode ServiceCode OPTIONAL,
callingNumber CallingNumber OPTIONAL,
recEntityId RecEntityId OPTIONAL,
callReference CallReference OPTIONAL,
chargeAmount ChargeAmount OPTIONAL,
servingNetwork ServingNetwork OPTIONAL,
msisdn Msisdn OPTIONAL,
locationArea LocationArea OPTIONAL,
cellId CellId OPTIONAL
--validationError ValidationError  OPTIONAL
}

Gprs ::= [APPLICATION 5] SEQUENCE
{
imsi Imsi OPTIONAL,
imei Imei OPTIONAL,
callEventStartTimeStamp CallEventStartTimeStamp OPTIONAL,
utcTimeOffset UtcTimeOffset OPTIONAL,
callEventDuration CallEventDuration OPTIONAL,
causeForTermination CauseForTermination OPTIONAL,
accessPointNameNI AccessPointNameNI OPTIONAL,
accessPointNameOI AccessPointNameOI OPTIONAL,
dataVolumeIncoming DataVolumeIncoming OPTIONAL,
dataVolumeOutgoing DataVolumeOutgoing OPTIONAL,
sgsnAddress SgsnAddress OPTIONAL,
ggsnAddress GgsnAddress OPTIONAL,
chargingId ChargingId OPTIONAL,
chargeAmount ChargeAmount OPTIONAL,
servingNetwork ServingNetwork OPTIONAL,
msisdn Msisdn OPTIONAL,
locationArea LocationArea OPTIONAL,
cellId CellId OPTIONAL
--validationError ValidationError  OPTIONAL
}
--ValidationError ::= [APPLICATION 401] SEQUENCE
--{
--	recordNumber  RecordNumber OPTIONAL,
--	fileErrorCode  FileErrorCode OPTIONAL,
--	fieldName  FieldName OPTIONAL,
--	fileName   FileName OPTIONAL,
--	callType  CallType OPTIONAL
--}
RecordNumber ::= [APPLICATION 402] INTEGER
FileErrorCode ::= [APPLICATION 403]  SEQUENCE OF INTEGER
FieldName ::= [APPLICATION 404] AsciiString
FileName ::= [APPLICATION 405] AsciiString
CallType ::= ENUMERATED 
{
		 moc (0),
		 mtc (1),
		 gprs (2)
}
--
-- NRTRDE individual data items
--
AccessPointNameNI ::= [APPLICATION 16] AsciiString (SIZE(1..63))
AccessPointNameOI ::= [APPLICATION 17] AsciiString (SIZE(1..37))
BearerServiceCode ::= [APPLICATION 18] HexString (SIZE(2))
CallEventDuration ::= [APPLICATION 19] INTEGER (CODE("DEC"))
CallEventStartTimeStamp ::= [APPLICATION 21] NumberString (SIZE(14))
CallingNumber ::= [APPLICATION 22] NumberString
CallReference ::= [APPLICATION 23] INTEGER (CODE("DEC"))
CauseForTermination ::= [APPLICATION 24] INTEGER (CODE("DEC"))
CellId ::= [APPLICATION 47] INTEGER (CODE("DEC"))
ChargeAmount ::= [APPLICATION 25] INTEGER (CODE("DEC"))
ChargingId ::= [APPLICATION 26] INTEGER (CODE("DEC"))
ConnectedNumber ::= [APPLICATION 27] NumberString
DataVolumeIncoming ::= [APPLICATION 28] INTEGER (CODE("DEC"))
DataVolumeOutgoing ::= [APPLICATION 29] INTEGER (CODE("DEC"))
DialledDigits ::= [APPLICATION 30] AsciiString
GgsnAddress ::= [APPLICATION 32] AsciiString
Imei ::= [APPLICATION 33] BCDString (SIZE(7..8))
Imsi ::= [APPLICATION 34] BCDString (SIZE(3..8))
LocationArea ::= [APPLICATION 48] INTEGER (CODE("DEC"))
Msisdn ::= [APPLICATION 49] BCDString (SIZE(1..8))
RecEntityId ::= [APPLICATION 35] AsciiString

ServiceCode ::= [APPLICATION 46] EXPLICIT CHOICE
{
teleServiceCode TeleServiceCode OPTIONAL,
bearerServiceCode BearerServiceCode OPTIONAL
}

ServingNetwork ::= [APPLICATION 15] AsciiString
SgsnAddress ::= [APPLICATION 40] AsciiString
SupplementaryServiceCode ::= [APPLICATION 42] HexString (SIZE(2))
TeleServiceCode ::= [APPLICATION 43] HexString (SIZE(2))
ThirdPartyNumber ::= [APPLICATION 44] NumberString
UtcTimeOffset ::= [APPLICATION 45] AsciiString (SIZE(5))

--
-- Local timestamps are noted in the format
--
-- CCYYMMDDhhmmss
--
-- where CC = century ('20',...)
-- YY = year ('00' - '99')
-- MM = month ('01', '02', ... , '12')
-- DD = day ('01', '02', ... , '31')
-- hh = hour ('00', '01', ... , '23')
-- mm = minutes ('00', '01', ... , '59')
-- ss = seconds ('00', '01', ... , '59')
--
--
-- Non-tagged common data types
--
-- Recommended common data types to be used for encoding:
--
-- The following definitions should be used for NRTRDE record creation
-- instead of the default specifications (OCTET STRING)
--
 AsciiString ::= VisibleString
 HexString ::= VisibleString
 NumberString ::= NumericString

--AsciiString ::= OCTET STRING
--HexString ::= OCTET STRING
--NumberString ::= OCTET STRING
--
-- The BCDString data type (Binary Coded Decimal String) is used to
-- represent several digits from 0 through 9, a, b, c, d, e
-- two digits per octet, f as filler when there is an odd number
-- of digits.
--
BCDString ::= OCTET STRING
END

-- Ericsson shall have no liability for any errors or damage of any kind 
-- resulting from the use of modified versions of this document.
--
-- DESCRIPTION:
--  This is the BGw ASN.1 structure specification for TurkCell specific
--  structures, such as Matching keys etc.
--  
--
-- SOURCE DOCUMENT:
--      No. : 
--      Rev : 
-- 
--
-- ********************************************************************** 

TurkCellStructures DEFINITIONS ::=
BEGIN

--
-- MVPNKey
-- =======
--
-- The Key consists of
-- 
-- NCR: The NCR from the CDRs (unique for a call)
-- * isCompsite: will be '1' if the CDR is a composite, otherwise '0'
-- * isOriginating: Does the composite contains Originating data
-- * isDiverting: Does the composite contains Diverting data
--
--  SwitchNameTable
--  =======================
--
-- The Key is ExchangeID
-- The Data is SwitchIDNumber
-- 
-- The key is the id for the MSC
-- The data is a "short number" for the MSC
--
--
-- BscsName
-- =========
--
-- The Key is NeName
-- The Data is BscsName
--
-- VASNoCharge
-- ==============
--
-- The Key is Number
-- The Data is Reply
--
-- VASCharge
-- ==============
--
-- The Key is Number
-- The Data is Reply
--
-- UMdata
-- ============
--
-- The Key is Number
-- The Data is UMReply
--
--
-- MVPNCallType
-- ============
--
-- A enum
-- 
-- normalCall: a ordinary call
-- emergencyCall: a emergency call
-- customerControlCall: a customer control call
--


MVPNKey	::= SEQUENCE
{
	networkCallReference	[0]	NetworkCallReference OPTIONAL
}

MVPNCallType ::= ENUMERATED
{
	normalCall		(0),
	emergencyCall		(1),
	customerControlCall	(2)
}

ExchangeID		::= IA5STRING (SIZE(15) CODE("LEFT"))
SwitchIDNumber		::= IA5STRING (SIZE(3) CODE("LEFT"))
Number			::= IA5STRING (SIZE(18) CODE("LEFT"))
Reply			::= INTEGER (SIZE(3) CODE("DEC"))
NeName			::= IA5STRING
BscsName		::= IA5STRING
UMNumber		::= IA5STRING (SIZE(4) CODE("LEFT"))
UMReply			::= INTEGER (SIZE(1) CODE("DEC"))
PBXid			::= IA5STRING

NetworkCallReference	::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(5))

ServiceName	::= IA5STRING
Charge	::= INTEGER


END

	input_cdrs	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,
	partial_cdrs	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,
	duplicate_cdrs	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,
	discarded_cdrs	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,
	created_cdrs	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,
	corrupt_cdrs	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,
	output_cdrs	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,
	input_files	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,
	created_files	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,
	duplicate_files	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,
	corrupted_files	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,
	partial_files	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,
	discarded_files	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,
	empty_files	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,
	output_files	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D
	}
	ATEvent	::=	[APPLICATION	43]	ENUMERATED
	{	
	collection(67),	--	'C'
	processing(80),	--	'P'
	inProcessing(73),	--	'I'
	distribution(68),	--	'D'
	any(65)	--	'A'
	}
	ReportingAuditEntryList	::=	[APPLICATION	339]	SEQUENCE	OF	ReportingAuditEntry
	ReportingAuditEntry	::=	[APPLICATION	338]	SEQUENCE
	{
	auditTrailLogEntry	AuditTrailLogEntry,
	isNodeIntermediate	[1]	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	,
	isNodeAuditLogOn	[2]	BOOLEAN	OPTIONAL,
	reportingKey             [3]    ReportingKey  OPTIONAL
    }

    {   
        physicalServer  IA5String,
        logicalServer   IA5String,
        configuration   IA5String,
        collection  IA5String,
        serviceName     IA5String   OPTIONAL,
        configPosition  IA5String   OPTIONAL
    }

	AuditTrailLogEntry	::=	[APPLICATION	21]	SEQUENCE
	{
	event	ATEvent	(CODE("DEC")),	--	Type	of	audit	trail
	inNodeID	IA5STRING,	--	Internal	node	ID
	inNodeName	IA5STRING,	--	The	GUI	name	of	the	NE
	sourceID	IA5STRING,	--	Source	ID	of	the	file,	either	key	or	filename	
	inTime	IA5STRING,	--	Timestamp	when	start	of	file	action
	outNodeID	IA5STRING,	--	Internal	node	ID
	outNodeName	IA5STRING,	--	The	GUI	name	of	the	PPS
	destinationID	IA5STRING,	--	Destination	ID	of	the	file,	either	key	or	filename
	outTime	IA5STRING,	--	Timestamp	when	end	of	file	action
	bytes	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC")),
	cdrs	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC")),
	noOfSubfilesInFile	[1]	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	OPTIONAL,	--	Number	of	files	in	a	merged	collected	file	
	recordSequenceNumberList	[2]	IA5STRING	OPTIONAL,	--	String	with	the	RSNs	in	this	file
	inLoggedCDRs	[3]	SEQUENCE	OF	LogCDRs	OPTIONAL,
	outLoggedCDRs	[4]	SEQUENCE	OF	LogCDRs	OPTIONAL,
	logDetailCDRs	[7]	SEQUENCE	OF	LogDetailCDRs	OPTIONAL
	}
	LogCDRs	::=	[APPLICATION	76]	SEQUENCE
	{
	cdrName	IA5STRING,	--	The	name	of	the	logged	CDR	(or	variable)
	numOfCDRs	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,	--	The	number	of	logged	CDRs	of	type	'cdrName'.
	sumValue	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,	--	Summed	up	value	of	all	logged	variables.
	inOrOut	[1]	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	OPTIONAL
	}
	LogDetailCDRs	::=	[APPLICATION	295]	SEQUENCE
	{
	partial_CDRs	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,
	duplicate_CDRs	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,
	discarded_CDRs	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,
	created_CDRs	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,	
	corrupted_CDRs	INTEGER	(CODE("DEC"))	DEFAULT	'0'D,

	}

NRTRDEINFMSInput_Intermediate DEFINITIONS ::= 
BEGIN
CallEvent ::= [APPLICATION 1] CHOICE
{
moc Moc OPTIONAL,
mtc Mtc OPTIONAL,
gprs Gprs OPTIONAL
}
--
-- Structure of the individual NRTRDE call events
-- Note: The Basic Call Information and Optional Call Information Groups
-- are not present in the physical structure, rather
-- they have been expanded into MOC, MTC and GPRS respectively.
--
Moc ::= [APPLICATION 3] SEQUENCE
{
imsi Imsi OPTIONAL,
imei Imei OPTIONAL,
callEventStartTimeStamp CallEventStartTimeStamp OPTIONAL,
utcTimeOffset UtcTimeOffset OPTIONAL,
callEventDuration CallEventDuration OPTIONAL,
causeForTermination CauseForTermination OPTIONAL,
serviceCode ServiceCode OPTIONAL,
supplementaryServiceCode SupplementaryServiceCode OPTIONAL,
dialledDigits DialledDigits OPTIONAL,
connectedNumber ConnectedNumber OPTIONAL,
thirdPartyNumber ThirdPartyNumber OPTIONAL,
recEntityId RecEntityId OPTIONAL,
callReference CallReference OPTIONAL,
chargeAmount ChargeAmount OPTIONAL,
servingNetwork ServingNetwork OPTIONAL,
msisdn Msisdn OPTIONAL,
locationArea LocationArea OPTIONAL,
cellId CellId OPTIONAL,
validationError ValidationError  OPTIONAL
}

Mtc ::= [APPLICATION 4] SEQUENCE
{
imsi Imsi OPTIONAL,
imei Imei OPTIONAL,
callEventStartTimeStamp CallEventStartTimeStamp OPTIONAL,
utcTimeOffset UtcTimeOffset OPTIONAL,
callEventDuration CallEventDuration OPTIONAL,
causeForTermination CauseForTermination OPTIONAL,
serviceCode ServiceCode OPTIONAL,
callingNumber CallingNumber OPTIONAL,
recEntityId RecEntityId OPTIONAL,
callReference CallReference OPTIONAL,
chargeAmount ChargeAmount OPTIONAL,
servingNetwork ServingNetwork OPTIONAL,
msisdn Msisdn OPTIONAL,
locationArea LocationArea OPTIONAL,
cellId CellId OPTIONAL,
validationError ValidationError  OPTIONAL
}

Gprs ::= [APPLICATION 5] SEQUENCE
{
imsi Imsi OPTIONAL,
imei Imei OPTIONAL,
callEventStartTimeStamp CallEventStartTimeStamp OPTIONAL,
utcTimeOffset UtcTimeOffset OPTIONAL,
callEventDuration CallEventDuration OPTIONAL,
causeForTermination CauseForTermination OPTIONAL,
accessPointNameNI AccessPointNameNI OPTIONAL,
accessPointNameOI AccessPointNameOI OPTIONAL,
dataVolumeIncoming DataVolumeIncoming OPTIONAL,
dataVolumeOutgoing DataVolumeOutgoing OPTIONAL,
sgsnAddress SgsnAddress OPTIONAL,
ggsnAddress GgsnAddress OPTIONAL,
chargingId ChargingId OPTIONAL,
chargeAmount ChargeAmount OPTIONAL,
servingNetwork ServingNetwork OPTIONAL,
msisdn Msisdn OPTIONAL,
locationArea LocationArea OPTIONAL,
cellId CellId OPTIONAL,
validationError ValidationError  OPTIONAL
}
ValidationError ::= [APPLICATION 401] SEQUENCE
{
	recordNumber  RecordNumber OPTIONAL,
	fileErrorCode  FileErrorCode OPTIONAL,
	fieldName  FieldName OPTIONAL,
	fileName   FileName OPTIONAL,
	callType  CallType OPTIONAL
}
RecordNumber ::= [APPLICATION 402] INTEGER
FileErrorCode ::= [APPLICATION 403]  SEQUENCE OF INTEGER
FieldName ::= [APPLICATION 404] AsciiString
FileName ::= [APPLICATION 405] AsciiString
CallType ::= ENUMERATED 
{
		 moc (0),
		 mtc (1),
		 gprs (2)
}
--
-- NRTRDE individual data items
--
AccessPointNameNI ::= [APPLICATION 16] AsciiString (SIZE(1..63))
AccessPointNameOI ::= [APPLICATION 17] AsciiString (SIZE(1..37))
BearerServiceCode ::= [APPLICATION 18] HexString (SIZE(2))

CallEventStartTimeStamp ::= [APPLICATION 21] NumberString (SIZE(14))
CallingNumber ::= [APPLICATION 22] NumberString
CallReference ::= [APPLICATION 23] INTEGER (CODE("DEC"))

CellId ::= [APPLICATION 47] INTEGER (CODE("DEC"))
ChargeAmount ::= [APPLICATION 25] INTEGER (CODE("DEC"))
ChargingId ::= [APPLICATION 26] INTEGER (CODE("DEC"))
ConnectedNumber ::= [APPLICATION 27] NumberString
DataVolumeIncoming ::= [APPLICATION 28] INTEGER (CODE("DEC"))
DataVolumeOutgoing ::= [APPLICATION 29] INTEGER (CODE("DEC"))
DialledDigits ::= [APPLICATION 30] AsciiString
GgsnAddress ::= [APPLICATION 32] AsciiString
Imei ::= [APPLICATION 33] BCDString (SIZE(7..8))
Imsi ::= [APPLICATION 34] BCDString (SIZE(3..8))
LocationArea ::= [APPLICATION 48] INTEGER (CODE("DEC"))
Msisdn ::= [APPLICATION 49] BCDString (SIZE(1..8))
RecEntityId ::= [APPLICATION 35] AsciiString

ServiceCode ::= [APPLICATION 46] EXPLICIT CHOICE
{
teleServiceCode TeleServiceCode OPTIONAL,
bearerServiceCode BearerServiceCode OPTIONAL
}

ServingNetwork ::= [APPLICATION 15] AsciiString
SgsnAddress ::= [APPLICATION 40] AsciiString
SupplementaryServiceCode ::= [APPLICATION 42] HexString (SIZE(2))
TeleServiceCode ::= [APPLICATION 43] HexString (SIZE(2))
ThirdPartyNumber ::= [APPLICATION 44] NumberString
UtcTimeOffset ::= [APPLICATION 45] AsciiString (SIZE(5))

--
-- Local timestamps are noted in the format
--
-- CCYYMMDDhhmmss
--

}

}

{-- Intentionally left blank since no CDR trailer is used
}
BlockTrailer ::= SEQUENCE
{-- Intentionally left blank since no Block trailer is used
}

{
reportIdentification ReportIdentification,

vpmn VPMN,
sequenceNumber SequenceNumber,
reportCreationTime ReportCreationTime,
reportPeriodStartTime ReportPeriodStartTime,

}

{

	fileName   FileName,

FileName ::=[APPLICATION 12] IA5String (SIZE(19))

NumberOfRecords ::=[APPLICATION 15] INTEGER (CODE("DEC"))

name: MMTelChargingDataTypes_eski
contents:
--********************************************************************************
--      File          : MMTelChargingDataTypes.asn1
--      Date          : 02-12-2019
--      Created By    : tcftepekoy
--
-- DESCRIPTION:
--             Parses Mavenir TAS Cdrs
--             Using  Flows : TAS Flow
-- ********************************************************************************
--             Update Comments :
--             <DD-MM-YYYY> - <DEV. USER NAME> - <PPM/FT Id> : <Change Comments>
-- ********************************************************************************

MMTelChargingDataTypes_eski {itu-t (0) identified-organization (4) etsi(0) mobileDomain (0) charging (5) mMTelChargingDataTypes (9) asn1Module (0) version1 (0)}

DEFINITIONS IMPLICIT TAGS	::=

BEGIN

-- EXPORTS everything 

MMTelServiceRecord ::= CHOICE
{
    mMTelRecord  [83]    MMTelRecord,
    sCIRecord    [999]  MMTelRecord
}


MMTelRecord ::= SET
{
	recordType	[0] RecordType,
	sIP-Method	[2] SIP-Method OPTIONAL,
	role-of-Node	[3] Role-of-Node OPTIONAL,
	nodeAddress	[4] EXPLICIT NodeAddress OPTIONAL,
	session-Id	[5] Session-Id OPTIONAL,
	list-Of-Calling-Party-Address	[6] ListOfInvolvedParties OPTIONAL,	
	called-Party-Address	[7] EXPLICIT InvolvedParty OPTIONAL,
	serviceRequestTimeStamp	[9] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	serviceDeliveryStartTimeStamp	[10] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	serviceDeliveryEndTimeStamp	[11] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	recordOpeningTime	[12] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	recordClosureTime	[13] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	interOperatorIdentifiers	[14] InterOperatorIdentifierlist OPTIONAL,
	localRecordSequenceNumber	[15] LocalSequenceNumber OPTIONAL,
    recordSequenceNumber	[16] RecordSequenceNumber OPTIONAL,
	causeForRecordClosing	[17] CauseForRecordClosing OPTIONAL,
	iMS-Charging-Identifier	[19] IMS-Charging-Identifier OPTIONAL,
	list-Of-SDP-Media-Components	[21] SEQUENCE OF Media-Components-List OPTIONAL,
	serviceReasonReturnCode	[23] UTF8String OPTIONAL,
	recordExtensions	[25] ManagementExtensions OPTIONAL,
	accessNetworkInformation	[29] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
	serviceContextID	[30] ServiceContextID OPTIONAL,
	list-of-subscription-ID	[31] SEQUENCE OF SubscriptionID OPTIONAL, 
	list-Of-Early-SDP-Media-Components	[32] SEQUENCE OF Early-Media-Components-List OPTIONAL,
    numberPortabilityRouting	[34] NumberPortabilityRouting OPTIONAL,
	sessionPriority	[36] SessionPriority OPTIONAL,
	serviceRequestTimeStampFraction	[37] Milliseconds OPTIONAL,
	serviceDeliveryStartTimeStampFraction	[38] Milliseconds OPTIONAL,
	serviceDeliveryEndTimeStampFraction	[39] Milliseconds OPTIONAL,
	online-charging-flag				 [43] NULL OPTIONAL,
	userLocationInformation	[47] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
	servedPartyIPAddress				[50] EXPLICIT ServedPartyIPAddress OPTIONAL,
	iMSEmergencyIndicator			[52] NULL OPTIONAL,
	listOfReasonHeader	[55] ListOfReasonHeader OPTIONAL,
	additionalAccessNetworkInformation	[56] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
    instanceId	[57] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
	requested-Party-Address	[101] EXPLICIT InvolvedParty OPTIONAL,
	list-Of-Called-Asserted-Identity 	[102] ListOfInvolvedParties OPTIONAL,
	outgoingSessionId 	[104] Session-Id OPTIONAL,
	list-Of-AccessTransferInformation	[106] SEQUENCE OF AccessTransferInformation OPTIONAL,
	mMTelInformation	[110] MMTelInformation	OPTIONAL,
	routeHeaderReceived[59] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL
}

RecordType ::= INTEGER 
{ 
--
-- Record Value 83 is MMTel specific. The contents are defined in TS 32.275 [35]
--
	mMTelRecord (83),
        sciRecord   (999)
}

LocalSequenceNumber ::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)
--
-- Sequence number of the record in this node
-- 0.. 4294967295 is equivalent to 0..232-1, unsigned integer in four octets
--

RecordSequenceNumber ::= INTEGER (1..4294967295)
--
-- Sequence number of the partial record for a given session
-- 1.. 4294967295 is equivalent to 20..232-1, unsigned integer in four octets
--

IPAddress ::= CHOICE
{
	iPBinaryAddress	IPBinaryAddress,
	iPTextRepresentedAddress	IPTextRepresentedAddress
}

IPBinaryAddress ::= CHOICE
{
	iPBinV4Address	[0] OCTET STRING (SIZE(4)),
	iPBinV6Address	[1] OCTET STRING (SIZE(16))
}

IPTextRepresentedAddress ::= CHOICE
{--
-- IP address in the familiar "dot" notation
--
	iPTextV4Address	[2] IA5String (SIZE(7..15)),
	iPTextV6Address	[3] IA5String (SIZE(15..45))
}

NodeAddress ::= CHOICE 
{
	iPAddress 	[0] EXPLICIT IPAddress,
	domainName	[1] GraphicString
}

ServiceContextID		::= UTF8String

ServedPartyIPAddress  ::=  IPAddress

NumberPortabilityRouting ::= GraphicString

PriorityCallType	::=ENUMERATED
{
	gets-fc 	(0),
	gets-an 	(1),
	gets-nt 	(2),
	gets-fc-an 	(3),
	gets-fc-nt 	(4),
	others 	(5)
}


SessionPriority ::= ENUMERATED
--
-- PRIORITY-4 is the highest priority and Priority-0 is the lowest priority.
--
{
 pRIORITY-0 (0),
 pRIORITY-1 (1),
 pRIORITY-2 (2),
 pRIORITY-3 (3),
 pRIORITY-4 (4)
}


Milliseconds ::= INTEGER (0..999)

SubscriptionID	::= SET
{
	subscriptionIDType	[0] SubscriptionIDType,
	subscriptionIDData	[1] UTF8String
}

{
	eND-USER-E164	(0),
	eND-USER-IMSI	(1),
	eND-USER-SIP-URI	(2),
	eND-USER-NAI	(3),
	eND-USER-PRIVATE	(4)
}

TimeStamp ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(9))
--
-- The contents of this field are a compact form of the UTCTime format
-- containing local time plus an offset to universal time. Binary coded
-- decimal encoding is employed for the digits to reduce the storage and
-- transmission overhead, e.g. YYMMDDhhmmssShhmm, where
-- YY = Year 00 to 99	BCD encoded
-- MM = Month 01 to 12 	BCD encoded
-- DD = Day 01 to 31	BCD encoded
-- hh = hour 00 to 23	BCD encoded
-- mm = minute 00 to 59	BCD encoded
-- ss = second 00 to 59	BCD encoded
-- S  = Sign 0 = "+", "-"	ASCII encoded
-- hh = hour 00 to 23	BCD encoded
-- mm = minute 00 to 59	BCD encoded

{

}

IN-AMA-EXT-Type ::= SEQUENCE
{
	recordType			[0] INTEGER,
	callTransactionType 		[1] INTEGER,
	chargedPartyId			[2] IA5String (SIZE (1..16)) OPTIONAL,
	chargingTimeData		[3] ChargingTimeDataType OPTIONAL,
	timeQuality			[4] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	mSCID                           [5] OCTET STRING  (SIZE (2..12)),
	otherParty			[6] OCTET STRING  (SIZE(12)) OPTIONAL,
	basicService			[7] OCTET STRING (SIZE (1)) OPTIONAL,
	callingPartyNumber		[8] OCTET STRING  (SIZE (2..12)),
	cAMELDestinationNumber		[9] OCTET STRING  (SIZE (3..12)) OPTIONAL,
	correlationId			[10] OCTET STRING (SIZE(3)) OPTIONAL,
	chargeInfos			[11] OCTET STRING (SIZE (1..40)) OPTIONAL,
	serviceKey			[12] INTEGER,
	call-Type-Status    [13] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	destination-Type    [14] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	defaultCallHandling	[15] DefaultCallHandling OPTIONAL,
        dchOverideForINIW [16] DchOverideType OPTIONAL
}

DefaultCallHandling ::= ENUMERATED 
{
    continueCall (0) ,
    releaseCall (1) 
}
-- exception handling:
-- reception of values in range 2-31 shall be treated as "continueCall"
-- reception of values greater than 31 shall be treated as "releaseCall"

Epf3Service ::= SET
{
    imsi   [3] GraphicString OPTIONAL,
    primary-imsi    [9] GraphicString OPTIONAL
}

ChargingTimeDataType ::= SEQUENCE
{
	inStartOfChargingDate		[0] OCTET STRING (SIZE (3)),
	inStartOfChargingTime		[1] InStartOfChargingTimeType,
	inCallDuration   		[2] INTEGER
}

InStartOfChargingTimeType	::= SET
{
	inTimeStamp		[0] OCTET STRING,
	inTimeStamp2		[1] OCTET STRING
}

-- IN Start Charging Date
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- octets BCD coded
-- yy: year (2 digits)
-- mm: month (2 digits)
-- dd: day (2 digits)
-- example: march 14th. 1997 coded as '970314'
--

-- IN TimeStamp1
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- granularity of seconds, fractions of second are simply cut off
-- octets BCD coded
-- hh: hour (2 digits)
-- mm: minutes (2 digits)
-- ss: seconds (2 digits)
-- example: 08:27:56 coded as '082756'
--

-- IN TimeStamp2
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- octets BCD coded
-- hh: hour (2 digits)
-- mm: minutes (2 digits)
-- ss: seconds (4 digits)
-- example: 08:27:56,4 coded as '08275640'

-- MSC ID
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Signalling Point Code (SPC) Of The MSC
-- 
-- only 14 bits are relevant, the least significant 2 bits are set to 0.
-- Example: SPC = 03 - 5 - 01 - 0
-- 14 bit: 0011 101 0001 000
-- 16 bit: 0011 101 0001 000 00
-- Nibbles: 0011 1010 0010 0000
-- 2 Byte coding: 3 A 2 0

-- Other Party
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Octet 1 like octect 3 in 3GPP TS 24.008 CalledPartyBCDNumber
-- Ext. bit , type of number , number plan 
-- Subsequent octets: Digits coded as TBCD-String
-- Default value:
-- Octet 1: 	H'80
-- Subsequent octets:	H'FF

-- Basic Service
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- identical to ISDN Basic Service
-- 
-- aLL-SERVICES ISDNBasicService::= '00'H
-- sPEECH ISDNBasicService::= '01'H
-- uNRESTRICTED ISDNBasicService::= '02'H
-- aUDIO-3K1HZ ISDNBasicService::= '03'H
-- tELEPHONY-3K1HZ ISDNBasicService::= '20'H
-- tELETEXT ISDNBasicService::= '21'H
-- tELEFAX-GROUP-4 ISDNBasicService::= '22'H
-- vIDEOTEXT ISDNBasicService::= '23'H
-- vIDEOTEL ISDNBasicService::= '24'H
-- tELEFAX-GROUP-23 ISDNBasicService::= '25'H
-- tELEPHONY-7KHZ ISDNBasicService::= '26'H

-- Calling Party Number
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- content according ITU Q.763
--
-- address string, coded as specified by Q.763
-- First octet
-- BIT 8 (msb): Odd/Even indicator
-- BIT 7-1 : Nature Of Address indicator
-- Second octet
-- BIT 8 (msb): Calling party incomplete indicator
-- BIT 7-5 : Numbering Plan indicator
-- BIT 4-3 : Presentation indicator
-- BIT 2-1 : Screening
-- Following octets:
-- max. 16 octets (32 digits), each octet coded as:
-- BIT 8-5 : Address Signal 2n
-- BIT 4-1 : Address Signal 2n-1

-- Address signal
-- 0 0 0 0 digit 0
-- 0 0 0 1 digit 1
-- 0 0 1 0 digit 2
-- 0 0 1 1 digit 3
-- 0 1 0 0 digit 4
-- 0 1 0 1 digit 5
-- 0 1 1 0 digit 6
-- 0 1 1 1 digit 7
-- 1 0 0 0 digit 8
-- 1 0 0 1 digit 9
-- 1 0 1 0 spare
-- 1 0 1 1 code 11
-- 1 1 0 0 code 12
-- 1 1 0 1 spare
--    to
-- 1 1 1 1 spare

-- Spare bits are coded 0 unless indicated otherwise
-- CAMEL Destination Number
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- content according 3G TS 24.008
-- coded as specified in Q.763

-- First octet 
-- BIT 8 (msb): Odd/Even indicator 
-- BIT 7-1 : Nature Of Address indicator
-- Second octet
-- BIT 8 (msb): Internal Network Number indicator (INN ind.)
-- BIT 7-5 : Numbering Plan indicator
-- BIT 4-1 : spare
-- Following octets:
-- max. 16 octets (32 digits), each octet coded as:
-- BIT 8-5 : Address Signal 2n
-- BIT 4-1 : Address Signal 2n-1
-- Spare bits are coded 0 unless indicated otherwise.

-- Correlation ID
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- fixed length of 3 Bytes

-- Charging Infos
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- FCI Transparent Data 


Charging-Function-Address ::= SEQUENCE
{
	ccf		[0] SEQUENCE OF NodeAddress OPTIONAL,
	ecf		[1] SEQUENCE OF NodeAddress OPTIONAL
}

-- Refers to International Mobile Station Equipment Identity

-- digit 0 and a filler.
-- If present the SVN shall be included in the last octet.

-- ********************************************************************************

{

  	{

 	 }
}


PreMMSCdr	::= SEQUENCE
{

	inStartOfChargingDate		[0] OCTET STRING (SIZE (3)),
	inStartOfChargingTime		[1] InStartOfChargingTimeType,
	inCallDuration   		[2] INTEGER
}

InStartOfChargingTimeType	::= SET
{
	inTimeStamp		[0] OCTET STRING,
	inTimeStamp2		[1] OCTET STRING
}

-- IN Start Charging Date
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- octets BCD coded
-- yy: year (2 digits)
-- mm: month (2 digits)
-- dd: day (2 digits)
-- example: march 14th. 1997 coded as '970314'
--

-- IN TimeStamp1
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- granularity of seconds, fractions of second are simply cut off
-- octets BCD coded
-- hh: hour (2 digits)
-- mm: minutes (2 digits)
-- ss: seconds (2 digits)
-- example: 08:27:56 coded as '082756'
--

-- IN TimeStamp2
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- octets BCD coded
-- hh: hour (2 digits)
-- mm: minutes (2 digits)
-- ss: seconds (4 digits)
-- example: 08:27:56,4 coded as '08275640'

-- MSC ID
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Signalling Point Code (SPC) Of The MSC
-- 
-- only 14 bits are relevant, the least significant 2 bits are set to 0.
-- Example: SPC = 03 - 5 - 01 - 0
-- 14 bit: 0011 101 0001 000
-- 16 bit: 0011 101 0001 000 00
-- Nibbles: 0011 1010 0010 0000
-- 2 Byte coding: 3 A 2 0

-- Other Party
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Octet 1 like octect 3 in 3GPP TS 24.008 CalledPartyBCDNumber
-- Ext. bit , type of number , number plan 
-- Subsequent octets: Digits coded as TBCD-String
-- Default value:
-- Octet 1: 	H'80
-- Subsequent octets:	H'FF

-- Basic Service
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- identical to ISDN Basic Service
-- 
-- aLL-SERVICES ISDNBasicService::= '00'H
-- sPEECH ISDNBasicService::= '01'H
-- uNRESTRICTED ISDNBasicService::= '02'H
-- aUDIO-3K1HZ ISDNBasicService::= '03'H
-- tELEPHONY-3K1HZ ISDNBasicService::= '20'H
-- tELETEXT ISDNBasicService::= '21'H
-- tELEFAX-GROUP-4 ISDNBasicService::= '22'H
-- vIDEOTEXT ISDNBasicService::= '23'H
-- vIDEOTEL ISDNBasicService::= '24'H
-- tELEFAX-GROUP-23 ISDNBasicService::= '25'H
-- tELEPHONY-7KHZ ISDNBasicService::= '26'H

-- Calling Party Number
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- content according ITU Q.763
--
-- address string, coded as specified by Q.763
-- First octet
-- BIT 8 (msb): Odd/Even indicator
-- BIT 7-1 : Nature Of Address indicator
-- Second octet
-- BIT 8 (msb): Calling party incomplete indicator
-- BIT 7-5 : Numbering Plan indicator
-- BIT 4-3 : Presentation indicator
-- BIT 2-1 : Screening
-- Following octets:
-- max. 16 octets (32 digits), each octet coded as:
-- BIT 8-5 : Address Signal 2n
-- BIT 4-1 : Address Signal 2n-1

-- Address signal
-- 0 0 0 0 digit 0
-- 0 0 0 1 digit 1
-- 0 0 1 0 digit 2
-- 0 0 1 1 digit 3
-- 0 1 0 0 digit 4
-- 0 1 0 1 digit 5
-- 0 1 1 0 digit 6
-- 0 1 1 1 digit 7
-- 1 0 0 0 digit 8
-- 1 0 0 1 digit 9
-- 1 0 1 0 spare
-- 1 0 1 1 code 11
-- 1 1 0 0 code 12
-- 1 1 0 1 spare
--    to
-- 1 1 1 1 spare

-- Spare bits are coded 0 unless indicated otherwise
-- CAMEL Destination Number
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- content according 3G TS 24.008
-- coded as specified in Q.763

-- First octet 
-- BIT 8 (msb): Odd/Even indicator 
-- BIT 7-1 : Nature Of Address indicator
-- Second octet
-- BIT 8 (msb): Internal Network Number indicator (INN ind.)
-- BIT 7-5 : Numbering Plan indicator
-- BIT 4-1 : spare
-- Following octets:
-- max. 16 octets (32 digits), each octet coded as:
-- BIT 8-5 : Address Signal 2n
-- BIT 4-1 : Address Signal 2n-1
-- Spare bits are coded 0 unless indicated otherwise.

-- Correlation ID
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- fixed length of 3 Bytes

-- Charging Infos
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- FCI Transparent Data 


Charging-Function-Address ::= SEQUENCE
{
	ccf		[0] SEQUENCE OF NodeAddress OPTIONAL,

-- digit 0 and a filler.
-- If present the SVN shall be included in the last octet.

    mT-Epsfb        (8),

name: NRTRDEINFLOWV0201
contents:
-- ********************************************************************** 
-- The following ASN.1 specification defines the abstract syntax for
--
-- NRTRDE Version 2.1
--
-- The specification is structured as follows:
-- (1) structure of the NRTRDE record
-- (2) definition of the individual Call Events
-- (3) data items and groups of data items used within (2)
-- (4) common, non-NRTRDE data types
--
-- It is mainly a translation from the logical structure
-- diagrams. Where appropriate, names used within the
-- logical structure diagrams have been shortened.
--      File : NRTRDEINV0201.asn1
--      No.  : GSMA TD.35 v 8.5 
--      Date : 2012-05-16
--      Rev  : A
-- ********************************************************************** 
NRTRDEINFLOWV0201 DEFINITIONS IMPLICIT TAGS ::=
BEGIN
--
-- Structure of a NRTRDE record
--
NrtrdeFile  ::= CHOICE
{
		nrtrde   Nrtrde,
		berError   BERError
}

BERError ::= [APPLICATION 355] SEQUENCE
{
	errorCode  ErrorCode OPTIONAL,
	tagNumber  TagNumber OPTIONAL,
	realvalueName RealvalueName OPTIONAL
}
RealvalueName ::= [APPLICATION 356] AsciiString
TagNumber ::= [APPLICATION 357] INTEGER
ErrorCode ::= ENUMERATED 
{
		  decodingError (0),
		 invalidTag (1),
		 encodingError (2),
		unknownTag (3)
}

ValidationError ::= [APPLICATION 401] SEQUENCE
{
	recordNumber  RecordNumber OPTIONAL,
	fileErrorCode  FileErrorCode OPTIONAL,
	fieldName  FieldName OPTIONAL,
	fileName   FileName OPTIONAL,
	callType  CallType OPTIONAL
	
}
RecordNumber ::= [APPLICATION 402] INTEGER
FileErrorCode ::= [APPLICATION 403]  SEQUENCE OF INTEGER
FieldName ::= [APPLICATION 404] AsciiString
FileName ::= [APPLICATION 405] AsciiString
CallType ::= ENUMERATED 
{
		 moc (0),
		 mtc (1),
		 gprs (2)
}

Nrtrde ::= [APPLICATION 1] SEQUENCE
{
		specificationVersionNumber SpecificationVersionNumber OPTIONAL,
		releaseVersionNumber ReleaseVersionNumber OPTIONAL, 
		sender Sender OPTIONAL, 
		recipient Recipient OPTIONAL, 
		sequenceNumber SequenceNumber OPTIONAL,
		fileAvailableTimeStamp FileAvailableTimeStamp OPTIONAL, 
		utcTimeOffset UtcTimeOffset OPTIONAL, 
		callEvents CallEventList OPTIONAL,
		callEventsCount CallEventsCount OPTIONAL,
		fileValidationError ValidationError  OPTIONAL 
}
CallEventList ::= [APPLICATION 2] SEQUENCE OF CallEvent
CallEvent ::= CHOICE
{
		moc Moc,
		mtc Mtc,
		gprs Gprs

}
--
-- Structure of the individual NRTRDE call events
-- Note: The Basic Call Information and Optional Call Information Groups
-- are not present in the physical structure, rather
-- they have been expanded into MOC, MTC and GPRS respectively.
--
Moc ::= [APPLICATION 3] SEQUENCE
{
		imsi Imsi OPTIONAL, 
		imei Imei OPTIONAL,
		callEventStartTimeStamp CallEventStartTimeStamp OPTIONAL, 
		utcTimeOffset UtcTimeOffset OPTIONAL,
		callEventDuration CallEventDuration OPTIONAL, 
		causeForTermination CauseForTermination OPTIONAL, 
		serviceCode ServiceCode OPTIONAL, 
		supplementaryServiceCode SupplementaryServiceCode OPTIONAL,
		dialledDigits DialledDigits OPTIONAL,
		connectedNumber ConnectedNumber OPTIONAL,
		thirdPartyNumber ThirdPartyNumber OPTIONAL,
		recEntityId RecEntityId OPTIONAL, 
		callReference CallReference OPTIONAL,
		chargeAmount ChargeAmount OPTIONAL,
		servingNetwork ServingNetwork OPTIONAL,
		msisdn Msisdn OPTIONAL,
		locationArea LocationArea OPTIONAL,
		cellId CellId OPTIONAL,
		validationError ValidationError  OPTIONAL
}
Mtc ::= [APPLICATION 4] SEQUENCE
{
		imsi Imsi OPTIONAL, 
		imei Imei OPTIONAL,
		callEventStartTimeStamp CallEventStartTimeStamp OPTIONAL,
		utcTimeOffset UtcTimeOffset OPTIONAL, 
		callEventDuration CallEventDuration OPTIONAL, 
		causeForTermination CauseForTermination OPTIONAL, 
		serviceCode ServiceCode OPTIONAL, 
		callingNumber CallingNumber OPTIONAL,
		recEntityId RecEntityId OPTIONAL, 
		callReference CallReference OPTIONAL,
		chargeAmount ChargeAmount OPTIONAL,
		servingNetwork ServingNetwork OPTIONAL,
		msisdn Msisdn OPTIONAL,
		locationArea LocationArea OPTIONAL,
		cellId CellId OPTIONAL,
		validationError ValidationError  OPTIONAL
}
Gprs ::= [APPLICATION 5] SEQUENCE
{
		imsi Imsi OPTIONAL,
		imei Imei OPTIONAL,
		callEventStartTimeStamp CallEventStartTimeStamp OPTIONAL, 
		utcTimeOffset UtcTimeOffset OPTIONAL,
		callEventDuration CallEventDuration OPTIONAL, 
		causeForTermination CauseForTermination OPTIONAL, 
		accessPointNameNI AccessPointNameNI OPTIONAL, 
		accessPointNameOI AccessPointNameOI OPTIONAL,
		dataVolumeIncoming DataVolumeIncoming OPTIONAL, 
		dataVolumeOutgoing DataVolumeOutgoing OPTIONAL, 
		sgsnAddress SgsnAddress OPTIONAL,
		ggsnAddress GgsnAddress OPTIONAL, 
		chargingId ChargingId OPTIONAL,
		chargeAmount ChargeAmount OPTIONAL,
		servingNetwork ServingNetwork OPTIONAL,
		msisdn Msisdn OPTIONAL,
		locationArea LocationArea OPTIONAL,
		cellId CellId OPTIONAL,
		validationError ValidationError  OPTIONAL
}
		AccessPointNameNI ::= [APPLICATION 16] AsciiString --(SIZE(1..63))
		AccessPointNameOI ::= [APPLICATION 17] AsciiString --(SIZE(1..37))
		BearerServiceCode ::= [APPLICATION 18] HexString --(SIZE(2))
		CallEventDuration ::= [APPLICATION 19] INTEGER
		CallEventsCount ::= [APPLICATION 20] INTEGER
		CallEventStartTimeStamp ::= [APPLICATION 21] NumberString --(SIZE(14))
		CallingNumber ::= [APPLICATION 22] NumberString
		CallReference ::= [APPLICATION 23] INTEGER
		CauseForTermination ::= [APPLICATION 24] INTEGER
		CellId ::= [APPLICATION 47] INTEGER
		ChargeAmount ::= [APPLICATION 25] INTEGER
		ChargingId ::= [APPLICATION 26] INTEGER
		ConnectedNumber ::= [APPLICATION 27] NumberString
		DataVolumeIncoming ::= [APPLICATION 28] INTEGER
		DataVolumeOutgoing ::= [APPLICATION 29] INTEGER
		DialledDigits ::= [APPLICATION 30] AsciiString
		FileAvailableTimeStamp ::= [APPLICATION 31] NumberString --(SIZE(14))
		GgsnAddress ::= [APPLICATION 32] AsciiString
		Imei ::= [APPLICATION 33] BCDString --(SIZE(7..8))
		Imsi ::= [APPLICATION 34] BCDString --(SIZE(3..8))
		LocationArea ::= [APPLICATION 48] INTEGER
		Msisdn ::= [APPLICATION 49] BCDString --(SIZE(1..8))
		RecEntityId ::= [APPLICATION 35] AsciiString
		Recipient ::= [APPLICATION 36] AsciiString --(SIZE(5))
		ReleaseVersionNumber ::= [APPLICATION 37] INTEGER
		Sender ::= [APPLICATION 38] AsciiString --(SIZE(5))
		SequenceNumber ::= [APPLICATION 39] NumberString --(SIZE(7))
		
ServiceCode ::= [APPLICATION 46] EXPLICIT CHOICE
{
		teleServiceCode TeleServiceCode,
		bearerServiceCode BearerServiceCode
}
ServingNetwork ::= [APPLICATION 15] AsciiString
SgsnAddress ::= [APPLICATION 40] AsciiString
SpecificationVersionNumber ::= [APPLICATION 41] INTEGER
SupplementaryServiceCode ::= [APPLICATION 42] HexString --(SIZE(2))
TeleServiceCode ::= [APPLICATION 43] HexString --(SIZE(2))
ThirdPartyNumber ::= [APPLICATION 44] NumberString
UtcTimeOffset ::= [APPLICATION 45] AsciiString --(SIZE(5))

--
-- Local timestamps are noted in the format
--
-- CCYYMMDDhhmmss
--
-- where CC = century ('20',...)
-- YY = year ('00' - '99')
-- MM = month ('01', '02', ... , '12')
-- DD = day ('01', '02', ... , '31')
-- hh = hour ('00', '01', ... , '23')
-- mm = minutes ('00', '01', ... , '59')
-- ss = seconds ('00', '01', ... , '59')
--
--
-- Non-tagged common data types
--
--
-- Recommended common data types to be used for encoding:
--
-- The following definitions should be used for NRTRDE record creation
-- instead of the default specifications (OCTET STRING)
--
-- AsciiString ::= VisibleString
--
-- HexString ::= VisibleString
--
-- NumberString ::= NumericString
--
AsciiString ::= OCTET STRING
HexString ::= OCTET STRING
NumberString ::= OCTET STRING
--
-- The BCDString data type (Binary Coded Decimal String) is used to
-- represent several digits from 0 through 9, a, b, c, d, e
-- two digits per octet, f as filler when there is an odd number
-- of digits.
--
BCDString ::= OCTET STRING
END

	recordOpeningTime	[16]  TimeStamp	OPTIONAL,
	duration		[17]  CallDuration	OPTIONAL,
	sgsnChange		[18]  SGSNChange	OPTIONAL,
	causeForRecClosing	[19]  CauseForRecClosing	OPTIONAL,
	diagnostics		[20]  EXPLICIT Diagnostics	OPTIONAL,
	recordSequenceNumber	[21]  INTEGER		OPTIONAL,
	nodeID		[22]  IA5String		OPTIONAL,
	recordExtensions	[23]  ManagementExtensions	OPTIONAL,
	listOfTrafficVolumes	[15]  SEQUENCE OF ChangeOfCharCondition  OPTIONAL,
	servedPDPAddress	[14]  EXPLICIT PDPAddress	OPTIONAL,
	subscriptionType	[230] IMPLICIT INTEGER	OPTIONAL,

	inRatedAmount		[220] IMPLICIT INTEGER	OPTIONAL,
	balanceBeforeCDRProcessing	[211] IMPLICIT MoneyAmount	OPTIONAL,
	balanceAfterCDRProcessing	[212] IMPLICIT MoneyAmount	OPTIONAL,
	eventCost		[213] IMPLICIT MoneyAmount	OPTIONAL,
	surplusDebit		[214] IMPLICIT MoneyAmount	OPTIONAL,
	accumulator1StartValue	[119] INTEGER		OPTIONAL,
	accumulator2StartValue	[120] INTEGER		OPTIONAL,
	accumulator3StartValue	[121] INTEGER		OPTIONAL,
	accumulator4StartValue	[122] INTEGER		OPTIONAL,
	accumulator5StartValue	[123] INTEGER		OPTIONAL,
	updatedAccumulatorID	[124] INTEGER		OPTIONAL,
	accumulatorDeltaValue	[125] INTEGER		OPTIONAL,
	dedicatedAccountID	[126] INTEGER		OPTIONAL,
	dedicatedAccountValueBeforeCall  [127] MoneyAmount	OPTIONAL,
	dedicatedAccountValueAfterCall	     [128] MoneyAmount	OPTIONAL
}

	accumulator4StartValue	[22] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	accumulator5StartValue	[23] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	updatedAccumulatorID	[24] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	accumulatorDeltaValue	[25] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	dedicatedAccountID	[26] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	dedicatedAccountValueBeforeCall  [27] MoneyAmount OPTIONAL,
	dedicatedAccountValueAfterCall	      [28] MoneyAmount OPTIONAL
}

Date ::= IA5String (SIZE (8))
Time ::= IA5String (SIZE (6))

RecordType ::= ENUMERATED {
	mobileOriginating (1),
	mobileTerminating (2),
	callForwarding (3),
	mobileOriginatingSMSinSMSC (4),
	mobileTerminatingSMSinSMSC (5),
	gprsCDR (6),
	mobileOriginatingSMSinGPRS (7),
	mobileTerminatingSMSinGPRS (8),

}

{
        moCallRecord	(0),
        mtCallRecord	(1),
        roamingRecord	(2),
        incGatewayRecord	(3),
        outGatewayRecord	(4),
        transitCallRecord	(5),
        moSMSRecord	(6),
        mtSMSRecord	(7),
        moSMSIWRecord	(8),
        mtSMSGWRecord	(9),
        ssActionRecord	(10),
        hlrIntRecord	(11),
        termCAMELIntRecord	(12),
        locUpdateHLRRecord	(13),
        locUpdateVLRRecord	(14),
        commonEquipRecord	(15),
        moTraceRecord	(16),
        mtTraceRecord	(17),
        sgsnPDPRecord	(18),
        ggsnPDPRecord	(19),
        sgsnMMRecord	(20),
        sgsnSMORecord	(21),
        sgsnSMTRecord	(22)
}

        normalRelease	(0),
        abnormalRelease	(4),

        maxChangeCond	(19),
        managementIntervention	(20)
}

        --
        -- used in PDP context record only
        --
{
        qosRequested	 [1] QoSInformation OPTIONAL,
        qosNegotiated	 [2] QoSInformation OPTIONAL,
        dataVolumeGPRSUplink	 [3] DataVolumeGPRS OPTIONAL,
        dataVolumeGPRSDownlink	 [4] DataVolumeGPRS OPTIONAL,

        changeTime	 [6] TimeStamp OPTIONAL

DataVolumeGPRS  ::= INTEGER

Diagnostics ::= CHOICE
{
        gsm0408Cause	[0] INTEGER,
        gsm0902MapErrorValue	[1] INTEGER,
        ccittQ767Cause	[2] INTEGER,
        networkSpecificCause	[3] ManagementExtension,
        manufacturerSpecificCause [4] ManagementExtension
}

ETSIAddress     ::= AddressString

GSNAddress      ::= IPAddress

IMSI ::= TBCD STRING (SIZE (6..16))

IMEI ::= TBCD STRING (SIZE (8))

IPAddress       ::= CHOICE
{
        iPBinaryAddress	   IPBinaryAddress,
        iPTextRepresentedAddress	   IPTextRepresentedAddress
}

IPBinaryAddress ::= CHOICE
{
        iPBinV4Address                  [0] OCTET STRING (SIZE(4)),
        iPBinV6Address                  [1] OCTET STRING (SIZE(16))
}

IPTextRepresentedAddress        ::= CHOICE
{       --
        -- IP address in the familiar "dot" notation
        --
        iPTextV4Address                 [2] IA5String (SIZE(7..15)),
        iPTextV6Address                 [3] IA5String (SIZE(15..45))
}

LocationAreaCode ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))

ManagementExtension ::= NULL

        iPAddress		[0] EXPLICIT IPAddress,

PDPType	::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))

{
        --
        -- See Quality of service TS GSM 04.08
        --
        delayClass1                             (0),
        delayClass2                             (1),
        delayClass3                             (2),
        delayClass4                             (3)
}

QoSInformation  ::=SEQUENCE
{
        reliability		[0] QoSReliability,
        delay		[1] QoSDelay,
        precedence	[2] QoSPrecedence,

        meanThroughput	[4] QoSMeanThroughput
}

QoSMeanThroughput       ::= ENUMERATED
{
        --
        -- See Quality of service TS GSM 04.08
        --
        bestEffort		(0),
        mean100octetPh	(1),
        mean200octetPh	(2),
        mean500octetPh	(3),
        mean1000octetPh	(4),
        mean2000octetPh	(5),
        mean5000octetPh	(6),
        mean10000octetPh	(7),
        mean20000octetPh	(8),
        mean50000octetPh	(9),
        mean100000octetPh	(10),
        mean200000octetPh	(11),
        mean500000octetPh	(12),
        mean1000000octetPh	(13),
        mean2000000octetPh	(14),
        mean5000000octetPh	(15),
        mean10000000octetPh	(16),
        mean20000000octetPh	(17),
        mean50000000octetPh	(18)

QoSPeakThroughput       ::= ENUMERATED
{
        --
        -- See Quality of service TS GSM 04.08
        --
        unspecified	(0),
        upTo100OctetPs	(1),
        upTo200OctetPs	(2),
        upTo400OctetPs	(3),
        upTo800OctetPs	(4),
        upTo1600OctetPs	(5),
        upTo3200OctetPs	(6),
        upTo6400OctetPs	(7),
        upTo12800OctetPs	(8),
        upTo25600OctetPs	(9)

QoSPrecedence   ::= ENUMERATED

        -- See Quality of service TS GSM 04.08

QoSReliability  ::= ENUMERATED

        -- See Quality of service TS GSM 04.08

        unackGTPAcknowLLC	(2),
        unackGTPLLCAcknowRLC	(3),
        unackGTPLLCRLC	(4),
        unacknowUnprotectedData	(5)

RoutingAreaCode ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(1))

name: CiscoGGSNCdrR7
contents:
-- ********************************************************************************
--      File                  : CiscoGGSNCdrR7.asn1
--      Date                : 01-01-2012
--      Created By    : tteryildiz
--
-- DESCRIPTION:
--             Parses Huawei EGCDR, GCDR
--             Using Systems: ALL
--             Using  Flows    : Huawei GGSN
--             Creation PPM/FT Id :	96686 : Gy Implementation 
-- ********************************************************************************
--             Update Comments :
--             <DD-MM-YYYY> - <DEV. USER NAME> - <PPM/FT Id> : <Change Comments>
-- ********************************************************************************

CiscoGGSNCdrR7 
DEFINITIONS IMPLICIT TAGS ::=
BEGIN


--  GPRS RECORDS
--
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

GPRSRecord	::= CHOICE 
{
	ggsnPDPRecord			[21] GGSNPDPRecord,
	egsnPDPRecord			[70] EGSNPDPRecord
}

GGSNPDPRecord 	::= SET
{
  recordType					[0] RecordType,		
  networkInitiation				[1] NetworkInitiatedPDPContext OPTIONAL,
  servedIMSI					[3] IMSI,
  ggsnAddress				[4] EXPLICIT GSNAddress,
  chargingID					[5] ChargingID,
  sgsnAddress				[6] EXPLICIT SEQUENCE OF GSNAddress,
  accessPointNameNI		[7] AccessPointNameNI OPTIONAL,
  pdpType					[8] PDPType OPTIONAL,
  servedPDPAddress			[9] EXPLICIT PDPAddress OPTIONAL,
  dynamicAddressFlag		[11] DynamicAddressFlag OPTIONAL,
  listOfTrafficVolumes			[12] EXPLICIT SEQUENCE OF ChangeOfCharCondition OPTIONAL,
  recordOpeningTime			[13] TimeStamp,
  duration					[14] CallDuration,
  causeForRecClosing		[15] CauseForRecClosing, 
  diagnostics					[16] EXPLICIT Diagnostics OPTIONAL,
  recordSequenceNumber		[17] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
  nodeID						[18] NodeID OPTIONAL,
  localSequenceNumber		[20] LocalSequenceNumber OPTIONAL,
  apnSelectionMode			[21] APNSelectionMode OPTIONAL,
  servedMSISDN				[22] MSISDN OPTIONAL, 
  chargingCharacteristics		[23] ChargingCharacteristics,
  chChSelectionMode			[24] ChChSelectionMode OPTIONAL,
  sgsnPLMNIdentifier			[27] PLMN-Id OPTIONAL,
  servedIMEISV				[29] IMEI OPTIONAL,
  rATType					[30] RATType OPTIONAL,
  mSTimeZone 				[31] MSTimeZone OPTIONAL,
  userLocationInformation		[32] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL
}

EGSNPDPRecord 	::= SET
{
	recordType						[0] RecordType,
	networkInitiation					[1] NetworkInitiatedPDPContext OPTIONAL,
	servedIMSI						[3] IMSI,
	ggsnAddress					[4] EXPLICIT GSNAddress,
	chargingID						[5] ChargingID,
	sgsnAddress					[6] EXPLICIT SEQUENCE OF GSNAddress,
	accessPointNameNI				[7] AccessPointNameNI OPTIONAL,
	pdpType							[8] PDPType OPTIONAL,
	servedPDPAddress				[9] EXPLICIT PDPAddress OPTIONAL,
	dynamicAddressFlag				[11] DynamicAddressFlag OPTIONAL,
	listOfTrafficVolumes				[12] EXPLICIT SEQUENCE OF ChangeOfCharCondition OPTIONAL,
	recordOpeningTime				[13] TimeStamp,
	duration							[14] CallDuration,
	causeForRecClosing				[15] CauseForRecClosing,
	diagnostics						[16] EXPLICIT Diagnostics OPTIONAL,
	recordSequenceNumber			[17] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	nodeID							[18] NodeID OPTIONAL,
	localSequenceNumber			[20] LocalSequenceNumber OPTIONAL,
	apnSelectionMode				[21] APNSelectionMode OPTIONAL,
	servedMSISDN					[22] MSISDN OPTIONAL,
	chargingCharacteristics			[23] ChargingCharacteristics,
	chChSelectionMode				[24] ChChSelectionMode OPTIONAL,
	sgsnPLMNIdentifier				[27] PLMN-Id OPTIONAL,
	servedIMEISV					[29] IMEI OPTIONAL,
	rATType							[30] RATType OPTIONAL,
	mSTimeZone 					[31] MSTimeZone OPTIONAL,
	userLocationInformation			[32] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
	listOfServiceData					[34] SEQUENCE OF ChangeOfServiceCondition OPTIONAL
}

RecordType	::= ENUMERATED 
{ 
	ggsnPDPRecord		(19),
	egsnPDPRecord		(70)
}

IMEI ::= TBCD-STRING (SIZE (8))
IMSI ::= TBCD-STRING (SIZE (3..8))
AddressString ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1..20))

Diagnostics						::= CHOICE
{
	gsm0408Cause				[0] INTEGER
}

IPAddress	::= CHOICE
{
	iPBinaryAddress	 IPBinaryAddress,
	iPTextRepresentedAddress	 IPTextRepresentedAddress
}

IPBinaryAddress	::= CHOICE
{
	iPBinV4Address			[0] OCTET STRING (SIZE(4)),
	iPBinV6Address			[1] OCTET STRING (SIZE(16))
}

IPTextRepresentedAddress	::= CHOICE
{	
	--
	-- IP address in the familiar "dot" notation
	--
	iPTextV4Address			[2] IA5String (SIZE(7..15)),
	iPTextV6Address			[3] IA5String (SIZE(15..45))
}
ISDN-AddressString ::= AddressString (SIZE(1..9))

MSISDN ::= ISDN-AddressString
MSTimeZone ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (2))
RatingGroup ::= INTEGER

TimeStamp ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(9))
TBCD-STRING ::= OCTET STRING


AccessPointNameNI	::= IA5String (SIZE(1..63))

APNSelectionMode ::= ENUMERATED
{
	--
	-- See Information Elements TS 29.060 [75]
	--
	mSorNetworkProvidedSubscriptionVerified				(0),
	mSProvidedSubscriptionNotVerified					(1),
	networkProvidedSubscriptionNotVerified				(2)
}

CallDuration ::= INTEGER

CauseForRecClosing	::= ENUMERATED
{
	normalRelease					(0),
	abnormalRelease				(4),
	cAMELInitCallRelease		 	(5),				-- Added For GCDR
	volumeLimit						(16),
	timeLimit						(17),
	sGSNChange					(18),
	maxChangeCond				(19),
	managementIntervention			(20),
	rATChange						(22),
	mSTimeZoneChange				(23)
}

ChangeCondition	::= ENUMERATED
{
	--
	-- Failure Handling values used in eGCDR only
	--
	qoSChange								(0),
	tariffTime								(1),
	recordClosure							(2),
	failureHandlingContinueOngoing			(3),
	failureHandlingRetryandTerminateOngoing (4),
	failureHandlingTerminateOngoing			(5),
	cGI-SAICHange							(6),
	rAIChange								(7)
}
ChangeOfCharCondition	::= SEQUENCE
{
	--
	-- Used in PDP context record only
	-- failureHandlingContinue field used in eGCDR only
	--
	qosNegotiated				[2] EXPLICIT QoSInformation OPTIONAL,
	dataVolumeGPRSUplink		[3] DataVolumeGPRS OPTIONAL,
	dataVolumeGPRSDownlink	[4] DataVolumeGPRS OPTIONAL,
	changeCondition				[5] ChangeCondition,
	changeTime					[6] TimeStamp,
	failureHandlingContinue		[7] FailureHandlingContinue OPTIONAL,
	userLocationInformation		[8] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL
}

ChangeOfServiceCondition	::= SEQUENCE
{
	--
	-- Used for Flow based Charging service data container
	--
	ratingGroup 						[1] RatingGroupId,
	chargingRuleBaseName			[2] ChargingRuleBaseName OPTIONAL,
	resultCode						[3] ResultCode OPTIONAL,
	localSequenceNumber			[4] LocalSequenceNumber OPTIONAL,
	timeOfFirstUsage				[5] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	timeOfLastUsage				[6] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	timeUsage 						[7] CallDuration OPTIONAL,
	serviceConditionChange			[8] ServiceConditionChange,
	qoSInformationNeg				[9] QoSInformation OPTIONAL,
	sgsn-Address 					[10] EXPLICIT GSNAddress OPTIONAL,
	sGSNPLMNIdentifier 				[11] SGSNPLMNIdentifier OPTIONAL,
	datavolumeFBCUplink			[12] DataVolumeGPRS OPTIONAL,
	datavolumeFBCDownlink			[13] DataVolumeGPRS OPTIONAL,
	timeOfReport					[14] TimeStamp,
	rATType							[15] RATType OPTIONAL,
	failureHandlingContinue			[16] FailureHandlingContinue OPTIONAL,
	serviceIdentifier					[17] ServiceIdentifier OPTIONAL,
	userLocationInformation			[20] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL
}

ChargingCharacteristics	::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))
    --
	--	Bit 0-3: Profile Index
	--	Bit 4-15: For Behavior
	--

ChargingID	::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)
	--
	-- Generated in GGSN, part of PDP context, see TS 23.060 [74]
	-- 0..4294967295 is equivalent to 0..2**32-1
	--

ChargingRuleBaseName ::= IA5String (SIZE(1..16))
	-- 
	-- identifier for the group of charging rules
	-- see Charging-Rule-Base-Name AVP as desined in TS 29.212 [88]
	--

ChChSelectionMode		::= ENUMERATED
{
	sGSNSupplied				(0),	-- For GGSN only
	homeDefault					(3),	-- For SGSN and GGSN
	roamingDefault				(4),	-- For SGSN and GGSN
	visitingDefault				(5)		-- For SGSN and GGSN
}

DataVolumeGPRS	::= INTEGER
	--
	-- The volume of data transferred in octets.
	--

DynamicAddressFlag	::= BOOLEAN

ETSIAddress	::= AddressString
	--
	-- First octet for nature of address, and numbering plan indicator (3 for X.121)
	-- Other octets TBCD
	-- See TS 29.002 [60]
	-- See TS 29.002 [60]
	--
FailureHandlingContinue  ::= BOOLEAN
	--
-- This parameter is included when the failure handling procedure has been executed and new 
-- containers are opened. This parameter shall be included in the first and subsequent 
-- containers opened after the failure 

GSNAddress	::= IPAddress

LocalSequenceNumber ::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)

NetworkInitiatedPDPContext	::= BOOLEAN

NodeID	::= IA5String (SIZE(1..20))

PDPAddress	::= CHOICE
{
	iPAddress				[0] EXPLICIT IPAddress,
	eTSIAddress			 	[1] EXPLICIT ETSIAddress
}

PDPType		::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))
	--
	-- OCTET 1: PDP Type Organization
	-- OCTET 2: PDP Type Number
	-- See TS 29.060 [75]
	--

PLMN-Id ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (3))
	--
	--	This is a 1:1 copy from the Routing Area Identity (RAI) IE specified in TS 29.060 [75]
	--  as follows:
	--	OCTET 1 of PLMN-Id = OCTET 2 of RAI  
	--	OCTET 2 of PLMN-Id = OCTET 3 of RAI  
	--	OCTET 3 of PLMN-Id = OCTET 4 of RAI  
	--

QoSInformation	::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (4..255))

RatingGroupId ::= INTEGER

RATType	::= INTEGER (0..255)

ResultCode ::= INTEGER

ServiceConditionChange	::= BIT STRING 
--{
--	qoSChange 									 (0),	-- PDP context modification
--	sGSNChange 								 (1), 	-- PDP context modification
--	sGSNPLMNIDChange 						 (2), 	-- PDP context modification
--	tariffTimeSwitch 								 (3), 	-- tariff time change
--	pDPContextRelease 							 (4), 	-- PDP context release
--	rATChange 									 (5),	-- PDP context modification
--	serviceIdledOut 								 (6),	-- IP flow idle out, DCCA QHT expiry
--	configurationChange 							 (8),	-- configuration change
--	serviceStop 									 (9), 	-- IP flow termination
--	dCCATimeThresholdReached 				(10),	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
--	dCCAVolumeThresholdReached 				(11), 	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
--	dCCAServiceSpecificUnitThresholdReached	(12), 	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
--	dCCATimeExhausted 						(13), 	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
--	dCCAVolumeExhausted 						(14), 	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
--	dCCAContinueOngoingSession 				(18), 	-- DCCA failure handling (CCFH),
--														-- continue IP flow
--	dCCARetryAndTerminateOngoingSession		(19), 	-- DCCA failure handling (CCFH),
--														-- terminate IP flow after DCCA retry
--	dCCATerminateOngoingSession 				(20), 	-- DCCA failure handling,
--														-- terminate IP flow
--	cGI-SAIChange								(21), 	-- PDP context modification
--	rAIChange									(22), 	-- PDP context modification
--	dCCAServiceSpecificUnitExhausted			(23), 	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
--	recordClosure								(24),	-- eG-CDR closure
--	timeLimit									(25),	-- intermediate recording
--	volumeLimit									(26),	-- intermediate recording
--	serviceSpecificUnitLimit						(27),	-- intermediate recording
--	envelopeClosure 							(28)
--} 
ServiceIdentifier	::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)

SGSNPLMNIdentifier ::= PLMN-Id 



END

DeliveryAttempts ::=  INTEGER {min (1), max (65535) } -- CR SMSC_3057

TBCD-STRING ::= OCTET STRING
    -- This type (Telephony Binary Coded Decimal String) is used to
    -- reresent several digits from 0 through 9, *, #, a, b, c, two
    -- digits per octet, each digit encoded 0000 to 1001 (0..9),
    -- 1010 (*), 1011 (#), 1100 (a), 1101 (b) or 1110 (c); 1111 used
    -- as filler when there is an odd number of digits.

    -- bits 8765 of octet n encoding digit 2n
    -- bits 4321 of octet n encoding digit 2(n-1) + 1

AddressString   ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1..20))
    -- This type is used to represent a number for addressing
    -- purposes. It is composed of
    --  a)  one octet for the nature of the address and numbering
    --      plan indicator.
    --  b)  digits of an address encoded as TBCD-String

    -- A)   The first octet includes a one bit extension indicator,
    --      a 3 bits nature of the address indicator and a 4 bits
    --      numbering plan indicator, encoded as follows:

    --  bit 8:  1   (no extension)

    --  bits 765:   nature of the address indicator

        --  000     unknown, starting with international/(optional)national prefixes
        --  001     international number, starting with the country code (CC)
        --  010     national significant number, number starting with the national destination code (NDC)
        --  011     network specific number
        --  100     short number, subscriber number
        --  101     alphanumeric 

    --  bits 4321:  numbering plan indicator

        --  0000    unknown
        --  0001    ISDN/Telephony Numbering Plan (Rec CCITT E.164)
        --  0011    Data numbering plan     (X.121)
        --  0100    Telex numbering plan    (F.69)
        --  0101    Service Centre Specific plan - LogicaCMG: TCP/IP
        --  1001    private numbering plan

        -- B)   The following octets representing digits of an address
        --      encoded as a TBCD-String

--maxAddressLength    INTEGER ::= 20

IMSI    ::= TBCD-STRING (SIZE (3..8))
    -- digits of MCC, MNC, MSIN are concatenated in this order

MessageError ::= INTEGER {min (0), max (65534)}

	roamer		(2)
}

{
noCharge (0),
charge (1)
}

CdrUniqueKey ::= IA5STRING

END

-- ********************************************************************************
