GGSNTurkcellCdrR7
DEFINITIONS IMPLICIT TAGS ::=

BEGIN


CallEventRecord	::= CHOICE 
{
	egsnPDPRecord					[70] EGSNPDPRecord
}

EGSNPDPRecord 	::= SET
{
	recordType						[0] CallEventRecordType,
	networkInitiation					[1] NetworkInitiatedPDPContext OPTIONAL,
	servedIMSI						[3] IMSI,
	ggsnAddress					[4] EXPLICIT GSNAddress,
	chargingID						[5] ChargingID,
	sgsnAddress					[6] EXPLICIT SEQUENCE OF GSNAddress,
	accessPointNameNI				[7] AccessPointNameNI OPTIONAL,
	pdpType							[8] PDPType OPTIONAL,
	servedPDPAddress				[9] EXPLICIT PDPAddress OPTIONAL,
	dynamicAddressFlag				[11] DynamicAddressFlag OPTIONAL,
	listOfTrafficVolumes				[12] EXPLICIT SEQUENCE OF ChangeOfCharCondition OPTIONAL,
	recordOpeningTime				[13] TimeStamp,
	duration							[14] CallDuration,
	causeForRecClosing				[15] CauseForRecClosing,
	diagnostics						[16] EXPLICIT Diagnostics OPTIONAL,
	recordSequenceNumber			[17] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	nodeID							[18] NodeID OPTIONAL,
--	recordExtensions					[19] ContentInfo OPTIONAL,
	localSequenceNumber			[20] LocalSequenceNumber OPTIONAL,
	apnSelectionMode				[21] APNSelectionMode OPTIONAL,
	servedMSISDN					[22] MSISDN OPTIONAL,
	chargingCharacteristics			[23] ChargingCharacteristics,
	chChSelectionMode				[24] ChChSelectionMode OPTIONAL,
--	iMSsignalingContext				[25] NULL OPTIONAL,
--	externalChargingID				[26] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
	sgsnPLMNIdentifier				[27] PLMN-Id OPTIONAL,
--	pSFurnishChargingInformation	[28] PSFurnishChargingInformation OPTIONAL,
	servedIMEISV					[29] IMEI OPTIONAL,
	rATType							[30] RATType OPTIONAL,
	mSTimeZone 					[31] MSTimeZone OPTIONAL,
	userLocationInformation			[32] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
--	cAMELChargingInformation		[33] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
	listOfServiceData					[34] SEQUENCE OF ChangeOfServiceCondition OPTIONAL,
	subscriptionType 				[98] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	sourceGGSNFlag				[99] SourceGGSNFlag OPTIONAL
}

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--
--  GPRS COMMAN DATA TYPES
--
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CallEventRecordType 	::= ENUMERATED 
{ 
	ggsnPDPRecord					(19),
	egsnPDPRecord					(70)
}

NetworkInitiatedPDPContext	::= BOOLEAN

IMSI ::= TBCD-STRING (SIZE (3..8))									-- OCTET STRING IN CISCO DTSTR

TBCD-STRING ::= OCTET STRING

GSNAddress	::= IPAddress

IPAddress	::= CHOICE
{
	iPBinaryAddress	 IPBinaryAddress,
	iPTextRepresentedAddress	 IPTextRepresentedAddress			-- Not present in CISCO DTSTR
}

IPBinaryAddress	::= CHOICE
{
	iPBinV4Address					[0] OCTET STRING (SIZE(4)),
	iPBinV6Address					[1] OCTET STRING (SIZE(16))		-- Not present in CISCO DTSTR
}

IPTextRepresentedAddress	::= CHOICE		-- Not present in CISCO DTSTR
{	--
	-- IP address in the familiar "dot" notation
	--
	iPTextV4Address					[2] IA5String (SIZE(7..15)),
	iPTextV6Address					[3] IA5String (SIZE(15..45))
}

ChargingID ::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)	

AccessPointNameNI ::= IA5String (SIZE(1..63))	

PDPType ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))	

PDPAddress	::= CHOICE
{
	iPAddress						[0] EXPLICIT IPAddress,
	eTSIAddress						[1] EXPLICIT ETSIAddress	-- Not present in CISCO DTSTR
}

ETSIAddress	::= AddressString

DynamicAddressFlag ::= BOOLEAN	

MSTimeZone	::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (2))

ChangeOfCharCondition	::= SEQUENCE
{
	--
	-- Used in PDP context record only
	-- failureHandlingContinue field used in eGCDR only
	--
	qosRequested					[1] EXPLICIT QoSInformation OPTIONAL,
	qosNegotiated					[2] EXPLICIT QoSInformation OPTIONAL,
	dataVolumeGPRSUplink			[3] DataVolumeGPRS OPTIONAL,
	dataVolumeGPRSDownlink		[4] DataVolumeGPRS OPTIONAL,
	changeCondition					[5] ChangeCondition,
	changeTime						[6] TimeStamp,
	failureHandlingContinue			[7] FailureHandlingContinue OPTIONAL,
	userLocationInformation			[8] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL
}

QoSInformation	::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (4..17)) -- Huawei
-- QoSInformation	::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (4..255)) -- Cisco

DataVolumeGPRS	::= INTEGER

ChangeCondition ::= IA5STRING -- ENUMERATED	
--{
		--
		-- Failure Handling values used in eGCDR only
		--
--		qoSChange (0),
--		tariffTime (1),
--		recordClosure (2),
--		failureHandlingContinueOngoing (3),
--		failureHandlingRetryandTerminateOngoing (4),
--		failureHandlingTerminateOngoing (5),
--		cGI-SAICHange (6),
--		rAIChange (7),
--		dT-Establishment (8),	-- Not in Cisco
--		dT-Removal (9)			-- Not in Cisco
--}

TimeStamp ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(9))		 					

CallDuration ::= INTEGER			

CauseForRecClosing	::= ENUMERATED
{
	normalRelease					(0),
	abnormalRelease					(4),
	cAMELInitCallRelease			(5),
	volumeLimit						(16),
	timeLimit						(17),
	sGSNChange						(18),
	maxChangeCond					(19),
	managementIntervention	    	(20),
   	intraSGSNIntersystemChange		(21),
	rATChange						(22),
	mSTimeZoneChange				(23),
	sGSNPLMNIDChange 				(24),
   	unauthorizedRequestingNetwork	(52),
	unauthorizedLCSClient			(53),
	positionMethodFailure			(54),
	unknownOrUnreachableLCSClient	(58),
	listofDownstreamNodeChange		(59)
}

NodeID ::= IA5String (SIZE(1..20))

ContentInfo  ::= SEQUENCE 
{
	extensionType					[0]	INTEGER,
	length							[1]	INTEGER,
	serviceList     					[2] SEQUENCE OF ServiceEvent, --<UNBOUNDED>-- OF ServiceEvent,
	changeTimeList					[3] SEQUENCE OF ChangeTimeExtension OPTIONAL,
	recordOpeningTime				[4]	TimeStampExtension OPTIONAL,
	duration	    						[5] CallDurationExtension OPTIONAL,
	transparentVSA    				[6] OCTET STRING (SIZE(3..255)) OPTIONAL
}

ServiceEvent ::= SEQUENCE
{
    serviceCode   					[0]  INTEGER OPTIONAL,
    uplinkVolume					[1]  INTEGER OPTIONAL,
    downlinkVolume				[2]  INTEGER OPTIONAL,
    usageduration					[3]  INTEGER OPTIONAL,
    url							[5]  OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..120)) OPTIONAL, 
    chargingRuleBaseName		[8]  ChargingRuleBaseName OPTIONAL,
    ratingGroup 					[9]  RatingGroupId OPTIONAL,
    serviceIdentifier				[10] ServiceIdentifier OPTIONAL,
    localSequenceNumber			[11] LocalSequenceNumber OPTIONAL,
    envelopeStartTime				[12] TimeStampExtension OPTIONAL,
    envelopeEndTime    			[13] TimeStampExtension OPTIONAL,
    duration						[14] CallDurationExtension OPTIONAL
}

ChangeTimeExtension ::= SEQUENCE
{
	changeTime  [1]  TimeStampExtension OPTIONAL
}

CallDurationExtension ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(3..12))

TimeStampExtension	::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(10))

ChargingRuleBaseName ::= IA5String (SIZE(1..16))		

RatingGroupId ::= INTEGER
 
LocalSequenceNumber ::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)

APNSelectionMode ::= ENUMERATED
{
	mSorNetworkProvidedSubscriptionVerified		(0),
	mSProvidedSubscriptionNotVerified			(1),
	networkProvidedSubscriptionNotVerified		(2)
}

MSISDN	::= ISDN-AddressString 

ISDN-AddressString ::= AddressString 			

AddressString ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1..20))

ChargingCharacteristics	::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))

ChChSelectionMode ::= ENUMERATED					
{
		sGSNSupplied 			(0), -- For GGSN only
		subscriptionSpecific 		(1), -- For SGSN only		-- not in Cisco
		aPNSpecific 				(2), -- For SGSN only		-- not in Cisco
		homeDefault 			(3), -- For SGSN and GGSN
		roamingDefault 			(4), -- For SGSN and GGSN
		visitingDefault 			(5)  -- For SGSN and GGSN
}

PLMN-Id ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (3))	

IMEI ::= TBCD-STRING (SIZE (8))	

RATType	::= INTEGER (0..255)

ChangeOfServiceCondition	::= SEQUENCE
{
	ratingGroup 						[1] RatingGroupId OPTIONAL,
	chargingRuleBaseName			[2] ChargingRuleBaseName OPTIONAL,
	resultCode						[3] ResultCode OPTIONAL,
	localSequenceNumber			[4] LocalSequenceNumber OPTIONAL,
	timeOfFirstUsage				[5] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	timeOfLastUsage				[6] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	timeUsage 						[7] CallDuration OPTIONAL,
	serviceConditionChange			[8] ServiceConditionChange,
	qoSInformationNeg				[9] QoSInformation OPTIONAL,
	sgsn-Address 					[10] EXPLICIT GSNAddress OPTIONAL,
	sGSNPLMNIdentifier 				[11] PLMN-Id OPTIONAL,
	datavolumeFBCUplink			[12] DataVolumeGPRS OPTIONAL,
	datavolumeFBCDownlink			[13] DataVolumeGPRS OPTIONAL,
	timeOfReport					[14] TimeStamp,
	rATType							[15] RATType OPTIONAL,
	failureHandlingContinue			[16] FailureHandlingContinue OPTIONAL,
	serviceIdentifier					[17] ServiceIdentifier OPTIONAL,
--	pSFurnishChargingInformation	[18] PSFurnishChargingInformation OPTIONAL,
--	aFRecordInformation				[19] SEQUENCE OF AFRecordInformation OPTIONAL,
	userLocationInformation			[20] UserLocationInfoList OPTIONAL
--	eventBasedChargingInformation	[21] EventBasedChargingInformation OPTIONAL,
--	timeQuotaMechanism			[22] TimeQuotaMechanism OPTIONAL
}

PSFurnishChargingInformation  ::= SEQUENCE
{
	pSFreeFormatData		[1] FreeFormatData,
	pSFFDAppendIndicator  	[2] FFDAppendIndicator OPTIONAL
}

FreeFormatData	::=	OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..160))

FFDAppendIndicator	::= BOOLEAN

ResultCode ::= INTEGER

ServiceIdentifier	::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)

AFRecordInformation	::= SEQUENCE
{
	aFChargingIdentifier			[1] AFChargingIdentifier,
	flows						[2] Flows OPTIONAL
}

AFChargingIdentifier ::= OCTET STRING

Flows  ::= 	SEQUENCE
{
	mediaComponentNumber	[1] INTEGER,
	flowNumber  				[2] SEQUENCE OF INTEGER OPTIONAL
}

EventBasedChargingInformation  ::= SEQUENCE
{
	numberOfEvents		[1] INTEGER,
	eventTimeStamps  	[2] SEQUENCE OF TimeStamp OPTIONAL
}

TimeQuotaMechanism	::= SEQUENCE
{
	timeQuotaType				[1] TimeQuotaType,
	baseTimeInterval				[2] INTEGER
}

TimeQuotaType	::= ENUMERATED
{
	discreteTimePeriod				(0),
	continuousTimePeriod			(1),
	continousTimePeriodExtension	(100)
}

ServiceConditionChange ::= BIT STRING						
--{
--		qoSChange 								(0), -- PDP context modification
--		sGSNChange 							(1), -- PDP context modification
--		sGSNPLMNIDChange 					(2), -- PDP context modification
--		tariffTimeSwitch 							(3), -- tariff time change
--		pDPContextRelease 						(4), -- PDP context release
--		rATChange 								(5), -- PDP context modification
--		serviceIdledOut 							(6), -- IP flow idle out, DCCA QHT expiry
--		--reserved 								(7) old: QCTexpiry is no report event
--		configurationChange 						(8), -- configuration change
--		serviceStop 								(9), -- IP flow termination
--		dCCATimeThresholdReached 				(10), -- DCCA quota reauthorization
--		dCCAVolumeThresholdReached  				(11), -- DCCA quota reauthorization
--		dCCAServiceSpecificUnitThresholdReached 	(12), -- DCCA quota reauthorization
--		dCCATimeExhausted 						(13), -- DCCA quota reauthorization
--		dCCAVolumeExhausted 						(14), -- DCCA quota reauthorization
--		dCCAValidityTimeout 						(15), -- DCCA quota validity time (QVT expiry)
--		reserved 									(16), -- reserved due to no use case,
--		-- old: return Requested is covered by  (17),(18)
--		dCCAReauthorisationRequest 				(17), -- DCCA quota reauthorization request by OCS
--		dCCAContinueOngoingSession 				(18), -- DCCA failure handling (CCFH),
--		-- continue IP flow
--		dCCARetryAndTerminateOngoingSession 		(19), -- DCCA failure handling (CCFH),
--		-- terminate IP flow after DCCA retry
--		dCCATerminateOngoingSession 				(20), -- DCCA failure handling,
--		-- terminate IP flow
--		cGI-SAIChange								(21), -- PDP context modification
--		rAIChange 									(22), -- PDP context modification
--		dCCAServiceSpecificUnitExhausted 			(23), -- DCCA quota reauthorization
--		recordClosure 								(24), -- eG-CDR closure
--		timeLimit 									(25), -- intermediate recording
--		volumeLimit 									(26), -- intermediate recording
--		serviceSpecificUnitLimit 						(27), -- intermediate recording
--		envelopeClosure 							(28)
--}

SourceGGSNFlag	::= ENUMERATED
{
	huaweiGGSN				(0),
	ciscoGGSN					(1)
}

FailureHandlingContinue  ::= BOOLEAN

Diagnostics	::= CHOICE
{
	gsm0408Cause					[0] INTEGER,
	-- See TS 24.008 [64]	

	gsm0902MapErrorValue			[1] INTEGER,
	-- Note: The value to be stored here corresponds to
	-- the local values defined in the MAP-Errors and 
	-- MAP-DialogueInformation modules, for full details
	-- see TS 29.002 [60].

	itu-tQ767Cause					[2] INTEGER,
	-- See ITU-T Q.767 [67]	

	networkSpecificCause			[3] ManagementExtension,
	-- To be defined by network operator	

	manufacturerSpecificCause		[4] INTEGER,
	-- To be defined by manufacturer	
	
	positionMethodFailureCause		[5] PositionMethodFailure-Diagnostic,
	-- see TS 29.002 [60]
	unauthorizedLCSClientCause		[6] UnauthorizedLCSClient-Diagnostic
	-- see TS 29.002 [60]
}

ManagementExtension ::= SEQUENCE 
{
	identifier	OBJECT IDENTIFIER,
	significance	[1] BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
	information	[2] OCTET STRING 
}

PositionMethodFailure-Diagnostic ::= ENUMERATED {
	congestion  (0),
	insufficientResources  (1),
	insufficientMeasurementData  (2),
	inconsistentMeasurementData  (3),
	locationProcedureNotCompleted  (4),
	locationProcedureNotSupportedByTargetMS  (5),
	qoSNotAttainable  (6),
	positionMethodNotAvailableInNetwork	(7),
	positionMethodNotAvailableInLocationArea	(8)
}
--	exception handling:
--	any unrecognized value shall be ignored

UnauthorizedLCSClient-Diagnostic ::= ENUMERATED {
	noAdditionalInformation (0),
	clientNotInMSPrivacyExceptionList (1),
	callToClientNotSetup (2),
	privacyOverrideNotApplicable (3),
	disallowedByLocalRegulatoryRequirements (4)
}
--	exception handling:
--	any unrecognized value shall be ignored

UserLocationInfoList ::= SEQUENCE
{
	firstUserLocationInformation [0] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
	lastUserLocationInformation [1] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL
}

END

contents:
-- **********************************************************************

-- The contents of this document are subject to revision without notice due
-- to continued progress in methodology, design and manufacturing.
--
-- Ericsson AB shall have no liability for any errors or damage of any kind 
-- resulting from the use of modified versions of this document.
--
-- DESCRIPTION:
--  This is the Ericsson Multi Mediation ASN.1 structure specification for
--  the GPRS charging extensions.
--  It must be imported into the Mediator before the GSN ASN.1 specifications
--  can be used.
--
-- INSTALLATION AND  CONFIGURATION:
--  1) Put this file in /opt/BGw/<version>/datastructures
--  2) Import it into the Mediator
--
-- REVISION HISTORY:
-- Rev		Date        Author          	Action
-- PA1		2003-05-12	epktml		Creation
-- PA2		2003-06-02	epkolfo		Correction of index in PolicyControlFailureReport 
-- PA3		2003-11-14	epktml		Updates, added EXPLICITs, changed source document
-- A			2003-11-16	epktml		Full revision after basic test
-- PB1		2004-08-19	epktml		New updated POD
-- PB2		2004-09-08	epktml		Corrections, added OPTIONAL to ServiceClassItem.volumeUplink ServiceClassItem.volumeDownlink
-- C		2004-04-13	epkhper		EXPLICIT added to ccsAddress->IPAddress.
-- D		2004-11-30	epktml		Corrections in file header
-- PE1		2005-05-31	epkhper		Updated to support new source documemt, 9/155 19-CSA 113 35/1, Rev B
-- PE2		2005-08-15	epkhper		Updated to support new source documemt, 9/155 19-CSA 113 35/1, Rev C
-- E		2005-09-28	epkhper		Put in sharp revision
-- F		2005-11-28	epkpers		Updated to support new source documemt, 9/155 19-CSA 113 35/1, Rev E
-- PG1		2005-11-28	epkpers		Updated to support new source documemt, 31/155 17-CSA 113 35/2, Rev B
-- PG2		2006-06-13	epkpers		New revision of source document, RevE
-- PG3		2006-09-27	epkpers		pcsRealm and policyControlSessionId changed to IA5String, TR HH36198
-- PG4		2006-10-04	epkpers		ccsRealm and creditControlSessionId changed to IA5String, TR 
-- G		2006-10-23	epkpers		Put in skarp revision, new source document in Rev.A
-- H            2006-11-27      emamcha         Added ExtendedDiagnostics in GprsCdrExtensions for SGSNR70. 
--
-- DEVIATIONS:
-- The following has been changed, compared to the source document:
--
-- COMMON DATA TYPES
--
--  CreditControlInfo, EXPLICIT has been added to IPAddress (TAG 1)
--  
--  PolicyControlInfo, EXPLICIT has been added to IPAddress (TAG 1)
--
--  IPAddress ::= CHOICE .... added
--
--  IPBinaryAddress ::= CHOICE .... added
--
--  IPTextRepresentedAddress ::= CHOICE .... added
--
--  IPAddress,  IPBinaryAddress, IPTextRepresentedAddress and TimeStamp added
--
--  TimeStamp ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(9)) added
--  
--  pcsRealm ::= IA5String
--  policyControlSessionId ::= IA5String
--  ccsRealm ::= IA5String
--  creditControlSessionId ::= IA5String
--
-- SOURCE DOCUMENT: 
--      No. : 1/190 83-AXB 250 05/3 Uen
--      Rev : D
-- 
-- 12.11.2009 TTECH :KTTC GY offline Charging mekanizmasi icin asagidaki alanlar CGNS40Ber structure'a assign edildi.
--		listOfServiceData[i].localSequenceNumber ==> serviceContainers[i].localSequenceNumber
--		listOfServiceData[i].failureHandlingContinue ==> serviceContainers.failureHandlingContinue
-- ********************************************************************** 
GPRS-Charging-Extensions { itu-t (0) identified-organization (4) etsi (0) reserved (127) etsi-identified-organization (0) ericsson (5) oAM (2) accounting (2) charging (0) mobileDomain (0) umts (0) packetSwitched (1) ts32015Extensions (0) version1 (1) }

DEFINITIONS IMPLICIT TAGS ::=
BEGIN

EXPORTS GprsCdrExtensions
;

GprsCdrExtensions	::= SET
{
	extendedDiagnostics     [0] EXPLICIT ExtendedDiagnostics OPTIONAL,
	chargingContainers	[1] SEQUENCE OF ChargingContainer OPTIONAL,  -- SACC 2.0, only
	creditControlInfo	[2] CreditControlInfo OPTIONAL,
	policyControlInfo	[3] PolicyControlInfo OPTIONAL,
	userCategory		[5] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	ruleSpaceId        	[6] IA5String OPTIONAL,                     -- SACC 3.0, only
  	serviceContainers  	[7] SEQUENCE OF ServiceContainer OPTIONAL,  -- SACC 3.0, only
  	timeReports        	[8] SEQUENCE OF TimeReport OPTIONAL         -- SACC 3.0, only
}

ActiveTimeMethod ::= ENUMERATED
{
  	duration           (1),
  	inactivityIncluded (2),
  	inactivity         (3),
  	activePeriods      (4)
}

BlockItem ::= SEQUENCE 
{ 
	blocks 		[0] INTEGER, 
	blockRate 	[1] RealUnit OPTIONAL, 
	blockSize 	[2] INTEGER, 
	blockSizeType 	[3] BlockSizeType,
  	startTime     	[4] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
  	stopTime      	[5] TimeStamp OPTIONAL
} 
BlockSizeType ::= ENUMERATED 
{ 
	seconds (0), 
	bytes (1) 
} 

ChargingContainer	::= SEQUENCE
{
	changeTime			[0] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	listOfServices			[1] SEQUENCE OF ServiceItem OPTIONAL,
	listOfServiceClasses		[2] SEQUENCE OF ServiceClassItem OPTIONAL,
	initialCharge			[3] RealUnit OPTIONAL,
	sessionPolicy			[4] SessionPolicy OPTIONAL,
	blockItem 			[5] BlockItem OPTIONAL
}
CreditControlDiagnostics	::= ENUMERATED
{
	creditDenied 			(0),
	creditControlFailure 		(1),
	creditControlSuspended		(2),
	creditControlResumed		(3)
}
CreditControlFailureAction	::= ENUMERATED
{
	release 			(0),
	continue 			(1),
	continueFreeServices		(2),
	newCreditControlSession		(3)
}
CreditControlFailureReport	::= SEQUENCE
{
 	requestType			[0] CreditRequestType,
	requestStatus			[1] CreditRequestStatus,
	resultCode			[2] CreditResultCode OPTIONAL,
	recordNumber			[4] CreditRecordNumber OPTIONAL,	-- SACC 2.0
	startTime			[5] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,			-- SACC 2.0
	stopTime			[6] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,			-- SACC 2.0
	lastCreditGranted		[7] RealUnit OPTIONAL,			-- SACC 2.0
	creditUsed			[8] RealUnit OPTIONAL,			-- SACC 2.0
	newCreditControlSessionId 	[10] OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..255)) OPTIONAL,  -- SACC 2.0
	deferredCreditUsed		[11] RealUnit OPTIONAL,			-- SACC 2.0
  	ccRequestNumber           	[12] INTEGER OPTIONAL                 	-- SACC 3.0
}
CreditControlInfo		::= SEQUENCE
{
	creditControlEnabled		[0] BOOLEAN OPTIONAL,			-- SACC 2.0
	ccsPeer				[1] EXPLICIT IPAddress OPTIONAL,	-- SACC 2.0
	creditUnit			[2] CreditUnit OPTIONAL,		-- SACC 2.0
	creditControlDiagnostics   	[3] CreditControlDiagnostics OPTIONAL,	-- SACC 2.0
	creditDeniedAction 		[4] CreditDeniedAction OPTIONAL,	-- SACC 2.0
	creditControlFailureAction 	[5] CreditControlFailureAction OPTIONAL,  -- SACC 2.0
	creditControlFailureReport 	[6] CreditControlFailureReport OPTIONAL,
	creditControlSessionId		[7] IA5String (SIZE(1..255)) OPTIONAL,
	ccsRealm 			[8] IA5String (SIZE(1..255)) OPTIONAL
}
CreditDeniedAction	::= ENUMERATED
{
	release 			(0),
	continue 			(1),
	continueFreeServiceClasses	(2),
	continueLimitServiceClasses	(3)
}
CreditRecordNumber	::= INTEGER(0..4294967295)
CreditRequestType ::= ENUMERATED
{
	start			(0),
	interim			(1),
	stop			(2)
}
CreditRequestStatus ::= ENUMERATED
{
	unsent			(0),
	noAnswer		(1),
	failure			(2)
}
CreditResultCode ::= INTEGER
CreditUnit::= SEQUENCE
{
	unitType		[0]	CreditUnitType,
	currencyCode		[1]	CurrencyCode OPTIONAL
}
CreditUnitType ::= ENUMERATED
{
	time			(0),
	volume			(1),
	event			(2),
	money			(3)
}
CurrencyCode ::= INTEGER

DataVolumeGPRS ::= INTEGER

ExtendedDiagnostics ::= CHOICE
{
        ts48018BssgpCause	[0] INTEGER,
        ts25413RanapCause	[1] INTEGER
}

IPAddress ::= CHOICE
{
	iPBinaryAddress			IPBinaryAddress,
	iPTextRepresentedAddress	IPTextRepresentedAddress
}
IPBinaryAddress ::= CHOICE
{
	iPBinV4Address	[0] OCTET STRING (SIZE(4)),
	iPBinV6Address	[1] OCTET STRING (SIZE(16))
}
IPTextRepresentedAddress ::= CHOICE
{
	iPTextV4Address	[2] IA5String (SIZE(7..15)),
	iPTextV6Address	[3] IA5String (SIZE(15..45))
}

LocalSequenceNumber ::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)

PolicyControlDiagnostics	::= ENUMERATED
{
	policyControlFailure 		(1),
	policyControlSuspended		(2),
	policyControlResumed		(3)
}
PolicyControlFailureAction	::= ENUMERATED
{
	release 		(0),
	continueDefaultPolicy 	(1)
}
PolicyControlFailureReport	::= SEQUENCE
{
	requestType		[0] PolicyRequestType,
	requestStatus		[1] PolicyRequestStatus,
	resultCode		[2] PolicyResultCode OPTIONAL,
	sessionId		[3] OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..255)) OPTIONAL,	-- SACC 2.0
	startTime		[4] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,				-- SACC 2.0
	stopTime		[5] TimeStamp OPTIONAL
}
PolicyControlInfo		::= SEQUENCE
{
	policyControlEnabled		[0] BOOLEAN OPTIONAL,			  -- SACC 2.0
	pcsPeer				[1] EXPLICIT IPAddress OPTIONAL,	  -- SACC 2.0
	policyControlDiagnostics	[2] PolicyControlDiagnostics OPTIONAL,	  -- SACC 2.0
	policyControlFailureAction	[3] PolicyControlFailureAction OPTIONAL,  -- SACC 2.0
	policyControlFailureReport	[4] PolicyControlFailureReport OPTIONAL,
	currencyCode			[5] CurrencyCode OPTIONAL,		  -- SACC 2.0
	pcsRealm			[6] IA5String (SIZE(1..255)) OPTIONAL,
  	policyControlSessionId     	[7] IA5String (SIZE(1..255)) OPTIONAL  -- SACC 3.0
}
PolicyRequestStatus ::= ENUMERATED
{
	unsent			(0),
	noAnswer		(1),
	failure			(2)
}
PolicyRequestType ::= ENUMERATED
{
	start			(0),
	interim			(1),
	stop			(2)
}
PolicyResultCode ::= INTEGER

RatingGroup ::= INTEGER
RealUnit ::= SEQUENCE
{	
	valueDigits		[0] INTEGER,
	exponent		[1] INTEGER OPTIONAL
}

ServiceClass	::=	INTEGER(0..4294967295)
ServiceClassItem	::= SEQUENCE
{
	serviceClass		[0] ServiceClass,
	volumeUplink		[1] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	volumeDownlink		[2] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	volumeRateUplink	[3] RealUnit OPTIONAL,
	volumeRateDownlink	[4] RealUnit OPTIONAL,
	sessionPolicy		[5] SessionPolicy OPTIONAL,
	blockItem 		[6] BlockItem OPTIONAL,
	localSequenceNumber	[7] LocalSequenceNumber OPTIONAL,    --offline Charging icin eklendi --TTECH TCSCAKMAKCI
	failureHandlingContinue	[8] FailureHandlingContinue OPTIONAL --offline Charging icin eklendi --TTECH TCSCAKMAKCI
}

FailureHandlingContinue ::= BOOLEAN

ServiceContainer ::= SEQUENCE
{
  ratingGroup          [1] RatingGroup,
  serviceIdentifier    [2] ServiceIdentifier OPTIONAL,
  localSequenceNumber  [3] LocalSequenceNumber OPTIONAL,
  method               [4] ActiveTimeMethod OPTIONAL,
  inactivity           [5] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
  resolution           [6] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
  ccRequestNumber      [7] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
  serviceSpecificUnits [8] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
  listOfURI            [9] SEQUENCE OF URI OPTIONAL
}

ServiceIdentifier ::= INTEGER(0..4294967295)
ServiceItem		::= SEQUENCE
{
	serviceIdentifier	[0] ServiceIdentifier,
	volumeUplink		[1] INTEGER,
	volumeDownlink		[2] INTEGER
}
SessionPolicy ::= SEQUENCE
{
	volumeLimitAction	[0] UsageLimitAction OPTIONAL,
	blockLimitAction	[1] UsageLimitAction OPTIONAL
}

TimeReport ::= SEQUENCE
{
  ratingGroup        [1] RatingGroup,
  startTime          [2] TimeStamp,
  endTime            [3] TimeStamp,
  dataVolumeUplink   [4] DataVolumeGPRS OPTIONAL,
  dataVolumeDownlink [5] DataVolumeGPRS OPTIONAL
}
TimeStamp ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(9))

URI ::= SEQUENCE
{
  	count   [1] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
  	uri     [2] IA5String
}
UsageLimitAction  ::=  ENUMERATED
{
	reset			(1),
	add			(2)
}

END

-- ********************************************************************************

--
-- DESCRIPTION:
--             Brief Description of the datastructure and its aim

-- ********************************************************************************

-- ********************************************************************************

GSN21IC DEFINITIONS  IMPLICIT TAGS ::=
BEGIN

CallEventRecord ::= SEQUENCE 
{
	sgsnPDPRecord		[1] GSNPDPRecord
}

GSNPDPRecord   ::= SEQUENCE
{
	recordType		[1]  RecordType		OPTIONAL,
	networkInitiation	[2]  NetworkInitiation	OPTIONAL,
	servedMSISDN		[3]  MSISDN 		OPTIONAL,
	servedIMSI		[4]  IMSI		OPTIONAL,
	servedIMEI		[5]  IMEI 		OPTIONAL,
	sgsnAddress		[6]  GSNAddress		OPTIONAL,
	routingArea     	[7]  RoutingAreaCode	OPTIONAL,
	locationAreaCode	[8]  LocationAreaCode	OPTIONAL,
	chargingID      	[10] ChargingID		OPTIONAL,
	ggsnAddress 		[11] GSNAddress		OPTIONAL,
	accessPointName 	[12] AccessPointName	OPTIONAL,
	pdpType			[13] PDPType		OPTIONAL,
	servedPDPAddress	[14] GSNAddress 	OPTIONAL,
	trafficVolume		[15] TrafficVolumeData	OPTIONAL,
	recordOpeningDate	[16] DATE		OPTIONAL,
	duration		[18] Duration		OPTIONAL,
	causeForRecClosing     	[19] CauseForRecClosing OPTIONAL,
	subscriptionType	[20] SPType		OPTIONAL,
	ratType			[22] RatType		OPTIONAL
}

-------------------------------

RecordType		::= INTEGER (SIZE(2) CODE("DEC"))
NetworkInitiation	::= INTEGER (SIZE(1) CODE("DEC"))
MSISDN			::= IA5STRING(SIZE(18) CODE("LEFT"))

}

SGSNPDPRecord ::= SET
{

	cellIdentifier 		[9] OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))	OPTIONAL,
	chargingID 		[10] INTEGER (0..4294967295),
	ggsnAddressUsed	[11] EXPLICIT IPAddress,
	accessPointNameNI 	[12] IA5String (SIZE(1..63))	OPTIONAL,
	pdpType 		[13] OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))	OPTIONAL,
	servedPDPAddress 	[14] EXPLICIT PDPAddress	OPTIONAL,
	listOfTrafficVolumes	[15] SEQUENCE OF ChangeOfCharCondition OPTIONAL,

	localSequenceNumber 	[24] INTEGER (0..4294967295) OPTIONAL,
	apnSelectionMode 	[25] APNSelectionMode	OPTIONAL,
	accessPointNameOI 	[26] IA5String (SIZE(1..37))	OPTIONAL,
	servedMSISDN 		[27] OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..9)) OPTIONAL,
	chargingCharacteristics 	[28] OCTET STRING (SIZE(2)),
	ratType 		[29] RatType	OPTIONAL,
	cAMELInformationPDP 	[30] CAMELInformationPDP	OPTIONAL,
	chChSelectionMode 	[32] ChChSelectionMode	OPTIONAL,
	dynamicAddressFlag 	[33] BOOLEAN		OPTIONAL,

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--
--  COMMON DATA TYPES

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
AddressString ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1..20))

APNSelectionMode ::= ENUMERATED
{
	mSorNetworkProvidedSubscriptionVerified	(0),
	mSProvidedSubscriptionNotVerified	(1),
	networkProvidedSubscriptionNotVerified	(2)
}

BCDDirectoryNumber ::= OCTET STRING

CallEventRecordType ::= INTEGER
{
	sgsnPDPRecord	(18),
	sgsnSMORecord	(21),
	sgsnSMTRecord	(22)
}

CAMELInformationPDP ::= SET
{
	sCFAddress 		[1] AddressString	OPTIONAL,
	serviceKey 		[2] INTEGER (0..2147483647)	OPTIONAL,
	defaultTransactionHandling	[3] DefaultGPRS-Handling	OPTIONAL,
	cAMELAccessPointNameNI 	[4] IA5String (SIZE(1..63))	OPTIONAL,
	cAMELAccessPointNameOI 	[5] IA5String (SIZE(1..37))	OPTIONAL,

	freeFormatData 	[8] OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..160)) OPTIONAL,
	fFDAppendIndicator 	[9] BOOLEAN		OPTIONAL
}

CallReferenceNumber ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..8))

CAMELInformationSMS ::= SET
{
	sCFAddress 			[1] AddressString	OPTIONAL,
	serviceKey 			[2] INTEGER (0..2147483647)	OPTIONAL,
	defaultSMSHandling 		[3] DefaultSMS-Handling	OPTIONAL,
	cAMELCallingPartyNumber 		[4] BCDDirectoryNumber	OPTIONAL,
	cAMELDestinationSubscriberNumber	[5] BCDDirectoryNumber	OPTIONAL,
	cAMELSMSCAddress 		[6] AddressString	OPTIONAL,
	freeFormatData 		[7] OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..160)) OPTIONAL,
	smsReferenceNumber 		[8] CallReferenceNumber	OPTIONAL
}

CauseForRecClosing ::= INTEGER
{
	normalRelease		(0),
	abnormalRelease	(4),
	cAMELInitCallRelease	(5),
	volumeLimit		(16),
	timeLimit 		(17),
	sGSNChange		(18),
	maxChangeCond	(19),
	managementIntervention       	(20),
	intraSGSNIntersystemChange	(21),
	pLMNChange		(101)
}

ChangeCondition ::= ENUMERATED
{
	qosChange		(0),
	tariffTime		(1),
	recordClosure		(2),
	failureHandlingContinueOngoing	(3),
	oneTunnelEstablish	(8),
	oneTunnelRelease	(9)

}

ChangeOfCharCondition ::= SEQUENCE
{
	qosRequested		[1] QoSInformation OPTIONAL,
	qosNegotiated		[2] QoSInformation OPTIONAL,
	dataVolumeGPRSUplink	[3] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	dataVolumeGPRSDownlink	[4] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	changeCondition	[5] ChangeCondition,
	changeTime		[6] OCTET STRING (SIZE(9))
}

ChChSelectionMode ::= ENUMERATED
{
	subscriptionSpecific	(1),
	aPNSpecific		(2),
	homeDefault		(3),
	roamingDefault	(4),
	visitingDefault		(5)
}

DefaultGPRS-Handling ::= ENUMERATED
{
	continueTransaction	(0),
	releaseTransaction	(1)
}

DefaultSMS-Handling ::= ENUMERATED
{
	continueTransaction	(0),
	releaseTransaction	(1)
}

Diagnostics ::= CHOICE
{
	gsm0408Cause	[0] INTEGER,
	gsm0902MapErrorValue	[1] INTEGER
}

IPAddress ::= CHOICE
{
	iPBinaryAddress	IPBinaryAddress,
	iPTextRepresentedAddress	IPTextRepresentedAddress
}

IPBinaryAddress ::= CHOICE
{
	iPBinV4Address	[0] OCTET STRING (SIZE(4)),
	iPBinV6Address	[1] OCTET STRING (SIZE(16))
}

IPTextRepresentedAddress ::= CHOICE
{
	iPTextV4Address	[2] IA5String (SIZE(7..15)),
	iPTextV6Address	[3] IA5String (SIZE(15..45))
}

LevelOfCAMELService ::= OCTET STRING
-- LevelOfCAMELService ::= BIT STRING
--{
--      basic                   (0),
--      callDurationSupervision (1),
--      onlineCharging          (2)
--}

PDPAddress ::= CHOICE
{
	iPAddress		[0] EXPLICIT IPAddress,
	eTSIAddress		[1] EXPLICIT OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..20))
}

QoSInformation ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(4..12))

SMSResult ::= CHOICE
{
	gsm0408Cause	[0] INTEGER,
	gsm0902MapErrorValue	[1] INTEGER
}

RatType ::= ENUMERATED
{
	iuUTRAN		(1), --UMTS (3G)
	gSM		(2) --GSM (2G)
}

ManagementExtensions ::= SET OF ManagementExtension
ManagementExtension ::= SEQUENCE
{
  identifier	[UNIVERSAL 6] OCTET STRING,
  significance	[1] BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
  information	[2] GprsCdrExtensions OPTIONAL
}

END

	datavolumeFBCDownlink			[28] DataVolumeGPRS OPTIONAL,

AddressString ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1..20))
	-- This type is used to represent a number for addressing
	-- purposes. It is composed of
	--	a)	one octet for nature of address, and numbering plan
	--		indicator.
	--	b)	digits of an address encoded as TBCD-String.

	-- a)	The first octet includes a one bit extension indicator, a
	--		3 bits nature of address indicator and a 4 bits numbering
	--		plan indicator, encoded as follows:

	-- bit 8: 1  (no extension)

	-- bits 765: nature of address indicator
	--	000  unknown
	--	001  international number
	--	010  national significant number
	--	011  network specific number
	--	100  subscriber number
	--	101  reserved
	--	110  abbreviated number
	--	111  reserved for extension

	-- bits 4321: numbering plan indicator
	--	0000  unknown
	--	0001  ISDN/Telephony Numbering Plan (Rec CCITT E.164)
	--	0010  spare
	--	0011  data numbering plan (CCITT Rec X.121)
	--	0100  telex numbering plan (CCITT Rec F.69)
	--	0101  spare
	--	0110  land mobile numbering plan (CCITT Rec E.212)
	--	0111  spare
	--	1000  national numbering plan
	--	1001  private numbering plan
	--	1111  reserved for extension

	--	all other values are reserved.

	-- b)	The following octets representing digits of an address
	--		encoded as a TBCD-STRING.

TmoCallDuration			::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(3..12))
-- The contents of this field are 2^32 - 1. Variable with one digit after the comma

TmoTimeStamp			::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(10))
--
-- The contents of this field are a compact form of the UTCTime format
-- containing local time plus an offset to universal time. Binary coded
-- decimal encoding is employed for the digits to reduce the storage and
-- transmission overhead
-- e.g. yymmddhhmmsss Suuvv	
-- where
-- YY 	= 	Year 00 to 99		BCD encoded
-- MM 	= 	Month 01 to 12 	BCD encoded
-- DD	=	Day 01 to 31		BCD encoded
-- hh	=	hour 00 to 23		BCD encoded
-- mm	=	minute 00 to 59	BCD encoded
-- ss	=	second 00 to 59	BCD encoded
-- s	= 	1/ 10 of a second: 0 to 9 BCD encoded
-- S	=	Sign 0 = "+", "-"	ASCII encoded
-- hh	=	hour 00 to 23		BCD encoded
-- mm	=	minute 00 to 59	BCD encoded

{

{
	huaweiGGSN	(0),
	ciscoGGSN	(1),
	huaweiPGW	(2)
}

GROUPSMSIsoCdr DEFINITIONS ::=
BEGIN

ISOCodedCallDataModule ::= SEQUENCE
{
	fixedISO  CHOICE
	{
		mobileTerminated	[225]	IMPLICIT	SMSRecord,
		mobileOriginated	[241]	IMPLICIT	SMSRecord,
		faxReport		[249]	IMPLICIT	SMSRecord
	}
}

SMSRecord	::= SEQUENCE
{
	recordType		[1]	RecordType		OPTIONAL,
	inputOutputModule	[2]	InputOutputModule	OPTIONAL,	
	accessModule		[3]	AccessModule		OPTIONAL,
	aSubscriberNumber	[4]	ASubscriberNumber	OPTIONAL,
	bSubscriberNumber	[5]	BSubscriberNumber	OPTIONAL, 
	gSMTeleserviceCode	[6]	GSMTeleserviceCode	OPTIONAL,
	requestedSevice	[7]	RequestedSevice	OPTIONAL,
	deliveryStatus		[8]	DeliveryStatus		OPTIONAL,
	numberOfCharacters	[9]	NumberOfCharacters	OPTIONAL,
	timeOfArrivalAtSC	[10]	TimeOfArrivalAtSC	OPTIONAL,
	dateOfArrivalAtSC	[11]	DateOfArrivalAtSC	OPTIONAL,
	sCAddress		[12]	SCAddress		OPTIONAL,
	terminator		[13]	Terminator		OPTIONAL
}

-------------------------------	
RecordType		::= INTEGER (SIZE(2) CODE("HEX"))	--[1]
InputOutputModule	::= INTEGER (SIZE(1) CODE("DEC"))	--[2]
AccessModule		::= INTEGER (SIZE(1) CODE("DEC"))	--[3]
ASubscriberNumber	::= IA5STRING (SIZE(18) CODE("LEFT"))	--[4]
BSubscriberNumber	::= IA5STRING (SIZE(18) CODE("LEFT"))	--[5]
GSMTeleserviceCode	::= INTEGER (SIZE(2) CODE("HEX"))	--[6]

NumberOfCharacters	::= INTEGER (SIZE(3) CODE("DEC"))	--[9]
TimeOfArrivalAtSC	::= INTEGER (SIZE(6) CODE("DEC"))	--[10]
DateOfArrivalAtSC 	::= INTEGER (SIZE(6) CODE("DEC"))	--[11]
SCAddress		::= IA5STRING (SIZE(18) CODE("LEFT"))	--[12]
Terminator		::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(1) CODE("LEFT"))	--[13]

END

SMSCconvergent DEFINITIONS ::=
BEGIN

ISOCodedCallDataModule ::= SEQUENCE
{
	fixedISO  CHOICE
	{
		mobileTerminated	[225]	IMPLICIT	SMSRecord,
		mobileOriginated	[241]	IMPLICIT	SMSRecord,
		faxReport		[249]	IMPLICIT	SMSRecord
	}
}

SMSRecord	::= SEQUENCE
{
	recordType		[1]	RecordType		OPTIONAL,
	inputOutputModule	[2]	InputOutputModule	OPTIONAL,	
	accessModule		[3]	AccessModule		OPTIONAL,
	aSubscriberNumber	[4]	ASubscriberNumber	OPTIONAL,
	bSubscriberNumber	[5]	BSubscriberNumber	OPTIONAL, 
	gSMTeleserviceCode	[6]	GSMTeleserviceCode	OPTIONAL,
	requestedService	[7]	RequestedService	OPTIONAL,
	deliveryStatus		[8]	DeliveryStatus		OPTIONAL,
	numberOfCharacters	[9]	NumberOfCharacters	OPTIONAL,
	timeOfArrivalAtSC	[10]	TimeOfArrivalAtSC	OPTIONAL,
	dateOfArrivalAtSC	[11]	DateOfArrivalAtSC	OPTIONAL,
	sCAddress		[12]	SCAddress		OPTIONAL,
	subscriptionType	[13]	SPType		OPTIONAL,
	paymentType		[14]	SPType		OPTIONAL,
	inRatedAmount		[15]	InRatedType		OPTIONAL,
	terminator		[16]	Terminator		OPTIONAL
}
-------------------------------	
RecordType		::= INTEGER (SIZE(2) CODE("HEX"))	--[1]
InputOutputModule	::= INTEGER (SIZE(1) CODE("DEC"))	--[2]
AccessModule		::= INTEGER (SIZE(1) CODE("DEC"))	--[3]

contents:
MMTelChargingDataTypes_KKTC {itu-t (0) identified-organization (4) etsi(0) mobileDomain (0) charging (5) mMTelChargingDataTypes (9) asn1Module (0) version1 (0)}

DEFINITIONS IMPLICIT TAGS	::=

BEGIN

-- EXPORTS everything 

MMTelServiceRecord ::= CHOICE
{
    mMTelRecord  [83]    MMTelRecord,
    sCIRecord    [999]  MMTelRecord
}


MMTelRecord ::= SET
{
	recordType	[0] RecordType,
	sIP-Method	[2] SIP-Method OPTIONAL,
	role-of-Node	[3] Role-of-Node OPTIONAL,
	nodeAddress	[4] EXPLICIT NodeAddress OPTIONAL,
	session-Id	[5] Session-Id OPTIONAL,
	list-Of-Calling-Party-Address	[6] ListOfInvolvedParties OPTIONAL,	
	called-Party-Address	[7] EXPLICIT InvolvedParty OPTIONAL,
	serviceRequestTimeStamp	[9] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	serviceDeliveryStartTimeStamp	[10] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	serviceDeliveryEndTimeStamp	[11] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	recordOpeningTime	[12] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	recordClosureTime	[13] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	interOperatorIdentifiers	[14] InterOperatorIdentifierlist OPTIONAL,
	localRecordSequenceNumber	[15] LocalSequenceNumber OPTIONAL,
    recordSequenceNumber	[16] RecordSequenceNumber OPTIONAL,
	causeForRecordClosing	[17] CauseForRecordClosing OPTIONAL,
	iMS-Charging-Identifier	[19] IMS-Charging-Identifier OPTIONAL,
	list-Of-SDP-Media-Components	[21] SEQUENCE OF Media-Components-List OPTIONAL,
	serviceReasonReturnCode	[23] UTF8String OPTIONAL,
	recordExtensions	[25] ManagementExtensions OPTIONAL,
	accessNetworkInformation	[29] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
	serviceContextID	[30] ServiceContextID OPTIONAL,
	list-of-subscription-ID	[31] SEQUENCE OF SubscriptionID OPTIONAL, 
	list-Of-Early-SDP-Media-Components	[32] SEQUENCE OF Early-Media-Components-List OPTIONAL,
    numberPortabilityRouting	[34] NumberPortabilityRouting OPTIONAL,
	sessionPriority	[36] SessionPriority OPTIONAL,
	serviceRequestTimeStampFraction	[37] Milliseconds OPTIONAL,
	serviceDeliveryStartTimeStampFraction	[38] Milliseconds OPTIONAL,
	serviceDeliveryEndTimeStampFraction	[39] Milliseconds OPTIONAL,
	online-charging-flag				 [43] NULL OPTIONAL,
	userLocationInformation	[47] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
	servedPartyIPAddress				[50] EXPLICIT ServedPartyIPAddress OPTIONAL,
	iMSEmergencyIndicator			[52] NULL OPTIONAL,
	listOfReasonHeader	[55] ListOfReasonHeader OPTIONAL,
	additionalAccessNetworkInformation	[56] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
    instanceId	[57] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
	requested-Party-Address	[101] EXPLICIT InvolvedParty OPTIONAL,
	list-Of-Called-Asserted-Identity 	[102] ListOfInvolvedParties OPTIONAL,
	outgoingSessionId 	[104] Session-Id OPTIONAL,
	list-Of-AccessTransferInformation	[106] SEQUENCE OF AccessTransferInformation OPTIONAL,
	mMTelInformation	[110] MMTelInformation	OPTIONAL,
	routeHeaderReceived[59] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
	diverting-Party-Address	[111] EXPLICIT InvolvedParty OPTIONAL
}

RecordType ::= INTEGER 
{ 
--
-- Record Value 83 is MMTel specific. The contents are defined in TS 32.275 [35]
--
	mMTelRecord (83),
        sciRecord   (999)
}

LocalSequenceNumber ::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)
--
-- Sequence number of the record in this node
-- 0.. 4294967295 is equivalent to 0..232-1, unsigned integer in four octets
--

RecordSequenceNumber ::= INTEGER (1..4294967295)
--
-- Sequence number of the partial record for a given session
-- 1.. 4294967295 is equivalent to 20..232-1, unsigned integer in four octets
--

IPAddress ::= CHOICE
{
	iPBinaryAddress	IPBinaryAddress,
	iPTextRepresentedAddress	IPTextRepresentedAddress
}

IPBinaryAddress ::= CHOICE
{
	iPBinV4Address	[0] OCTET STRING (SIZE(4)),
	iPBinV6Address	[1] OCTET STRING (SIZE(16))
}

IPTextRepresentedAddress ::= CHOICE
{--
-- IP address in the familiar "dot" notation
--
	iPTextV4Address	[2] IA5String (SIZE(7..15)),
	iPTextV6Address	[3] IA5String (SIZE(15..45))
}

NodeAddress ::= CHOICE 
{
	iPAddress 	[0] EXPLICIT IPAddress,
	domainName	[1] GraphicString
}

ServiceContextID		::= UTF8String

ServedPartyIPAddress  ::=  IPAddress

NumberPortabilityRouting ::= GraphicString

PriorityCallType	::=ENUMERATED
{
	gets-fc 	(0),
	gets-an 	(1),
	gets-nt 	(2),
	gets-fc-an 	(3),
	gets-fc-nt 	(4),
	others 	(5)
}


SessionPriority ::= ENUMERATED
--
-- PRIORITY-4 is the highest priority and Priority-0 is the lowest priority.
--
{
 pRIORITY-0 (0),
 pRIORITY-1 (1),
 pRIORITY-2 (2),
 pRIORITY-3 (3),
 pRIORITY-4 (4)
}


Milliseconds ::= INTEGER (0..999)

SubscriptionID	::= SET
{
	subscriptionIDType	[0] SubscriptionIDType,
	subscriptionIDData	[1] UTF8String
}

SubscriptionIDType	::= ENUMERATED
{
	eND-USER-E164	(0),
	eND-USER-IMSI	(1),
	eND-USER-SIP-URI	(2),
	eND-USER-NAI	(3),
	eND-USER-PRIVATE	(4)
}

TimeStamp ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(9))
--
-- The contents of this field are a compact form of the UTCTime format
-- containing local time plus an offset to universal time. Binary coded
-- decimal encoding is employed for the digits to reduce the storage and
-- transmission overhead, e.g. YYMMDDhhmmssShhmm, where
-- YY = Year 00 to 99	BCD encoded
-- MM = Month 01 to 12 	BCD encoded
-- DD = Day 01 to 31	BCD encoded
-- hh = hour 00 to 23	BCD encoded
-- mm = minute 00 to 59	BCD encoded
-- ss = second 00 to 59	BCD encoded
-- S  = Sign 0 = "+", "-"	ASCII encoded
-- hh = hour 00 to 23	BCD encoded
-- mm = minute 00 to 59	BCD encoded

CauseForRecordClosing ::= ENUMERATED 
{
	serviceDeliveryEndSuccessfully	(0),
	unSuccessfulServiceDelivery	(1),
	timeLimit	(3),
      partialCDRSessionEstablished          (100),
   partialCDRDurationTimeLimit           (101),
   partialCDRAudioToVideoToggle          (501),
   partialCDRVideoToAudioToggle          (502)
}

Early-Media-Components-List ::= SEQUENCE 
{
	sDP-Offer-Timestamp 	[0] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	sDP-Answer-Timestamp	[1] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	sDP-Media-Components	[2] SEQUENCE OF SDP-Media-Component OPTIONAL,
	mediaInitiatorFlag	[3] NULL OPTIONAL,
	sDP-Session-Description	[4] SEQUENCE OF GraphicStringImp OPTIONAL,
	sDP-Type	[5] SDP-Type OPTIONAL
}

IMS-Charging-Identifier ::= OCTET STRING

InterOperatorIdentifierlist ::= SEQUENCE OF InterOperatorIdentifiers

InterOperatorIdentifiers ::= SEQUENCE 
{ 
	originatingIOI	[0] GraphicString OPTIONAL,
	terminatingIOI	[1] GraphicString OPTIONAL
}

InvolvedParty ::= CHOICE 
{
	sIP-URI	[0] GraphicString, -- refer to rfc3261 [401]
	tEL-URI	[1] GraphicString  -- refer to rfc3966 [402]
}

ListOfInvolvedParties ::= SEQUENCE OF InvolvedParty

ReasonHeaderInformation ::= GraphicStringImp

ListOfReasonHeader ::= SEQUENCE OF ReasonHeaderInformation

AccessTransferType	::= ENUMERATED
{
	pSToCS (0),
    psToPS (2),
    invalid (3)
}

AccessTransferInformation 	::= SEQUENCE

{
	accessTransferType 		 	 [0] AccessTransferType OPTIONAL,
	accessNetworkInformation 			 [1] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
	additionalAccessNetworkInformation		 [2] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL

}

Media-Components-List ::= SEQUENCE 
--
-- MediaInitiatorParty is used to identify the initiator of the media 
--
{
	sIP-Request-Timestamp 	[0] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	sIP-Response-Timestamp	[1] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	sDP-Media-Components	[2] SEQUENCE OF SDP-Media-Component OPTIONAL,
	mediaInitiatorFlag	[3] NULL OPTIONAL,

-- IN Start Charging Date
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- octets BCD coded
-- yy: year (2 digits)
-- mm: month (2 digits)
-- dd: day (2 digits)
-- example: march 14th. 1997 coded as '970314'
--

-- IN TimeStamp1
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- granularity of seconds, fractions of second are simply cut off
-- octets BCD coded
-- hh: hour (2 digits)
-- mm: minutes (2 digits)
-- ss: seconds (2 digits)
-- example: 08:27:56 coded as '082756'
--

-- IN TimeStamp2
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- octets BCD coded
-- hh: hour (2 digits)
-- mm: minutes (2 digits)
-- ss: seconds (4 digits)
-- example: 08:27:56,4 coded as '08275640'

-- MSC ID
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Signalling Point Code (SPC) Of The MSC
-- 
-- only 14 bits are relevant, the least significant 2 bits are set to 0.
-- Example: SPC = 03 - 5 - 01 - 0
-- 14 bit: 0011 101 0001 000
-- 16 bit: 0011 101 0001 000 00
-- Nibbles: 0011 1010 0010 0000
-- 2 Byte coding: 3 A 2 0

-- Other Party
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Octet 1 like octect 3 in 3GPP TS 24.008 CalledPartyBCDNumber
-- Ext. bit , type of number , number plan 
-- Subsequent octets: Digits coded as TBCD-String
-- Default value:
-- Octet 1: 	H'80
-- Subsequent octets:	H'FF

-- Basic Service
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- identical to ISDN Basic Service
-- 
-- aLL-SERVICES ISDNBasicService::= '00'H
-- sPEECH ISDNBasicService::= '01'H
-- uNRESTRICTED ISDNBasicService::= '02'H
-- aUDIO-3K1HZ ISDNBasicService::= '03'H
-- tELEPHONY-3K1HZ ISDNBasicService::= '20'H
-- tELETEXT ISDNBasicService::= '21'H
-- tELEFAX-GROUP-4 ISDNBasicService::= '22'H
-- vIDEOTEXT ISDNBasicService::= '23'H
-- vIDEOTEL ISDNBasicService::= '24'H
-- tELEFAX-GROUP-23 ISDNBasicService::= '25'H
-- tELEPHONY-7KHZ ISDNBasicService::= '26'H

-- Calling Party Number
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- content according ITU Q.763
--
-- address string, coded as specified by Q.763
-- First octet
-- BIT 8 (msb): Odd/Even indicator
-- BIT 7-1 : Nature Of Address indicator
-- Second octet
-- BIT 8 (msb): Calling party incomplete indicator
-- BIT 7-5 : Numbering Plan indicator
-- BIT 4-3 : Presentation indicator
-- BIT 2-1 : Screening
-- Following octets:
-- max. 16 octets (32 digits), each octet coded as:
-- BIT 8-5 : Address Signal 2n
-- BIT 4-1 : Address Signal 2n-1

-- Address signal
-- 0 0 0 0 digit 0
-- 0 0 0 1 digit 1
-- 0 0 1 0 digit 2
-- 0 0 1 1 digit 3
-- 0 1 0 0 digit 4
-- 0 1 0 1 digit 5
-- 0 1 1 0 digit 6
-- 0 1 1 1 digit 7
-- 1 0 0 0 digit 8
-- 1 0 0 1 digit 9
-- 1 0 1 0 spare
-- 1 0 1 1 code 11
-- 1 1 0 0 code 12
-- 1 1 0 1 spare
--    to
-- 1 1 1 1 spare

-- Spare bits are coded 0 unless indicated otherwise
-- CAMEL Destination Number
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- content according 3G TS 24.008
-- coded as specified in Q.763

-- First octet 
-- BIT 8 (msb): Odd/Even indicator 
-- BIT 7-1 : Nature Of Address indicator
-- Second octet
-- BIT 8 (msb): Internal Network Number indicator (INN ind.)
-- BIT 7-5 : Numbering Plan indicator
-- BIT 4-1 : spare
-- Following octets:
-- max. 16 octets (32 digits), each octet coded as:
-- BIT 8-5 : Address Signal 2n
-- BIT 4-1 : Address Signal 2n-1
-- Spare bits are coded 0 unless indicated otherwise.

-- Correlation ID
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- fixed length of 3 Bytes

-- Charging Infos
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- FCI Transparent Data

-- ********************************************************************************
--      File         : FCMSsmsc.asn1
--      Date         : 27-06-2007
--      Created By   : Bahadir Babacan
--
-- DESCRIPTION:
--             Brief Description of the datastructure and its aim
--             Using Systems: FCMS
--             Using  Flows: SMSC, CCNSMS
--             Creation PPM/FT Id:
-- ********************************************************************************
--             Update Comments :
-- 12.05.2009 Rattype field added, tcobabacan
-- 06.08.2009 tcscakmakci FCMS PPBR:  preMscSMSCdr CDR'lara yeni alanlar eklendi.
-- 17.06.2011 okandardogan PPM-103473 fcms spda - preSMSCdr ve postSMSCdr tipleri , 
-- FCMS OMM ile uyumlu hale getirildi. - yeni alanlar eklendi.
-- 28-12-2011 burgek : FT 116964 Cellid Uzunlugu 20 ye ikartildi.
-- 04.03.2012 burgek PPM 108451 : accumulatorid alan size guncellendi.   
-- ********************************************************************************

FCMSsmsc DEFINITIONS ::=
BEGIN

ISOCdr ::= SEQUENCE
{
	cdr  CHOICE
  	{
		preSMSCdr				[20] IMPLICIT 	PreSMSCdr,
		postSMSCdr				[30] IMPLICIT 	PostSMSCdr

 	 }
}


PreSMSCdr	::= SEQUENCE
{
	entity			[1]	Anumber			OPTIONAL,
	startTime		[2]	Time			OPTIONAL,
	duration		[3]	Duration		OPTIONAL,
	destination		[4]	Bnumber			OPTIONAL,
	rating			[5]	Rating			OPTIONAL,
	preCallAmount		[6]	PreCallAmopunt		OPTIONAL,
	iMSI			[7]	IMSI			OPTIONAL,
	equipmentId		[8]	IMEI			OPTIONAL,
	serviceType		[9]	ServiceType		OPTIONAL,
	callDirectionCode	[10]	DirectionCode		OPTIONAL,
	productType		[11]	ProductType		OPTIONAL,

LTE-R10_Syniverse

DEFINITIONS IMPLICIT TAGS	::=

BEGIN


CallEventRecord	::= CHOICE

}

SGWRecord	::= SET
{
	recordType					[0] CallEventRecordType,
	networkInitiation			[1] NetworkInitiatedPDPContext OPTIONAL,
	servedIMSI					[3] IMSI OPTIONAL,
	sGWAddress					[4] EXPLICIT GSNAddress,
	chargingID					[5] ChargingID,
	servingNodeAddress			[6] EXPLICIT SEQUENCE OF GSNAddress  OPTIONAL,
	accessPointNameNI			[7] AccessPointNameNI OPTIONAL,
	pdpPDNType					[8] PDPType OPTIONAL,
	servedPDPPDNAddress			[9] EXPLICIT PDPAddress OPTIONAL,
	dynamicAddressFlag			[11] EXPLICIT DynamicAddressFlag OPTIONAL,
	listOfTrafficVolumes		[12] EXPLICIT SEQUENCE OF ChangeOfCharCondition OPTIONAL,   
	recordOpeningTime			[13] TimeStamp,
	duration					[14] CallDuration,
	causeForRecClosing			[15] CauseForRecClosing,
	diagnostics					[16] EXPLICIT Diagnostics OPTIONAL,
	recordSequenceNumber		[17] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	nodeID						[18] NodeID OPTIONAL,
	recordExtensions			[19] ContentInfo OPTIONAL,
	localSequenceNumber			[20] LocalSequenceNumber OPTIONAL,
	apnSelectionMode			[21] APNSelectionMode OPTIONAL,
	servedMSISDN				[22] MSISDN OPTIONAL,
	chargingCharacteristics		[23] ChargingCharacteristics,
	chChSelectionMode			[24] ChChSelectionMode OPTIONAL,
	iMSsignalingContext			[25] NULL OPTIONAL,
	servingNodePLMNIdentifier	[27] PLMN-Id OPTIONAL,
	servedIMEISV				[29] IMEI OPTIONAL,
	rATType						[30] RATType OPTIONAL,
	mSTimeZone 					[31] MSTimeZone OPTIONAL,
	userLocationInformation		[32] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
	cAMELChargingInformation	[33] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
	sGWChange					[34] SGWChange OPTIONAL,
	servingNodeType				[35] SEQUENCE OF ServingNodeType OPTIONAL,
	pGWAddressUsed				[36] EXPLICIT GSNAddress OPTIONAL,
	pGWPLMNIdentifier			[37] PLMN-Id OPTIONAL,
	startTime					[38] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	stopTime					[39] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	pDNConnectionChargingID		[40] ChargingID OPTIONAL,
	iMSIunauthenticatedFlag 	[41] NULL OPTIONAL,
	userCSGInformation			[42] UserCSGInformation OPTIONAL,
	servedPDPPDNAddressExt 		[43] EXPLICIT PDPAddress OPTIONAL,
	lowPriorityIndicator		[44] NULL OPTIONAL,
	dynamicAddressFlagExt		[47] DynamicAddressFlag OPTIONAL,
	operatorSpecificFields		[399] TurkcellSpecificFields OPTIONAL
}

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--
--  GPRS DATA TYPES
--
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

AccessPointNameNI	::= IA5String (SIZE(1..63))
	--
	-- Network Identifier part of APN in  dot representation.
	-- For example, if the complete APN is 'apn1a.apn1b.apn1c.mnc022.mcc111.gprs'
	-- NI is 'apn1a.apn1b.apn1c' and is presented in this form in the CDR..

AddressString ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1..20))
	-- This type is used to represent a number for addressing
	-- purposes. It is composed of
	--	a)	one octet for nature of address, and numbering plan
	--		indicator.
	--	b)	digits of an address encoded as TBCD-String.

	-- a)	The first octet includes a one bit extension indicator, a
	--		3 bits nature of address indicator and a 4 bits numbering
	--		plan indicator, encoded as follows:

	-- bit 8: 1  (no extension)

	-- bits 765: nature of address indicator
	--	000  unknown
	--	001  international number
	--	010  national significant number
	--	011  network specific number
	--	100  subscriber number
	--	101  reserved
	--	110  abbreviated number
	--	111  reserved for extension

	-- bits 4321: numbering plan indicator
	--	0000  unknown
	--	0001  ISDN/Telephony Numbering Plan (Rec CCITT E.164)
	--	0010  spare
	--	0011  data numbering plan (CCITT Rec X.121)
	--	0100  telex numbering plan (CCITT Rec F.69)
	--	0101  spare
	--	0110  land mobile numbering plan (CCITT Rec E.212)
	--	0111  spare
	--	1000  national numbering plan
	--	1001  private numbering plan
	--	1111  reserved for extension

	--	all other values are reserved.

	-- b)	The following octets representing digits of an address
	--		encoded as a TBCD-STRING.	

AFChargingIdentifier ::= OCTET STRING
    --
    -- see AF-Charging-Identifier AVP as defined in TS 29.214[221]
    --

AFRecordInformation	::= SEQUENCE
{
	aFChargingIdentifier		[1] AFChargingIdentifier,
	flows						[2] Flows OPTIONAL
}

APNSelectionMode ::= ENUMERATED
{
	--
	-- See Information Elements TS 29.060 [75], TS 29.274 [91] or TS 29.275 [92]
	--
	mSorNetworkProvidedSubscriptionVerified	(0),
	mSProvidedSubscriptionNotVerified	(1),
	networkProvidedSubscriptionNotVerified	(2)
}

CallEventRecordType 	::= INTEGER 
{ 
--

--	Record values 18..22 are GPRS specific.
--	The contents are defined in TS 32.251 [11]
--
	sgsnPDPRecord		(18),
--	ggsnPDPRecord		(19),
--	sgsnMMRecord		(20),
--	sgsnSMORecord		(21),
--	sgsnSMTRecord		(22),
-- 
--  Record values 26..28 are GPRS-LCS specific.
--	The contents are defined in TS 32.251 [11]
--
--	sgsnMtLCSRecord		(26),
--	sgsnMoLCSRecord     	(27),
--  sgsnNiLCSRecord     	(28),
--
--  Record values 70 is for Flow based Charging
--  The contents are defined in TS 32.251 [11]
--
--
--  Record values 63..69, 70, 82 are IMS specific.
--  The contents are defined in TS 32.260 [20]
--
	egsnPDPRecord		(70),
--
--  Record values 76..79 are MBMS specific.
--  The contents are defined in TS 32.251 [11]
--  Record values 76 and 77 are MBMS bearer context specific
--
--	sgsnMBMSRecord		(76),
--	ggsnMBMSRecord		(77),
--	
--  Record values 84..85 are EPC specific.
--  The contents are defined in TS 32.251 [11]
--
	sGWRecord		(84),
	pGWRecord		(85)
}

Diagnostics					::= CHOICE
{
	gsm0408Cause				[0] INTEGER,
	-- See TS 24.008 [208]	

	gsm0902MapErrorValue			[1] INTEGER,
	-- Note: The value to be stored here corresponds to
	-- the local values defined in the MAP-Errors and 
	-- MAP-DialogueInformation modules, for full details
	-- see TS 29.002 [214].

	itu-tQ767Cause				[2] INTEGER,
	-- See Q.767 [309]	

	networkSpecificCause			[3] ManagementExtension,
	-- To be defined by network operator	

	manufacturerSpecificCause		[4] INTEGER,
	-- To be defined by manufacturer	
	
	positionMethodFailureCause	[5] PositionMethodFailure-Diagnostic,
	-- see TS 29.002 [214]
	unauthorizedLCSClientCause	[6] UnauthorizedLCSClient-Diagnostic
	-- see TS 29.002 [214]
}

TimeStamp ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(9))
	--
	-- The contents of this field are a compact form of the UTCTime format
	-- containing local time plus an offset to universal time. Binary coded
	-- decimal encoding is employed for the digits to reduce the storage and
	-- transmission overhead
	-- e.g. YYMMDDhhmmssShhmm
	-- where
	-- YY 	= 	Year 00 to 99		BCD encoded
	-- MM 	= 	Month 01 to 12 	BCD encoded
	-- DD	=	Day 01 to 31		BCD encoded
	-- hh	=	hour 00 to 23		BCD encoded
	-- mm	=	minute 00 to 59	BCD encoded
	-- ss	=	second 00 to 59	BCD encoded
	-- S	=	Sign 0 = "+", "-"	ASCII encoded
	-- hh	=	hour 00 to 23		BCD encoded
	-- mm	=	minute 00 to 59	BCD encoded
	--

CauseForRecClosing	::= INTEGER
{
	--
	-- In PGW-CDR and SGW-CDR the value servingNodeChange is used for partial record
	-- generation due to Serving Node Address list Overflow
	-- In SGSN servingNodeChange indicates the SGSN change	-- 
	-- 
	-- LCS related causes belong to the MAP error causes acc. TS 29.002 [60]
	--
	-- cause codes 0 to 15 are defined 'CauseForTerm' (cause for termination)
	--
	normalRelease					(0),
	abnormalRelease					(4),
	cAMELInitCallRelease			(5),
	volumeLimit						(16),
	timeLimit						(17),
	servingNodeChange				(18),
	maxChangeCond					(19),
	managementIntervention	    	(20),
   	intraSGSNIntersystemChange		(21),
	rATChange						(22),
	mSTimeZoneChange				(23),
	sGSNPLMNIDChange 				(24),
   	unauthorizedRequestingNetwork	(52),
	unauthorizedLCSClient			(53),
	positionMethodFailure			(54),
	unknownOrUnreachableLCSClient	(58),
	listofDownstreamNodeChange		(59)
}

ChangeCondition	::= ENUMERATED
{
	--
	-- Failure Handling values used in eGCDR only
	--
	qoSChange								(0),
	tariffTime								(1),
	recordClosure							(2),
	failureHandlingContinueOngoing			(3),
	failureHandlingRetryandTerminateOngoing	(4),
	failureHandlingTerminateOngoing	   		(5),
	cGI-SAICHange							(6),    -- bearer modification. "CGI-SAI Change"
	rAIChange								(7),    -- bearer modification. "RAI Change"
	dT-Establishment						(8),
	dT-Removal								(9),
    eCGIChange								(10), 	-- bearer modification. "ECGI Change"
	tAIChange								(11), 	-- bearer modification. "TAI Change"
	userLocationChange						(12)	-- bearer modification. "User Location Change"
}

ChangeOfCharCondition	::= SEQUENCE
{
	--
	-- Used in PDP context record only
	-- failureHandlingContinue field used in eGCDR only
	--
	qosRequested					[1] EXPLICIT QoSInformation OPTIONAL,
	qosNegotiated					[2] EXPLICIT QoSInformation OPTIONAL,
	dataVolumeGPRSUplink			[3] DataVolumeGPRS OPTIONAL,
	dataVolumeGPRSDownlink			[4] DataVolumeGPRS OPTIONAL,
	changeCondition					[5] ChangeCondition,
	changeTime						[6] TimeStamp,
	failureHandlingContinue			[7] FailureHandlingContinue OPTIONAL,
	userLocationInformation			[8] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
	ePCQoSInformation				[9] EPCQoSInformation OPTIONAL
}

ChargingCharacteristics	::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))
    --
	--	Bit 0-3: Profile Index
	--	Bit 4-15: For Behavior
	--

ChargingID	::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)
	--
	-- Generated in P-GW, part of IP CAN bearer
	-- 0..4294967295 is equivalent to 0..2**32-1
	--

ChChSelectionMode ::= ENUMERATED
{
	servingNodeSupplied		(0),	-- For S-GW/P-GW
	subscriptionSpecific		(1),	-- For SGSN only
	aPNSpecific			(2),	-- For SGSN only

BCD-STRING ::= OCTET STRING

TBCD-STRING ::= OCTET STRING
	-- This type (Telephony Binary Coded Decimal String) is used to
	-- represent several digits from 0 through 9, *, #, a, b, c, two
	-- digits per octet, each digit encoded 0000 to 1001 (0 to 9),
	-- 1010 (*), 1011 (#), 1100 (a), 1101 (b) or 1110 (c); 1111 used
	-- as filler when there is an odd number of digits.

	-- bits 8765 of octet n encoding digit 2n
	-- bits 4321 of octet n encoding digit 2(n-1) +1

PositionMethodFailure-Diagnostic ::= ENUMERATED {

	-- charging protocol return value, range of 4 byte (0...4294967295)

ServiceConditionChange	::= BIT STRING 
--{
--
--	qoSChange 								(0),	-- bearer modification
--	sGSNChange 								(1), 	-- bearer modification
--	sGSNPLMNIDChange 						(2), 	-- bearer modification
--	tariffTimeSwitch 						(3), 	-- tariff time change
--	pDPContextRelease 						(4), 	-- bearer release
--	rATChange 								(5),	-- bearer modification
--	serviceIdledOut 						(6),	-- IP flow idle out, DCCA QHT expiry
--	reserved1 								(7),	-- old: QCTexpiry is no report event
--	configurationChange 					(8),	-- configuration change
--	serviceStop 							(9), 	-- IP flow termination
--	dCCATimeThresholdReached 				(10),	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
--	dCCAVolumeThresholdReached 				(11), 	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
--	dCCAServiceSpecificUnitThresholdReached	(12), 	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
--	dCCATimeExhausted 						(13), 	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
--	dCCAVolumeExhausted 					(14), 	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
--	dCCAValidityTimeout 					(15), 	-- DCCA quota validity time (QVT expiry)
--	reserved2								(16),	-- reserved due to no use case, 
--													-- old: return Requested is covered by (17),(18)
--	dCCAReauthorisationRequest 				(17), 	-- DCCA quota reauthorization request by OCS
--	dCCAContinueOngoingSession 				(18), 	-- DCCA failure handling (CCFH),
--													-- continue IP flow
--	dCCARetryAndTerminateOngoingSession		(19), 	-- DCCA failure handling (CCFH),
--													-- terminate IP flow after DCCA retry
--	dCCATerminateOngoingSession 			(20), 	-- DCCA failure handling,
--													-- terminate IP flow
--	cGI-SAIChange							(21), 	-- bearer modification. "CGI-SAI Change"
--	rAIChange								(22), 	-- bearer modification. "RAI Change"
--	dCCAServiceSpecificUnitExhausted		(23), 	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
--	recordClosure							(24),	-- PGW-CDR closure
--	timeLimit								(25),	-- intermediate recording
--	volumeLimit								(26),	-- intermediate recording
--	serviceSpecificUnitLimit				(27),	-- intermediate recording
--	envelopeClosure 						(28),
--        eCGIChange							(29), 	-- bearer modification. "ECGI Change"
--	tAIChange								(30), 	-- bearer modification. "TAI Change"
--	userLocationChange						(31)	-- bearer modification. "User Location Change"
--
--} 
--

-- Trigger and cause values for IP flow level recording are defined for support of independent
-- online and offline charging and also for tight interworking between online and offline charging.
-- Unused bits will always be zero.
-- Some of the values are non-exclusive (e.g. bearer modification reasons).
--

-- containers opened after the failure handling execution.

	-- Defined in 23.003[200]. Coded according to TS 29.060[215] for GTP, and in TS 29.274 [223]
	-- for eGTP.

	--

	cSGAccessMode				[1] CSGAccessMode,
	cSGMembershipIndication 	[2] NULL OPTIONAL
}

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--
--  TMO EXPAND
--
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TmoCallDuration			::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(3..12))
-- The contents of this field are 2^32 - 1. Variable with one digit after the comma
-- Value is in seconds with one digit after the comma


TmoTimeStamp			::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(10))
--
-- The contents of this field are a compact form of the UTCTime format
-- containing local time plus an offset to universal time. Binary coded
-- decimal encoding is employed for the digits to reduce the storage and
-- transmission overhead
-- e.g. yymmddhhmmsss Suuvv	
-- where
-- YY 	= 	Year 00 to 99		BCD encoded
-- MM 	= 	Month 01 to 12 	BCD encoded
-- DD	=	Day 01 to 31		BCD encoded
-- hh	=	hour 00 to 23		BCD encoded
-- mm	=	minute 00 to 59	BCD encoded
-- ss	=	second 00 to 59	BCD encoded
-- s	= 	1/ 10 of a second: 0 to 9 BCD encoded
-- S	=	Sign 0 = "+", "-"	ASCII encoded
-- hh	=	hour 00 to 23		BCD encoded
-- mm	=	minute 00 to 59	BCD encoded  

ChangeTimeEvent ::= SEQUENCE
{
	changeTime  			[1]  	TmoTimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	changeTimeTimeZone		[2] 	INTEGER OPTIONAL	
}

CallDuration 			::= INTEGER
--
-- The call duration is counted in seconds. 
-- For successful calls /sessions / PDP contexts, this is the chargeable duration.
-- For call attempts this is the call holding time.


TurkcellSpecificFields	::= SEQUENCE
{
	--
	-- Added Container for Turkcell Specific Fields
	--
	sGWUniqueKey     		[1] SGWUniqueKey OPTIONAL

}

SGWUniqueKey ::= IA5STRING(SIZE(20))    

Matched ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (2) CODE ("LEFT"))

SourceDataNodeType	::= ENUMERATED
{
	huaweiGGSN	(0),
	ciscoGGSN	(1),
	huaweiPGW	(2)
}

END

GSNAddress	::= IPAddress

IPAddress	::= CHOICE
{
	iPBinaryAddress	 IPBinaryAddress OPTIONAL,
	iPTextRepresentedAddress	 IPTextRepresentedAddress OPTIONAL
}

IPBinaryAddress	::= CHOICE
{
	iPBinV4Address			[0] IPBinV4Address,
	iPBinV6Address			    IPBinV6AddressWithOrWithoutPrefixLength OPTIONAL
}

IPBinV4Address	::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(4))

IPBinV6Address	::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(30))

IPBinV6AddressWithOrWithoutPrefixLength ::= CHOICE
{      
       iPBinV6Address             [1] IPBinV6Address OPTIONAL,
       iPBinV6AddressWithPrefix   IPBinV6AddressWithPrefixLength OPTIONAL
}

IPBinV6AddressWithPrefixLength ::= SEQUENCE
{
       iPBinV6Address                    IPBinV6Address OPTIONAL,
       pDPAddressPrefixLength            PDPAddressPrefixLength OPTIONAL
}

IPTextRepresentedAddress	::= CHOICE
{	--
	-- IP address in the familiar "dot" notation
	--
	iPTextV4Address		[2] IA5String (SIZE(7..15)),
	iPTextV6Address		[3] IA5String (SIZE(15..45))
}

ChargingCharacteristics	::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))

ChargingID	::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)
--
-- Generated in P-GW, part of IP-CAN bearer
-- 0..4294967295 is equivalent to 0..2**32-1
--

ChargingRuleBaseName	::= IA5String
-- 
-- identifier for the group of charging rules
-- see Charging-Rule-Base-Name AVP as desined in TS 29.212 [220]
--

AccessPointNameNI	::= IA5String (SIZE(1..63))
--
-- Network Identifier part of APN in  dot representation.
-- For example, if the complete APN is 'apn1a.apn1b.apn1c.mnc022.mcc111.gprs'
-- NI is 'apn1a.apn1b.apn1c' and is presented in this form in the CDR.
--

AccessPointNameOI	::= IA5String (SIZE(1..37))
--
-- Operator Identifier part of APN in dot representation.
-- In the 'apn1a.apn1b.apn1c.mnc022.mcc111.gprs' example, the OI portion is 'mnc022.mcc111.gprs'
-- and is presented in this form in the CDR.
--

AdditionalExceptionReports      ::= ENUMERATED
{
    notAllowed      (0),
    allowed         (1)
}


APNRateControl      ::= SEQUENCE
--
-- See TS 24.008 [208] for more information
--
{
    aPNRateControlUplink    [0] APNRateControlParameters OPTIONAL,
    aPNRateControlDownlink  [1] APNRateControlParameters OPTIONAL
}

APNRateControlParameters        ::= SEQUENCE
{
    additionalExceptionReports  [0] AdditionalExceptionReports OPTIONAL, --only for aPNRateControlUplink
    rateControlTimeUnit         [1] RateControlTimeUnit OPTIONAL,
    rateControlMaxRate          [2] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
    rateControlMaxMessageSize   [3] DataVolumeGPRS OPTIONAL --aPNRateControlDownlink only holds the maximum data PDU size in octets
}


PDPAddress		::= CHOICE
{
	iPAddress				[0] IPAddress
--	eTSIAddress				[1] ETSIAddress
--								has only been used in earlier releases for X.121 format
}

PDPType		::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))
--
-- OCTET 1: PDP Type Organization
-- OCTET 2: PDP/PDN Type Number
-- See TS 29.060 [215] for encoding details.
--

PLMN-Id		::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (3))
--
--	This is in the same format as octets 2,3,and 4 of the Routing Area Identity (RAI) IE specified
--	in TS 29.060 [215]
--

DynamicAddressFlag	::= BOOLEAN

ChangeOfCharCondition	::= SEQUENCE
--
-- qosRequested and qosNegotiated are used in S-CDR only
-- ePCQoSInformation used in SGW-CDR ,PGW-CDR, IPE-CDR and ePDG only
-- userLocationInformation is used only in S-CDR, SGW-CDR and PGW-CDR
-- chargingID used in PGW-CDR only when Charging per IP-CAN session is active
--
{
	qosRequested				[1] QoSInformation OPTIONAL,
	qosNegotiated				[2] QoSInformation OPTIONAL,
	dataVolumeGPRSUplink		[3] DataVolumeGPRS OPTIONAL,
	dataVolumeGPRSDownlink		[4] DataVolumeGPRS OPTIONAL,
	changeCondition				[5] ChangeCondition,
	changeTime					[6] TimeStamp,
	userLocationInformation		[8] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL,
	ePCQoSInformation			[9] EPCQoSInformation OPTIONAL,
	chargingID					[10] ChargingID OPTIONAL,
	presenceReportingAreaStatus [11] PresenceReportingAreaStatus OPTIONAL,

TBCD-STRING ::= OCTET STRING
	-- This type (Telephony Binary Coded Decimal String) is used to
	-- represent several digits from 0 through 9, *, #, a, b, c, two
	-- digits per octet, each digit encoded 0000 to 1001 (0 to 9),
	-- 1010 (*), 1011 (#), 1100 (a), 1101 (b) or 1110 (c); 1111 used
	-- as filler when there is an odd number of digits.

	-- bits 8765 of octet n encoding digit 2n
	-- bits 4321 of octet n encoding digit 2(n-1) +1

AddressString ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1..20))
	-- This type is used to represent a number for addressing
	-- purposes. It is composed of
	--	a)	one octet for nature of address, and numbering plan
	--		indicator.
	--	b)	digits of an address encoded as TBCD-String.

	-- a)	The first octet includes a one bit extension indicator, a
	--		3 bits nature of address indicator and a 4 bits numbering
	--		plan indicator, encoded as follows:

	-- bit 8: 1  (no extension)

	-- bits 765: nature of address indicator
	--	000  unknown
	--	001  international number
	--	010  national significant number
	--	011  network specific number
	--	100  subscriber number
	--	101  reserved
	--	110  abbreviated number
	--	111  reserved for extension

	-- bits 4321: numbering plan indicator
	--	0000  unknown
	--	0001  ISDN/Telephony Numbering Plan (Rec ITU-T E.164)
	--	0010  spare
	--	0011  data numbering plan (ITU-T Rec X.121)
	--	0100  telex numbering plan (ITU-T Rec F.69)
	--	0101  spare
	--	0110  land mobile numbering plan (ITU-T Rec E.212)
	--	0111  spare
	--	1000  national numbering plan
	--	1001  private numbering plan
	--	1111  reserved for extension

	--	all other values are reserved.

	-- b)	The following octets representing digits of an address
	--		encoded as a TBCD-STRING.



ISDN-AddressString ::= 
			AddressString (SIZE (1..9))
	-- This type is used to represent ISDN numbers.



FTN-AddressString ::= 
			AddressString (SIZE (1..15))
	-- This type is used to represent forwarded-to numbers. 
	-- If NAI = international the first digits represent the country code (CC)
	-- and the network destination code (NDC) as for E.164.



ISDN-SubaddressString ::= 
			OCTET STRING (SIZE (1..21))
	-- This type is used to represent ISDN subaddresses.
	-- It is composed of
	--	a)	one octet for type of subaddress and odd/even indicator.
	--	b)	20 octets for subaddress information.

	--	a)	The first octet includes a one bit extension indicator, a
	--		3 bits type of subaddress and a one bit odd/even indicator,
	--		encoded as follows:

	--	bit 8: 1  (no extension)

	--	bits 765: type of subaddress
	--		000  NSAP (X.213/ISO 8348 AD2)
	--		010  User Specified
	--		All other values are reserved

	--	bit 4: odd/even indicator
	--		0  even number of address signals
	--		1  odd number of address signals
	--		The odd/even indicator is used when the type of subaddress
	--		is "user specified" and the coding is BCD.

	--	bits 321: 000 (unused)

	--	b) Subaddress information.
	--	The NSAP X.213/ISO8348AD2 address shall be formatted as specified
	--	by octet 4 which contains the Authority and Format Identifier
	--	(AFI). The encoding is made according to the "preferred binary
	--	encoding" as defined in X.213/ISO834AD2. For the definition
	--	of this type of subaddress, see ITU-T Rec I.334.

	--	For User-specific subaddress, this field is encoded according
	--	to the user specification, subject to a maximum length of 20
	--	octets. When interworking with X.25 networks BCD coding should
	--	be applied.

	configurationChange 					 (8),	-- configuration change

													-- Change-Condition AVP
	dCCATimeThresholdReached 				(10),	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
	dCCAVolumeThresholdReached 				(11),	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
	dCCAServiceSpecificUnitThresholdReached	(12),	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
	dCCATimeExhausted 						(13),	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
	dCCAVolumeExhausted 					(14),	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
	dCCAValidityTimeout 					(15),	-- DCCA quota validity time (QVT expiry)
	reserved1								(16),	-- reserved due to no use case,
													-- old: return Requested is covered by (17),(18)

	dCCAContinueOngoingSession 				(18),	-- DCCA failure handling (CCFH),
													-- continue IP flow
	dCCARetryAndTerminateOngoingSession		(19),	-- DCCA failure handling (CCFH),
													-- terminate IP flow after DCCA retry
	dCCATerminateOngoingSession 			(20),	-- DCCA failure handling,
													-- terminate IP flow

	rAIChange								(22),	-- bearer modification. "RAI Change"
	dCCAServiceSpecificUnitExhausted		(23),	-- DCCA quota reauthorization
	recordClosure							(24),	-- PGW-CDR closure
	timeLimit								(25),	-- intermediate recording. From "Service Data
													-- Time Limit" Change-Condition AVP value
	volumeLimit								(26),	-- intermediate recording.From "Service Data
													-- Volume Limit" Change-Condition AVP value
	serviceSpecificUnitLimit				(27),	-- intermediate recording
	envelopeClosure 						(28),	
	eCGIChange								(29),	-- bearer modification. "ECGI Change"
	tAIChange								(30),	-- bearer modification. "TAI Change"
	userLocationChange						(31),	-- bearer modification. "User Location Change"
	userCSGInformationChange				(32),	-- bearer modification. "User CSG info Change"
	presenceInPRAChange					    (33),	-- bearer modification. "Change of UE Presence
													-- in Presence Reporting Area"
    servingPLMNRateControlChange            (36),   -- bearer modification. "Serving PLMNRate
                                                    -- Control Change"
    aPNRateControlChange                    (37)    -- bearer modification. "APN Rate ControlChange

}
--
-- Trigger and cause values for IP flow level recording are defined for support of independent
-- online and offline charging and also for tight interworking between online and offline charging.
-- Unused bits will always be zero.
-- Some of the values are non-exclusive (e.g. bearer modification reasons).
--

FailureHandlingContinue		::= BOOLEAN
--
-- This parameter is included when the failure handling procedure has been executed and new 
-- containers are opened. This parameter shall be included in the first and subsequent 
-- containers opened after the failure handling execution.
--

ServiceIdentifier	::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)
--
-- The service identifier is used to identify the service or the service component
-- the service data flow relates to. See Service-Identifier AVP as defined in TS 29.212 [220]
--

AFChargingIdentifier	::= OCTET STRING
--
-- see AF-Charging-Identifier AVP as defined in TS 29.214[221]
--
AFRecordInformation	::= SEQUENCE
{
	aFChargingIdentifier		[1] AFChargingIdentifier,
	flows			        [2] Flows OPTIONAL
}

Flows		::= 	SEQUENCE
--
-- See Flows AVP as defined in TS 29.214 [221]
--
{
	mediaComponentNumber	[1] INTEGER,
	flowNumber  			[2] SEQUENCE OF INTEGER OPTIONAL
}

EventBasedChargingInformation		::= SEQUENCE
{
	numberOfEvents		[1] INTEGER,
	eventTimeStamps  	[2] SEQUENCE OF TimeStamp OPTIONAL
}

TimeQuotaMechanism		::= SEQUENCE
{
	timeQuotaType					[1] TimeQuotaType,
	baseTimeInterval				[2] INTEGER
}

TimeQuotaType		::= ENUMERATED
{
	dISCRETETIMEPERIOD			(0),
	cONTINUOUSTIMEPERIOD		(1)
}

ServiceSpecificInfo  ::=  SEQUENCE
{
	serviceSpecificData		[0] OCTET STRING OPTIONAL, 
	serviceSpecificType		[1] INTEGER OPTIONAL
}

ADCRuleBaseName		::= IA5String
-- 
-- identifier for the group of charging rules
-- see ADC-Rule-Base-Name AVP as desined in TS 29.212 [220]
--

SubscriptionID	::= SET
{
	subscriptionIDType	[0]	SubscriptionIDType,
	subscriptionIDData	[1]	UTF8String
}

SubscriptionIDType	::= ENUMERATED
{
	eND-USER-E164		(0),
	eND-USER-IMSI		(1),
	eND-USER-SIP-URI	(2),
	eND-USER-NAI		(3),
	eND-USER-PRIVATE	(4)
}
