	routingAreaLastSM	[103] RoutingAreaCode		OPTIONAL,
	cellIdentityLastSM	[104] CellId			OPTIONAL
}

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--  COMMON DATA TYPES
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

AccessPointName ::= IA5String (SIZE(1..63))
        --
        --logical (domain) name in "dot" representation
        -- see TS GSM 09.60
        --

AddressString ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1..20))
        -- This type is used to represent a number for addressing
        -- purposes. It is composed of
        --      a)      one octet for nature of address, and numbering plan
        --              indicator.
        --      b)      digits of an address encoded as TBCD-String.

        --      a)   The first octet includes a one bit extension indicator, a
        --              3 bits nature of address indicator and a 4 bits numbering
        --              plan indicator, encoded as follows:

        -- bit 8: 1  (no extension)

        -- bits 765: nature of address indicator
        --      000  unknown
        --      001  international number
        --      010  national significant number
        --      011  network specific number
        --      100  subscriber number
        --      101  reserved
        --      110  abbreviated number
        --      111  reserved for extension

        -- bits 4321: numbering plan indicator
        --      0000  unknown
        --      0001  ISDN/Telephony Numbering Plan (Rec CCITT E.164)
        --      0010  spare
        --      0011  data numbering plan (CCITT Rec X.121)
        --      0100  telex numbering plan (CCITT Rec F.69)
        --      0101  spare
        --      0110  land mobile numbering plan (CCITT Rec E.212)
        --      0111  spare
        --      1000  national numbering plan
        --      1001  private numbering plan
        --      1111  reserved for extension

        --      all other values are reserved.

        -- b)   The following octets representing digits of an address
        --              encoded as a TBCD-STRING.

BasicServiceCode ::= CHOICE
{
        bearerService   [2] BearerServiceCode,
        teleservice     [3] TeleserviceCode
}

BearerServiceCode ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1))
        -- This type is used to represent the code identifying a single
        -- bearer service, a group of bearer services, or all bearer
        -- services. The services are defined in TS GSM 02.02.
        -- The internal structure is defined as follows:
        --
        -- v1: bit 8: Transparency indicator (If applicable)
        --      0       transparent (postfix T) or if not applicable
        --              (no postfix T or NT)
        --      1       non transparent (postfix NT)
        --
        -- v2: bit 8: 0 (unused)
        -- plmn-specific bearer services:
        -- bits 87654321: defined by the HPLMN operator
        -- rest of bearer services:
        --
        -- bits 7654321: group (bits 7654), and rate, if applicable
        -- (bits 321)
        -- symbolic constants are assigned only for v2

CallDuration ::= INTEGER
        -- The call duration in seconds. 
        -- For successful calls this is the chargeable duration.
        -- For call attempts this is the call holding time.

CallEventRecordType     ::= ENUMERATED
{ 
        moCallRecord	(0),
        mtCallRecord	(1),
        roamingRecord	(2),
        incGatewayRecord	(3),
        outGatewayRecord	(4),
        transitCallRecord	(5),
        moSMSRecord	(6),
        mtSMSRecord	(7),
        moSMSIWRecord	(8),
        mtSMSGWRecord	(9),
        ssActionRecord	(10),
        hlrIntRecord	(11),
        termCAMELIntRecord	(12),
        locUpdateHLRRecord	(13),
        locUpdateVLRRecord	(14),
        commonEquipRecord	(15),
        moTraceRecord	(16),
        mtTraceRecord	(17),
        sgsnPDPRecord	(18),
        ggsnPDPRecord	(19),
        sgsnMMRecord	(20),
        sgsnSMORecord                   (21),
        sgsnSMTRecord                   (22)
}

CauseForRecClosing      ::= ENUMERATED
{
        --
        -- in GGSN the value sGSNChange should be used for partial record
        -- generation due to SGSN Address List Overflow
        --
        normalRelease	(0),
        abnormalRelease	(4),
        volumeLimit	(16),
        timeLimit		(17),
        sGSNChange	(18),
        maxChangeCond	(19),
        managementIntervention	(20)
}

CellId ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))
        --
        -- Coded according to TS GSM 04.08      
        --

ChangeCondition ::= ENUMERATED
{
        qoSChange	(0),
        tariffTime		(1),
        recordClosure	(2)
}

ChangeOfCharCondition   ::= SEQUENCE
        --
        -- used in PDP context record only
        --
{
        qosRequested	[1] QoSInformation	OPTIONAL,
        qosNegotiated	[2] QoSInformation	OPTIONAL,
        dataVolumeGPRSUplink	[3] DataVolumeGPRS	OPTIONAL,
        dataVolumeGPRSDownlink	[4] DataVolumeGPRS	OPTIONAL,
        changeCondition	[5] ChangeCondition	OPTIONAL,
        changeTime	[6] TimeStamp		OPTIONAL
}

ChangeLocation  ::= SEQUENCE
        --
        -- used in SGSNMMRecord only
        --
{
        locationAreaCode	[0] LocationAreaCode	OPTIONAL,
        routingAreaCode	[1] RoutingAreaCode	OPTIONAL,
        cellId		[2] CellId		OPTIONAL,
        changeTime	[3] TimeStamp		OPTIONAL
}

ChargingID      ::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)
        --
        -- generated in GGSN, part of PDP context, see TS GSM 03.60
        -- 0..4294967295 is equivalent to 0..2**32-1

Classmark ::= OCTET STRING
        -- |-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|
        -- |  8  |  7  |  6  |  5  |  4  |  3  |  2  |  1  |
        -- |-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|
        -- |  0  | Revision  |  0  | A5/1|     RF Power    | Octet 1
        -- |Spare| Level     |Spare|     |    Capability   |
        -- |-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|
        -- |  0  | PS  | SS Screen.| SM  |  0  |  0  |  FC | Octet 2
        -- |Spare|capa.| Indicator |capa.|Spare|Spare|     |
        -- |-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|
        -- | CM3 |  0  |  0  |  0  |  0  |  0  | A5/3| A5/2| Octet 3
        -- |     |Spare|Spare|Spare|Spare|Spare|     |     |
        -- |-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|
        --
        --  See Mobile station classmark  2,  TS GSM 04.08      for further information.
        --

DataVolumeGPRS  ::= INTEGER
        --
        -- The volume of uncompressed data transferred in octets.
        --

Diagnostics ::= CHOICE
{
        gsm0408Cause	[0] INTEGER,
        -- See TS GSM 04.08     
        gsm0902MapErrorValue	[1] INTEGER,
        -- Note: The value to be stored here corresponds to
        -- the local values defined in the MAP-Errors and 
        -- MAP-DialogueInformation modules, for full details
        -- see TS GSM 09.02.
        ccittQ767Cause	[2] INTEGER,
        -- See CCITT Q.767      
        networkSpecificCause	[3] ManagementExtension,
        -- To be defined by network operator    
        manufacturerSpecificCause [4] ManagementExtension
        -- To be defined by manufacturer
}

DynamicAddressFlag      ::= BOOLEAN

ETSIAddress     ::= AddressString
        --
        --first octet for nature of address, and numbering plan indicator (3 for X.121)
        --other octets TBCD
        -- See TS GSM 09.02
        --

GSNAddress      ::= IPAddress

IMSI ::= TBCD STRING (SIZE (6..16))
        -- digits of MCC, MNC, MSIN are concatenated in this order.

        -- Observe that the string will be coded as a TBCD STRING,
        -- meaning that the order of the nibbles in each byte os swapped.
        -- This must be changed if an OCTET STRING is desired.
        -- Changing it will impact the formatter CME20R61MSCberToGSM1205ber.bfo
        -- since it only handles TBCD STRINGS

IMEI ::= TBCD STRING (SIZE (8))
        -- Refers to International Mobile Station Equipment Identity
        -- and Software Version Number (SVN) defined in TS GSM 03.03.
        -- If the SVN is not present the last octet shall contain the
        -- digit 0 and a filler.
        -- If present the SVN shall be included in the last octet.
        -- The SVN must not be present in version 1.

        -- Observe that the string will be coded as a TBCD STRING,
        -- meaning that the order of the nibbles in each byte os swapped.
        -- This must be changed if an OCTET STRING is desired.
        -- Changing it will impact the formatter CME20R61MSCberToGSM1205ber.bfo
        -- since it only handles TBCD STRINGS


IPAddress       ::= CHOICE
{
	iPBinaryAddress	IPBinaryAddress,
	iPTextRepresentedAddress	IPTextRepresentedAddress
}

IPBinaryAddress ::= CHOICE
{
        iPBinV4Address                  [0] OCTET STRING (SIZE(4)),
        iPBinV6Address                  [1] OCTET STRING (SIZE(16))
}

IPTextRepresentedAddress        ::= CHOICE
{       --
        -- IP address in the familiar "dot" notation
        --
        iPTextV4Address                 [2] IA5String (SIZE(7..15)),
        iPTextV6Address                 [3] IA5String (SIZE(15..45))
}

ISDN-AddressString ::= AddressString (SIZE (1..9))
        -- This type is used to represent ISDN numbers.

ISDN-SubaddressString ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1..21))
        -- This type is used to represent ISDN subaddresses.
        -- It is composed of
        --      a)      one octet for type of subaddress and odd/even indicator.
        --      b)      20 octets for subaddress information.

        --      a)      The first octet includes a one bit extension indicator, a
        --              3 bits type of subaddress and a one bit odd/even indicator,
        --              encoded as follows:

        --      bit 8: 1  (no extension)

        --      bits 765: type of subaddress
        --              000  NSAP (X.213/ISO 8348 AD2)
        --              010  User Specified
        --              All other values are reserved

        --      bit 4: odd/even indicator
        --              0  even number of address signals
        --              1  odd number of address signals
        --              The odd/even indicator is used when the type of subaddress
        --              is "user specified" and the coding is BCD.

        --      bits 321: 000 (unused)

        --      b) Subaddress information.
        --      The NSAP X.213/ISO8348AD2 address shall be formatted as specified
        --      by octet 4 which contains the Authority and Format Identifier
        --      (AFI). The encoding is made according to the "preferred binary
        --      encoding" as defined in X.213/ISO834AD2. For the definition
        --      of this type of subaddress, see CCITT Rec I.334.

        --      For User-specific subaddress, this field is encoded according
        --      to the user specification, subject to a maximum length of 20
        --      octets. When interworking with X.25 networks BCD coding should
        --      be applied.

LocationAreaCode ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))
        --
        -- See TS GSM 04.08
        --

ManagementExtensions ::= SET OF ManagementExtension
ManagementExtension ::= NULL
Matched ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (2) CODE ("LEFT"))
MessageReference ::= INTEGER

NumberOfForwarding ::= INTEGER (1..5)

MSISDN ::= ISDN-AddressString 
        -- 
        -- See TS GSM 03.03
        --

NetworkInitiatedPDPContext      ::= BOOLEAN
        --
        -- Set to true if PDP context was initiated from network side
        --

NodeID  ::= IA5String (SIZE(1..20))

PDPAddress      ::= CHOICE
{
        iPAddress                        [0] EXPLICIT IPAddress,
        eTSIAddress                     [1] ETSIAddress
}

PDPType         ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))
        --
        --OCTET 1: PDP Type Organization
        --OCTET 2: PDP Type Number
        -- See TS GSM 09.60
        --

QoSDelay                ::= ENUMERATED
{
        --
        -- See Quality of service TS GSM 04.08
        --
        delayClass1                             (0),
        delayClass2                             (1),
        delayClass3                             (2),
        delayClass4                             (3)
}

QoSInformation  ::=SEQUENCE
{
	reliability		[0] QoSReliability,
	delay		[1] QoSDelay,
	precedence		[2] QoSPrecedence,
	peakThroughput	[3] QoSPeakThroughput,
	meanThroughput	[4] QoSMeanThroughput
}

QoSMeanThroughput       ::= ENUMERATED
{
        --
        -- See Quality of service TS GSM 04.08
        --
        bestEffort		(0),
        mean100octetPh	(1),
        mean200octetPh	(2),
        mean500octetPh	(3),
        mean1000octetPh	(4),
        mean2000octetPh	(5),
        mean5000octetPh	(6),
        mean10000octetPh	(7),
        mean20000octetPh	(8),
        mean50000octetPh	(9),
        mean100000octetPh	(10),
        mean200000octetPh	(11),
        mean500000octetPh	(12),
        mean1000000octetPh	(13),
        mean2000000octetPh	(14),
        mean5000000octetPh	(15),
        mean10000000octetPh	(16),
        mean20000000octetPh	(17),
        mean50000000octetPh	(18)
}

QoSPeakThroughput       ::= ENUMERATED
{
        --
        -- See Quality of service TS GSM 04.08
        --
        unspecified	(0),
        upTo100OctetPs	(1),
        upTo200OctetPs	(2),
        upTo400OctetPs	(3),
        upTo800OctetPs	(4),
        upTo1600OctetPs	(5),
        upTo3200OctetPs	(6),
        upTo6400OctetPs	(7),
        upTo12800OctetPs	(8),
        upTo25600OctetPs	(9)
}

QoSPrecedence   ::= ENUMERATED
{
        --
        -- See Quality of service TS GSM 04.08
        --
        unspecified	(0),
        highPriority		(1),
        normalPriority	(2),
        lowPriority		(3)
}

QoSReliability  ::= ENUMERATED
{
        --
        -- See Quality of service TS GSM 04.08
        --
        unspecifiedReliability		(0),
        acknowledgedGTP		(1),
        unackGTPAcknowLLC		(2),
        unackGTPLLCAcknowRLC		(3),
        unackGTPLLCRLC		(4),
        unacknowUnprotectedData		(5)
}

RecordingEntity         ::= AddressString 
RecordSequenceNumber ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(3))
RoutingAreaCode ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(1))
        --
        -- See TS GSM 04.08     --
        --

SGSNChange      ::= BOOLEAN
        --
        -- present if first record after inter SGSN routing area update
        -- in new SGSN
        --

SMSResult ::= Diagnostics

SS-Code ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1))
        -- This type is used to represent the code identifying a single
        -- supplementary service, a group of supplementary services, or
        -- all supplementary services. The services and abbreviations
        -- used are defined in TS GSM 02.04. The internal structure is
        -- defined as follows:
        --
        -- bits 87654321: group (bits 8765), and specific service
        -- (bits 4321)

TeleserviceCode ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1))
        -- This type is used to represent the code identifying a single
        -- teleservice, a group of teleservices, or all teleservices. The
        -- services are defined in TS GSM 02.03.
        -- The internal structure is defined as follows:
        -- bits 87654321: group (bits 8765) and specific service
        -- (bits 4321)

TimeStamp ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(9))
        -- The contents of this field are a compact form of the UTCTime format
        -- containing local time plus an offset to universal time. Binary coded
        -- decimal encoding is employed for the digits to reduce the storage and
        -- transmission overhead
        -- e.g. YYMMDDhhmmssShhmm
        -- where
        -- YY   =       Year 00 to 99           BCD encoded
        -- MM   =       Month 01 to 12          BCD encoded
        -- DD   =       Day 01 to 31            BCD encoded
        -- hh   =       hour 00 to 23           BCD encoded
        -- mm   =       minute 00 to 59         BCD encoded
        -- ss   =       second 00 to 59         BCD encoded
        -- S    =       Sign 0 = "+", "-"               ASCII encoded
        -- hh   =       hour 00 to 23           BCD encoded
        -- mm   =       minute 00 to 59         BCD encoded
        --

APNSelectionMode ::= ENUMERATED
{
	mSorNetworkProvidedSubscriptionVerified	(0),
	mSProvidedSubscriptionNotVerified	(1),
	networkProvidedSubscriptionNotVerified	(2)
}

CAMELInformationPDP ::= SET
{
	sCFAddress 		[1] AddressString			OPTIONAL,
	serviceKey 		[2] INTEGER (0..2147483647)		OPTIONAL,
	defaultTransactionHandling	[3] DefaultGPRS-Handling	OPTIONAL,
	cAMELAccessPointNameNI 	[4] IA5String (SIZE(1..63))		OPTIONAL,
	cAMELAccessPointNameOI 	[5] IA5String (SIZE(1..37))		OPTIONAL,
	numberOfDPEncountered 	[6] INTEGER				OPTIONAL,
	levelOfCAMELService 	[7] LevelOfCAMELService			OPTIONAL,
	freeFormatData 	[8] OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..160)) 		OPTIONAL,
	fFDAppendIndicator 	[9] BOOLEAN				OPTIONAL
}
DefaultGPRS-Handling ::= ENUMERATED
{
	continueTransaction	(0),
	releaseTransaction	(1)
}
LevelOfCAMELService ::= OCTET STRING
-- LevelOfCAMELService ::= BIT STRING
--{
--      basic                   (0),
--      callDurationSupervision (1),
--      onlineCharging          (2)
--}

RatType ::= ENUMERATED
{
	gSM		(1), --(2G)
	uMTS		(2) --(3G)
}

CdrUniqueKey ::= IA5STRING
SGSNUniqueKey   ::= IA5STRING(SIZE(17))    

END

-- **********************************************************************

BEGIN

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--  CALL AND EVENT RECORDS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CallEventRecord ::= CHOICE 
{
	sgsnPDPRecord	[20] SGSNPDPRecord,

	sgsnSMORecord	[23] SGSNSMORecord,
	sgsnSMTRecord	[24] SGSNSMTRecord
}

SGSNPDPRecord   ::= SET
{
	matched		[200] IMPLICIT Matched		OPTIONAL,
	recordType		[0]  CallEventRecordType		OPTIONAL,
	networkInitiation	[1]  NetworkInitiatedPDPContext		OPTIONAL,
	anonymousAccessIndicator	[2]  BOOLEAN			OPTIONAL,
	servedIMSI		[3]  IMSI			OPTIONAL,

	ggsnAddressUsed	[11] EXPLICIT GSNAddress		OPTIONAL,

	servedPDPAddress	[14] EXPLICIT PDPAddress		OPTIONAL,

}

GGSNPDPRecord   ::= SET
{
	matched		[200] IMPLICIT Matched		OPTIONAL,

	anonymousAccessIndicator	[2]  BOOLEAN			OPTIONAL,

	sgsnAddress		[6]  EXPLICIT GSNAddress		OPTIONAL,

SGSNSMORecord   ::= SET

{

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--  COMMON DATA TYPES
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

AccessPointName ::= IA5String (SIZE(1..63))
        --
        --logical (domain) name in "dot" representation
        -- see TS GSM 09.60
        --

AccessPointNameOI ::= IA5String (SIZE(1..37))

AddressString ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1..20))
        -- This type is used to represent a number for addressing
        -- purposes. It is composed of
        --      a)      one octet for nature of address, and numbering plan
        --              indicator.
        --      b)      digits of an address encoded as TBCD-String.

        -- a)   The first octet includes a one bit extension indicator, a
        --              3 bits nature of address indicator and a 4 bits numbering
        --              plan indicator, encoded as follows:

        -- bit 8: 1  (no extension)

        -- bits 765: nature of address indicator
        --      000  unknown
        --      001  international number
        --      010  national significant number
        --      011  network specific number
        --      100  subscriber number
        --      101  reserved
        --      110  abbreviated number
        --      111  reserved for extension

        -- bits 4321: numbering plan indicator
        --      0000  unknown
        --      0001  ISDN/Telephony Numbering Plan (Rec CCITT E.164)
        --      0010  spare
        --      0011  data numbering plan (CCITT Rec X.121)
        --      0100  telex numbering plan (CCITT Rec F.69)
        --      0101  spare
        --      0110  land mobile numbering plan (CCITT Rec E.212)
        --      0111  spare
        --      1000  national numbering plan
        --      1001  private numbering plan
        --      1111  reserved for extension

        --      all other values are reserved.

        -- b)   The following octets representing digits of an address
        --              encoded as a TBCD-STRING.

APNSelectionMode ::= ENUMERATED
{
	mSorNetworkProvidedSubscriptionVerified	(0),
	mSProvidedSubscriptionNotVerified	(1),
	networkProvidedSubscriptionNotVerified	(2)
}

BasicServiceCode ::= CHOICE
{
	bearerService	[2] BearerServiceCode,
	teleservice	[3] TeleserviceCode
}

BearerServiceCode ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1))
        -- This type is used to represent the code identifying a single
        -- bearer service, a group of bearer services, or all bearer
        -- services. The services are defined in TS GSM 02.02.
        -- The internal structure is defined as follows:
        --
        -- v1: bit 8: Transparency indicator (If applicable)
        --      0       transparent (postfix T) or if not applicable
        --              (no postfix T or NT)
        --      1       non transparent (postfix NT)
        --
        -- v2: bit 8: 0 (unused)
        -- plmn-specific bearer services:
        -- bits 87654321: defined by the HPLMN operator
        -- rest of bearer services:
        --
        -- bits 7654321: group (bits 7654), and rate, if applicable
        -- (bits 321)
        -- symbolic constants are assigned only for v2

BCDDirectoryNumber ::= OCTET STRING

CallDuration ::= INTEGER
        -- The call duration in seconds. 
        -- For successful calls this is the chargeable duration.
        -- For call attempts this is the call holding time.

CallEventRecordType ::= ENUMERATED
{
	sgsnPDPRecord           (18),
	ggsnPDPRecord           (19),
	sgsnSMORecord           (21),
	sgsnSMTRecord           (22)
}

CAMELInformationPDP ::= SET
{
        sCFAddress	  [1] AddressString 	OPTIONAL,
        serviceKey		  [2] INTEGER (0..2147483647) 	OPTIONAL,
        defaultTransactionHandling  [3] DefaultGPRS-Handling 	OPTIONAL,
        cAMELAccessPointNameNI	  [4] IA5String (SIZE(1..63)) 	OPTIONAL,
        cAMELAccessPointNameOI	  [5] IA5String (SIZE(1..37)) 	OPTIONAL,
        numberOfDPEncountered	  [6] INTEGER 		OPTIONAL,
        levelOfCAMELService	  [7] LevelOfCAMELService 	OPTIONAL,
        freeFormatData	  [8] OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..160)) OPTIONAL,
        fFDAppendIndicator	  [9] BOOLEAN 		OPTIONAL
}

CauseForRecClosing ::= ENUMERATED
{
	normalRelease		(0),
	abnormalRelease	(4),
	cAMELInitCallRelease	(5),
	volumeLimit		(16),
	timeLimit		(17),
	sGSNChange		(18),
	maxChangeCond	(19),
	managementIntervention	(20)
}

ChargingCharacteristics ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))

CellId ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))
        --
        -- Coded according to TS GSM 04.08      
        --

ChangeCondition ::= ENUMERATED
{
        qoSChange	(0),
        tariffTime		(1),
        recordClosure	(2)
}

ChangeOfCharCondition   ::= SEQUENCE
        --
        -- used in PDP context record only
        --
{
        qosRequested	 [1] QoSInformation	OPTIONAL,
        qosNegotiated	 [2] QoSInformation	OPTIONAL,
        dataVolumeGPRSUplink	 [3] DataVolumeGPRS	OPTIONAL,
        dataVolumeGPRSDownlink	 [4] DataVolumeGPRS	OPTIONAL,
        changeCondition	 [5] ChangeCondition	OPTIONAL,
        changeTime	 [6] TimeStamp		OPTIONAL
}

ChangeLocation  ::= SEQUENCE
        --
        -- used in SGSNMMRecord only
        --
{
        locationAreaCode	[0] LocationAreaCode	OPTIONAL,
        routingAreaCode	[1] RoutingAreaCode	OPTIONAL,
        cellId		[2] CellId		OPTIONAL,
        changeTime	[3] TimeStamp		OPTIONAL
}

ChargingID      ::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)
        --
        -- generated in GGSN, part of PDP context, see TS GSM 03.60
        -- 0..4294967295 is equivalent to 0..2**32-1

Classmark ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..8))
        -- |-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|
        -- |  8  |  7  |  6  |  5  |  4  |  3  |  2  |  1  |
        -- |-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|
        -- |  0  | Revision  |  0  | A5/1|     RF Power    | Octet 1
        -- |Spare| Level     |Spare|     |    Capability   |
        -- |-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|
        -- |  0  | PS  | SS Screen.| SM  |  0  |  0  |  FC | Octet 2
        -- |Spare|capa.| Indicator |capa.|Spare|Spare|     |
        -- |-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|
        -- | CM3 |  0  |  0  |  0  |  0  |  0  | A5/3| A5/2| Octet 3
        -- |     |Spare|Spare|Spare|Spare|Spare|     |     |
        -- |-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|
        --
        --  See Mobile station classmark  2,  TS GSM 04.08      for further information.
        --

DataVolumeGPRS  ::= INTEGER
        --
        -- The volume of uncompressed data transferred in octets.
        --

DefaultGPRS-Handling ::= ENUMERATED
{
        continueTransaction     (0),
        releaseTransaction      (1)
}

Diagnostics ::= CHOICE
{
        gsm0408Cause	[0] INTEGER,
        -- See TS GSM 04.08     
        gsm0902MapErrorValue	[1] INTEGER,
        -- Note: The value to be stored here corresponds to
        -- the local values defined in the MAP-Errors and 
        -- MAP-DialogueInformation modules, for full details
        -- see TS GSM 09.02.
        ccittQ767Cause	[2] INTEGER,
        -- See CCITT Q.767      
        networkSpecificCause	[3] ManagementExtension,
        -- To be defined by network operator    
        manufacturerSpecificCause  [4] ManagementExtension
        -- To be defined by manufacturer
}

DynamicAddressFlag      ::= BOOLEAN

ETSIAddress     ::= AddressString
        --
        --first octet for nature of address, and numbering plan indicator (3 for X.121)
        --other octets TBCD
        -- See TS GSM 09.02
        --

GSNAddress      ::= IPAddress

IMSI ::= TBCD STRING (SIZE (6..16))
        -- digits of MCC, MNC, MSIN are concatenated in this order.

        -- Observe that the string will be coded as a TBCD STRING,
        -- meaning that the order of the nibbles in each byte os swapped.
        -- This must be changed if an OCTET STRING is desired.
        -- Changing it will impact the formatter CME20R61MSCberToGSM1205ber.bfo
        -- since it only handles TBCD STRINGS

IMEI ::= TBCD STRING (SIZE (8))
        -- Refers to International Mobile Station Equipment Identity
        -- and Software Version Number (SVN) defined in TS GSM 03.03.
        -- If the SVN is not present the last octet shall contain the
        -- digit 0 and a filler.
        -- If present the SVN shall be included in the last octet.
        -- The SVN must not be present in version 1.

        -- Observe that the string will be coded as a TBCD STRING,
        -- meaning that the order of the nibbles in each byte os swapped.
        -- This must be changed if an OCTET STRING is desired.
        -- Changing it will impact the formatter CME20R61MSCberToGSM1205ber.bfo
        -- since it only handles TBCD STRINGS


IPAddress       ::= CHOICE
{
        iPBinaryAddress	   IPBinaryAddress,
        iPTextRepresentedAddress   IPTextRepresentedAddress
}

IPBinaryAddress ::= CHOICE
{
        iPBinV4Address                  [0] OCTET STRING (SIZE(4)),
        iPBinV6Address                  [1] OCTET STRING (SIZE(16))
}

IPTextRepresentedAddress        ::= CHOICE
{       --
        -- IP address in the familiar "dot" notation
        --
        iPTextV4Address                 [2] IA5String (SIZE(7..15)),
        iPTextV6Address                 [3] IA5String (SIZE(15..45))
}

ISDN-AddressString ::= AddressString (SIZE (1..9))
        -- This type is used to represent ISDN numbers.

ISDN-SubaddressString ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1..21))
        -- This type is used to represent ISDN subaddresses.
        -- It is composed of
        --      a)      one octet for type of subaddress and odd/even indicator.
        --      b)      20 octets for subaddress information.

        --      a)      The first octet includes a one bit extension indicator, a
        --              3 bits type of subaddress and a one bit odd/even indicator,
        --              encoded as follows:

        --      bit 8: 1  (no extension)

        --      bits 765: type of subaddress
        --              000  NSAP (X.213/ISO 8348 AD2)
        --              010  User Specified
        --              All other values are reserved

        --      bit 4: odd/even indicator
        --              0  even number of address signals
        --              1  odd number of address signals
        --              The odd/even indicator is used when the type of subaddress
        --              is "user specified" and the coding is BCD.

        --      bits 321: 000 (unused)

        --      b) Subaddress information.
        --      The NSAP X.213/ISO8348AD2 address shall be formatted as specified
        --      by octet 4 which contains the Authority and Format Identifier
        --      (AFI). The encoding is made according to the "preferred binary
        --      encoding" as defined in X.213/ISO834AD2. For the definition
        --      of this type of subaddress, see CCITT Rec I.334.

        --      For User-specific subaddress, this field is encoded according
        --      to the user specification, subject to a maximum length of 20
        --      octets. When interworking with X.25 networks BCD coding should
        --      be applied.

LevelOfCAMELService ::= ENUMERATED
{
        basic		(0),
        callDurationSupervision	(1),
        onlineCharging	(2)
}

LocationAreaCode ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))
        --
        -- See TS GSM 04.08
        --

ManagementExtensions ::= SET OF ManagementExtension

ManagementExtension ::= NULL

Matched ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (2) CODE ("LEFT"))

MessageReference ::= OCTET STRING

NumberOfForwarding ::= INTEGER (1..5)

MSISDN ::= ISDN-AddressString 
        -- 
        -- See TS GSM 03.03
        --

NetworkInitiatedPDPContext      ::= BOOLEAN
        --
        -- Set to true if PDP context was initiated from network side
        --

NodeID  ::= IA5String (SIZE(1..20))

PDPAddress      ::= CHOICE
{
        iPAddress		[0] EXPLICIT IPAddress,
        eTSIAddress	[1] ETSIAddress
}

PDPType         ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))
        --
        --OCTET 1: PDP Type Organization
        --OCTET 2: PDP Type Number
        -- See TS GSM 09.60
        --

QoSDelay                ::= ENUMERATED
{
        --
        -- See Quality of service TS GSM 04.08
        --
	delayClass1                             (1),
	delayClass2                             (2),
	delayClass3                             (3),
	delayClass4                             (4)
}

QoSInformation ::= SEQUENCE
{
        gsmQosInformation       [0] GSMQoSInformation OPTIONAL,
        umtsQosInformation      [1] OCTET STRING (SIZE (12)) OPTIONAL
}

GSMQoSInformation ::=SEQUENCE
{
        reliability		[0] QoSReliability,
        delay		[1] QoSDelay,
        precedence	[2] QoSPrecedence,
        peakThroughput	[3] QoSPeakThroughput,
        meanThroughput	[4] QoSMeanThroughput
}

QoSMeanThroughput       ::= ENUMERATED
{
        --
        -- See Quality of service TS GSM 04.08
        --
        bestEffort		(0),
        mean100octetPh	(1),
        mean200octetPh	(2),
        mean500octetPh	(3),
        mean1000octetPh	(4),
        mean2000octetPh	(5),
        mean5000octetPh	(6),
        mean10000octetPh	(7),
        mean20000octetPh	(8),
        mean50000octetPh	(9),
        mean100000octetPh	(10),
        mean200000octetPh	(11),
        mean500000octetPh	(12),
        mean1000000octetPh	(13),
        mean2000000octetPh	(14),
        mean5000000octetPh	(15),
        mean10000000octetPh	(16),
        mean20000000octetPh	(17),
        mean50000000octetPh	(18)
}

QoSPeakThroughput       ::= ENUMERATED
{
        --
        -- See Quality of service TS GSM 04.08
        --
        unspecified	(0),
        upTo100OctetPs	(1),
        upTo200OctetPs	(2),
        upTo400OctetPs	(3),
        upTo800OctetPs	(4),
        upTo1600OctetPs	(5),
        upTo3200OctetPs	(6),
        upTo6400OctetPs	(7),
        upTo12800OctetPs	(8),
        upTo25600OctetPs	(9)
}

QoSPrecedence   ::= ENUMERATED
{
        --
        -- See Quality of service TS GSM 04.08
        --
        unspecified	(0),
        highPriority		(1),
        normalPriority	(2),
        lowPriority		(3)
}

QoSReliability  ::= ENUMERATED
{
        --
        -- See Quality of service TS GSM 04.08
        --
        unspecifiedReliability	(0),
        acknowledgedGTP	(1),
        unackGTPAcknowLLC	(2),
        unackGTPLLCAcknowRLC	(3),
        unackGTPLLCRLC	 (4),
        unacknowUnprotectedData	(5)
}

RecordingEntity         ::= AddressString 

RecordSequenceNumber ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(3))

RoutingAreaCode ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(1))
        --
        -- See TS GSM 04.08     --
        --

SGSNChange      ::= BOOLEAN
        --
        -- present if first record after inter SGSN routing area update
        -- in new SGSN
        --

SMSResult ::= Diagnostics

SS-Code ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1))
        -- This type is used to represent the code identifying a single
        -- supplementary service, a group of supplementary services, or
        -- all supplementary services. The services and abbreviations
        -- used are defined in TS GSM 02.04. The internal structure is
        -- defined as follows:
        --
        -- bits 87654321: group (bits 8765), and specific service
        -- (bits 4321)

SystemType ::= ENUMERATED
{
        unknown                 (0),
        iuUTRAN                 (1)
}

TeleserviceCode ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1))
        -- This type is used to represent the code identifying a single
        -- teleservice, a group of teleservices, or all teleservices. The
        -- services are defined in TS GSM 02.03.
        -- The internal structure is defined as follows:
        -- bits 87654321: group (bits 8765) and specific service
        -- (bits 4321)

TimeStamp ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(9))
        -- The contents of this field are a compact form of the UTCTime format
        -- containing local time plus an offset to universal time. Binary coded
        -- decimal encoding is employed for the digits to reduce the storage and
        -- transmission overhead
        -- e.g. YYMMDDhhmmssShhmm
        -- where
        -- YY   =       Year 00 to 99           BCD encoded
        -- MM   =       Month 01 to 12          BCD encoded
        -- DD   =       Day 01 to 31            BCD encoded
        -- hh   =       hour 00 to 23           BCD encoded
        -- mm   =       minute 00 to 59         BCD encoded
        -- ss   =       second 00 to 59         BCD encoded
        -- S    =       Sign 0 = "+", "-"               ASCII encoded
        -- hh   =       hour 00 to 23           BCD encoded
        -- mm   =       minute 00 to 59         BCD encoded
        --
LocalSequenceNumber ::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)

END

contents:
-- **********************************************************************
--      File : GPRS-Charging-Extensions-KKTC.asn1
--      No.  : 119/19001-CAA1171259
--      Date : 2006-11-27
--      Rev  : H

-- The contents of this document are subject to revision without notice due
-- to continued progress in methodology, design and manufacturing.
--
-- Ericsson AB shall have no liability for any errors or damage of any kind 
-- resulting from the use of modified versions of this document.
--
-- DESCRIPTION:
--  This is the Ericsson Multi Mediation ASN.1 structure specification for
--  the GPRS charging extensions.
--  It must be imported into the Mediator before the GSN ASN.1 specifications
--  can be used.
--
-- INSTALLATION AND  CONFIGURATION:
--  1) Put this file in /opt/BGw/<version>/datastructures
--  2) Import it into the Mediator
--
-- REVISION HISTORY:
-- Rev		Date        Author          	Action
-- PA1		2003-05-12	epktml		Creation
-- PA2		2003-06-02	epkolfo		Correction of index in PolicyControlFailureReport 
-- PA3		2003-11-14	epktml		Updates, added EXPLICITs, changed source document
-- A			2003-11-16	epktml		Full revision after basic test
-- PB1		2004-08-19	epktml		New updated POD
-- PB2		2004-09-08	epktml		Corrections, added OPTIONAL to ServiceClassItem.volumeUplink ServiceClassItem.volumeDownlink
-- C		2004-04-13	epkhper		EXPLICIT added to ccsAddress->IPAddress.
-- D		2004-11-30	epktml		Corrections in file header
-- PE1		2005-05-31	epkhper		Updated to support new source documemt, 9/155 19-CSA 113 35/1, Rev B
-- PE2		2005-08-15	epkhper		Updated to support new source documemt, 9/155 19-CSA 113 35/1, Rev C
-- E		2005-09-28	epkhper		Put in sharp revision
-- F		2005-11-28	epkpers		Updated to support new source documemt, 9/155 19-CSA 113 35/1, Rev E
-- PG1		2005-11-28	epkpers		Updated to support new source documemt, 31/155 17-CSA 113 35/2, Rev B
-- PG2		2006-06-13	epkpers		New revision of source document, RevE
-- PG3		2006-09-27	epkpers		pcsRealm and policyControlSessionId changed to IA5String, TR HH36198
-- PG4		2006-10-04	epkpers		ccsRealm and creditControlSessionId changed to IA5String, TR 
-- G		2006-10-23	epkpers		Put in skarp revision, new source document in Rev.A
-- H            2006-11-27      emamcha         Added ExtendedDiagnostics in GprsCdrExtensions for SGSNR70. 
--
-- DEVIATIONS:
-- The following has been changed, compared to the source document:
--
-- COMMON DATA TYPES
--
--  CreditControlInfo, EXPLICIT has been added to IPAddress (TAG 1)
--  
--  PolicyControlInfo, EXPLICIT has been added to IPAddress (TAG 1)
--
--  IPAddress ::= CHOICE .... added
--
--  IPBinaryAddress ::= CHOICE .... added
--
--  IPTextRepresentedAddress ::= CHOICE .... added
--
--  IPAddress,  IPBinaryAddress, IPTextRepresentedAddress and TimeStamp added
--
--  TimeStamp ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(9)) added
--  
--  pcsRealm ::= IA5String
--  policyControlSessionId ::= IA5String
--  ccsRealm ::= IA5String
--  creditControlSessionId ::= IA5String
--
-- SOURCE DOCUMENT: 
--      No. : 1/190 83-AXB 250 05/3 Uen
--      Rev : D
-- 
-- 12.11.2009 TTECH :KTTC GY offline Charging mekanizmasi icin asagidaki alanlar CGNS40Ber structure'a assign edildi.
--		listOfServiceData[i].localSequenceNumber ==> serviceContainers[i].localSequenceNumber
--		listOfServiceData[i].failureHandlingContinue ==> serviceContainers.failureHandlingContinue
-- ********************************************************************** 
GPRS-Charging-Extensions-KKTC { itu-t (0) identified-organization (4) etsi (0) reserved (127) etsi-identified-organization (0) ericsson (5) oAM (2) accounting (2) charging (0) mobileDomain (0) umts (0) packetSwitched (1) ts32015Extensions (0) version1 (1) }

DEFINITIONS IMPLICIT TAGS ::=
BEGIN

EXPORTS GprsCdrExtensions
;

GprsCdrExtensions	::= SET
{
	extendedDiagnostics     [0] EXPLICIT ExtendedDiagnostics OPTIONAL,
	chargingContainers	[1] SEQUENCE OF ChargingContainer OPTIONAL,  -- SACC 2.0, only
	creditControlInfo	[2] CreditControlInfo OPTIONAL,
	policyControlInfo	[3] PolicyControlInfo OPTIONAL,
	userCategory		[5] INTEGER OPTIONAL,
	ruleSpaceId        	[6] IA5String OPTIONAL,                     -- SACC 3.0, only
  	serviceContainers  	[7] SEQUENCE OF ServiceContainer OPTIONAL,  -- SACC 3.0, only
  	timeReports        	[8] SEQUENCE OF TimeReport OPTIONAL         -- SACC 3.0, only
}

ActiveTimeMethod ::= ENUMERATED
{
  	duration           (1),
  	inactivityIncluded (2),
  	inactivity         (3),
  	activePeriods      (4)
}

BlockItem ::= SEQUENCE 
{ 
	blocks 		[0] INTEGER, 
	blockRate 	[1] RealUnit OPTIONAL, 
	blockSize 	[2] INTEGER, 
	blockSizeType 	[3] BlockSizeType,
  	startTime     	[4] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
  	stopTime      	[5] TimeStamp OPTIONAL
} 
BlockSizeType ::= ENUMERATED 
{ 
	seconds (0), 
	bytes (1) 
} 

ChargingContainer	::= SEQUENCE
{
	changeTime			[0] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,
	listOfServices			[1] SEQUENCE OF ServiceItem OPTIONAL,
	listOfServiceClasses		[2] SEQUENCE OF ServiceClassItem OPTIONAL,
	initialCharge			[3] RealUnit OPTIONAL,
	sessionPolicy			[4] SessionPolicy OPTIONAL,
	blockItem 			[5] BlockItem OPTIONAL
}
CreditControlDiagnostics	::= ENUMERATED
{
	creditDenied 			(0),
	creditControlFailure 		(1),
	creditControlSuspended		(2),
	creditControlResumed		(3)
}
CreditControlFailureAction	::= ENUMERATED
{
	release 			(0),
	continue 			(1),
	continueFreeServices		(2),
	newCreditControlSession		(3)
}
CreditControlFailureReport	::= SEQUENCE
{
 	requestType			[0] CreditRequestType,
	requestStatus			[1] CreditRequestStatus,
	resultCode			[2] CreditResultCode OPTIONAL,
	recordNumber			[4] CreditRecordNumber OPTIONAL,	-- SACC 2.0
	startTime			[5] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,			-- SACC 2.0
	stopTime			[6] TimeStamp OPTIONAL,			-- SACC 2.0
	lastCreditGranted		[7] RealUnit OPTIONAL,			-- SACC 2.0
	creditUsed			[8] RealUnit OPTIONAL,			-- SACC 2.0
	newCreditControlSessionId 	[10] OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..255)) OPTIONAL,  -- SACC 2.0
	deferredCreditUsed		[11] RealUnit OPTIONAL,			-- SACC 2.0
  	ccRequestNumber           	[12] INTEGER OPTIONAL                 	-- SACC 3.0
}
CreditControlInfo		::= SEQUENCE
{
	creditControlEnabled		[0] BOOLEAN OPTIONAL,			-- SACC 2.0
	ccsPeer				[1] EXPLICIT IPAddress OPTIONAL,	-- SACC 2.0
	creditUnit			[2] CreditUnit OPTIONAL,		-- SACC 2.0
	creditControlDiagnostics   	[3] CreditControlDiagnostics OPTIONAL,	-- SACC 2.0
	creditDeniedAction 		[4] CreditDeniedAction OPTIONAL,	-- SACC 2.0
	creditControlFailureAction 	[5] CreditControlFailureAction OPTIONAL,  -- SACC 2.0
	creditControlFailureReport 	[6] CreditControlFailureReport OPTIONAL,
	creditControlSessionId		[7] IA5String (SIZE(1..255)) OPTIONAL,
	ccsRealm 			[8] IA5String (SIZE(1..255)) OPTIONAL
}
CreditDeniedAction	::= ENUMERATED
{
	release 			(0),
	continue 			(1),
	continueFreeServiceClasses	(2),
	continueLimitServiceClasses	(3)
}
CreditRecordNumber	::= INTEGER(0..4294967295)
CreditRequestType ::= ENUMERATED
{
	start			(0),
	interim			(1),
	stop			(2)
}
CreditRequestStatus ::= ENUMERATED
{
	unsent			(0),
	noAnswer		(1),
	failure			(2)
}
CreditResultCode ::= INTEGER
CreditUnit::= SEQUENCE
{
	unitType		[0]	CreditUnitType,
	currencyCode		[1]	CurrencyCode OPTIONAL
}
CreditUnitType ::= ENUMERATED
{
	time			(0),
	volume			(1),
	event			(2),
	money			(3)
}
CurrencyCode ::= INTEGER

DataVolumeGPRS ::= INTEGER

ExtendedDiagnostics ::= CHOICE
{
        ts48018BssgpCause	[0] INTEGER,
        ts25413RanapCause	[1] INTEGER
}

IPAddress ::= CHOICE
{
	iPBinaryAddress			IPBinaryAddress,
	iPTextRepresentedAddress	IPTextRepresentedAddress
}

BEGIN

RCFCdr	::= SEQUENCE
{
	callingPartyNumber		[1]	MSISDN				OPTIONAL,
	calledPartyNumber 		[2]	MSISDN				OPTIONAL,

END

IPBinV6Address	::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(16))

{
	iPBinV6Address                    IPBinV6Address,
	pDPAddressPrefixLength            PDPAddressPrefixLength
}

-- and the default value is 64 bits. 
-- 
--

{

	oIRestriction		(1),
	tIPresentation		(2),
	tIRestriction  		(3), 
	hOLD				(4), 
	cBarring			(5), 
	cDIVersion			(6), 
	cDIVersionNotif		(7), 
	cWaiting			(8), 
	mWaitingIndic		(9), 
	cONF				(10),
	fLexibleAlerting	(11),
	cCBS				(12),
	cCNR				(13),
	mCID				(14),
	cAT					(15),
	cUG					(16),

{

    vmscAddress                      [5]  IA5String OPTIONAL,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
    smsResult                        [6]  SMSResult OPTIONAL,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
    mapFailCause                    [7]  Unsigned32 OPTIONAL,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
    maximumOfConcatenatedSms       [8]  Unsigned32 OPTIONAL,

    dataCodingScheme                [11] DataCodingScheme OPTIONAL,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
    numberOfMessagesSent           [12] Unsigned32 OPTIONAL,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
    userdatalengthSms                [13] Unsigned32 OPTIONAL                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
}   

SMSResult ::= ENUMERATED                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
{                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
    success (0),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    failure (1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
DataCodingScheme ::= ENUMERATED                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
{                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
    aSCII (0),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
    uSC2  (8),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
    a8Bit (4)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
}  

SubscriberRole ::= ENUMERATED
{
	originating			(0),
	terminating			(1)
}

IMSChargingIdentifier ::= IA5String 

InvolvedParty ::= CHOICE 
{
	sIP-URI[0] IA5String, -- refer to rfc3261 [401]
	tEL-URI[1] IA5String  -- refer to rfc3966 [402]
}

ServiceId ::= IA5String

TimeStamp					::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(9))


ParticipantActionType ::= ENUMERATED
{
	cREATE_CONF         (0),
	jOIN_CONF           (1),
	iNVITED_INTO_CONF   (2),
	qUIT_CONF           (3)
}


Unsigned32 ::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)

Time ::= SEQUENCE
{
sec [0] Integer32,
tz [1] INTEGER(0..127)
}

Integer32 ::= INTEGER (0..2147483647)

contents:
-- **********************************************************************

GSN50 DEFINITIONS ::=
BEGIN

IMPORTS

GprsCdrExtensions

;

CallEventRecord ::= CHOICE
{

	sgsnSMORecord	[23] SGSNSMORecord,

}

SGSNPDPRecord ::= SET
{
	recordType		[0] CallEventRecordType,

	chargingID 		[10] INTEGER (0..4294967295),
	ggsnAddressUsed	[11] EXPLICIT IPAddress,
	accessPointNameNI 	[12] IA5String (SIZE(1..63))	OPTIONAL,
	pdpType 		[13] OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))	OPTIONAL,
	servedPDPAddress 	[14] EXPLICIT PDPAddress	OPTIONAL,
	listOfTrafficVolumes	[15] SEQUENCE OF ChangeOfCharCondition OPTIONAL,
	recordOpeningTime 	[16] OCTET STRING (SIZE(9)),
	duration 		[17] INTEGER,
	sgsnChange 		[18] BOOLEAN		OPTIONAL,
	causeForRecClosing 	[19] CauseForRecClosing,
	diagnostics 		[20] EXPLICIT Diagnostics	OPTIONAL,
	recordSequenceNumber 	[21] INTEGER		OPTIONAL,
	nodeID 		[22] IA5String (SIZE(1..20))	OPTIONAL,
	recordExtensions [23] ManagementExtensions OPTIONAL,
	localSequenceNumber 	[24] INTEGER (0..4294967295) OPTIONAL,
	apnSelectionMode 	[25] APNSelectionMode	OPTIONAL,
	accessPointNameOI 	[26] IA5String (SIZE(1..37))	OPTIONAL,
	servedMSISDN 		[27] OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..9)) OPTIONAL,
	chargingCharacteristics 	[28] OCTET STRING (SIZE(2)),
	ratType 		[29] RatType	OPTIONAL,
	cAMELInformationPDP 	[30] CAMELInformationPDP	OPTIONAL,
	chChSelectionMode 	[32] ChChSelectionMode	OPTIONAL,
	dynamicAddressFlag 	[33] BOOLEAN		OPTIONAL,
	pLMNIdentifier 		[101] OCTET STRING (SIZE(3))	OPTIONAL,
	mSTimeZone 		[102] OCTET STRING (SIZE(2)) OPTIONAL,
	matched 		[200] IMPLICIT INTEGER	OPTIONAL
}

SGSNSMORecord ::= SET
{
	recordType 		[0] CallEventRecordType,
	servedIMSI 		[1] TBCD STRING (SIZE (3..8)),
	servedIMEI 		[2] TBCD STRING (SIZE (8))	OPTIONAL,
	servedMSISDN 		[3] OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..9))	OPTIONAL,
	msNetworkCapability 	[4] OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..8))	OPTIONAL,
	serviceCentre		[5] TBCD STRING	OPTIONAL,
	recordingEntity		[6] TBCD STRING	OPTIONAL,
	locationArea 		[7] OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))	OPTIONAL,
	routingArea 		[8] OCTET STRING (SIZE(1))	OPTIONAL,
	cellIdentifier 		[9] OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))	OPTIONAL,
	messageReference	[10] OCTET STRING	OPTIONAL,
	eventTimeStamp 	[11] OCTET STRING (SIZE(9)),
	smsResult 		[12] EXPLICIT SMSResult	OPTIONAL,
	nodeID 		[14] IA5String (SIZE(1..20))	OPTIONAL,
	localSequenceNumber 	[15] INTEGER (0..4294967295)	OPTIONAL,

	destinationNumber 	[18] BCDDirectoryNumber	OPTIONAL,
	cAMELInformationSMS 	[19] CAMELInformationSMS	OPTIONAL,

	matched		[200] IMPLICIT INTEGER	OPTIONAL
}

SGSNSMTRecord ::= SET
{
	recordType 		[0] CallEventRecordType,
	servedIMSI 		[1] TBCD STRING (SIZE (3..8)),
	servedIMEI 		[2] TBCD STRING (SIZE (8))	OPTIONAL,
	servedMSISDN 		[3] OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..9))	OPTIONAL,
	msNetworkCapability 	[4] OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..8))	OPTIONAL,
	serviceCentre 		[5] TBCD STRING	OPTIONAL,
	recordingEntity 		[6] TBCD STRING	OPTIONAL,
	locationArea 		[7] OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))	OPTIONAL,
	routingArea		[8] OCTET STRING (SIZE(1))	OPTIONAL,
	cellIdentifier 		[9] OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))	OPTIONAL,
	eventTimeStamp 	[10] OCTET STRING (SIZE(9)),

	nodeID 		[13] IA5String (SIZE(1..20))	OPTIONAL,
	localSequnceNumber 	[14] INTEGER (0..4294967295)	OPTIONAL,

	ratType 		[16] RatType	OPTIONAL,
	chChSelectionMode 	[17] ChChSelectionMode	OPTIONAL,
	numberOfSM 		[101] INTEGER		OPTIONAL,

	routingAreaLastSM	[103] OCTET STRING (SIZE(1))	OPTIONAL,
	cellIdentifierLastSM	[104] OCTET STRING (SIZE(2))	OPTIONAL,
	pLMNIdentifierLastSM 	[105] OCTET STRING (SIZE(3))	OPTIONAL,
	pLMNIdentifier 		[106] OCTET STRING (SIZE(3))	OPTIONAL,
	matched		[200] IMPLICIT INTEGER	OPTIONAL
}

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--
--  COMMON DATA TYPES
--
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
AddressString ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1..20))

APNSelectionMode ::= ENUMERATED
{
	mSorNetworkProvidedSubscriptionVerified	(0),
	mSProvidedSubscriptionNotVerified	(1),
	networkProvidedSubscriptionNotVerified	(2)
}

BCDDirectoryNumber ::= OCTET STRING

CallEventRecordType ::= INTEGER
{
	sgsnPDPRecord	(18),
	sgsnSMORecord	(21),
	sgsnSMTRecord	(22)
}

CAMELInformationPDP ::= SET
{
	sCFAddress 		[1] AddressString	OPTIONAL,
	serviceKey 		[2] INTEGER (0..2147483647)	OPTIONAL,
	defaultTransactionHandling	[3] DefaultGPRS-Handling	OPTIONAL,
	cAMELAccessPointNameNI 	[4] IA5String (SIZE(1..63))	OPTIONAL,
	cAMELAccessPointNameOI 	[5] IA5String (SIZE(1..37))	OPTIONAL,

}

CAMELInformationSMS ::= SET
{

	freeFormatData 		[7] OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..160)) OPTIONAL,
	smsReferenceNumber 		[8] CallReferenceNumber	OPTIONAL
}

CauseForRecClosing ::= INTEGER
{
	normalRelease		(0),
	abnormalRelease	(4),
	cAMELInitCallRelease	(5),
	volumeLimit		(16),
	timeLimit 		(17),
	sGSNChange		(18),
	maxChangeCond	(19),
	pLMNChange		(101)
}

ChangeCondition ::= ENUMERATED
{
	qosChange		(0),
	tariffTime		(1),
	recordClosure		(2)
}

{
	qosRequested		[1] QoSInformation OPTIONAL,
	qosNegotiated		[2] QoSInformation OPTIONAL,

	dataVolumeGPRSDownlink	[4] INTEGER,
	changeCondition	[5] ChangeCondition,
	changeTime		[6] OCTET STRING (SIZE(9))
}

ChChSelectionMode ::= ENUMERATED
{
	subscriptionSpecific	(1),
	aPNSpecific		(2),
	homeDefault		(3)
}

DefaultGPRS-Handling ::= ENUMERATED
{
	continueTransaction	(0),
	releaseTransaction	(1)
}

DefaultSMS-Handling ::= ENUMERATED
{
	continueTransaction	(0),
	releaseTransaction	(1)
}

Diagnostics ::= CHOICE
{
	gsm0408Cause	[0] INTEGER,
	gsm0902MapErrorValue	[1] INTEGER
}

IPAddress ::= CHOICE
{
	iPBinaryAddress	IPBinaryAddress,
	iPTextRepresentedAddress	IPTextRepresentedAddress
}

IPBinaryAddress ::= CHOICE
{
	iPBinV4Address	[0] OCTET STRING (SIZE(4)),
	iPBinV6Address	[1] OCTET STRING (SIZE(16))
}

IPTextRepresentedAddress ::= CHOICE
{
	iPTextV4Address	[2] IA5String (SIZE(7..15)),
	iPTextV6Address	[3] IA5String (SIZE(15..45))
}

LevelOfCAMELService ::= OCTET STRING
-- LevelOfCAMELService ::= BIT STRING
--{
--      basic                   (0),
--      callDurationSupervision (1),
--      onlineCharging          (2)
--}

PDPAddress ::= CHOICE
{
	iPAddress		[0] EXPLICIT IPAddress,
	eTSIAddress		[1] EXPLICIT OCTET STRING (SIZE(1..20))
}

QoSInformation ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE(4..12))

SMSResult ::= CHOICE
{
	gsm0408Cause	[0] INTEGER,
	gsm0902MapErrorValue	[1] INTEGER
}

RatType ::= ENUMERATED
{
	iuUTRAN		(1), --UMTS (3G)
	gSM		(2) --GSM (2G)
}

ManagementExtensions ::= SET OF ManagementExtension
ManagementExtension ::= SEQUENCE
{
  identifier	[UNIVERSAL 6] OCTET STRING,
  significance	[1] BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
  information	[2] GprsCdrExtensions OPTIONAL
}

END

	cellID					[10]	CellID					OPTIONAL,

	invocationOfCallHold	[13]	InvocationOfCallHold		OPTIONAL,

	bNumberFormat			[21]	Msisdn 					OPTIONAL,

	dgtiAddressMsisdn		[23]	Msisdn 					OPTIONAL,
